1+;; lower-wasm driver: compile a whole .lg program to one WasmGC module (D10).
2+;;
3+;; lg -source-paths src src/driver.lg <prog.lg> <out.wat>
4+;;
5+;; Every top-level defn becomes an exported function; every other top-level
6+;; form runs, in order, inside the exported `_main`. The defns are first
7+;; eval'd in this process (in the program's namespace) so ir.build resolves
8+;; self and mutual calls to real vars, which lower-wasm turns into direct
9+;; calls (P1.0). Top-level `def`/`declare` vars form the var table (P1.3):
10+;; they are only interned here, never eval'd, and the def runs in `_main`.
11+(ns driver
12+ (:require [lower-wasm :as lw] [lw-rt] [ir.passes.pipeline :as p] [clojure.string]))
13+
14+(defn read-program [path]
15+ (read-string (str "[" (slurp path) "\n]")))
16+
17+(defn splice-do
18+ "A top-level (do a b ..) as the top-level forms a b .. (P2.14): native
19+ compiles and runs a top-level do subform by subform (Clojure's
20+ Compiler.eval special case, let-go #195), so a require in an earlier
21+ subform makes its namespace resolvable in a later one."
22+ [form]
23+ (if (and (seq? form) (= 'do (first form)))
24+ (mapcat splice-do (rest form))
25+ [form]))
26+
27+(defn defn-form? [form] (and (seq? form) (= 'defn (first form))))
28+
29+(def expand lw/expand-form)
30+
31+(defn def-form? [form] (and (seq? form) (= 'def (first form))))
32+(defn def-sym [form]
33+ (let [s (second form)] (if (and (seq? s) (= 'with-meta (first s))) (second s) s)))
34+
35+(defn name-fns
36+ "Native names fns compiled while a def's value compiles (compiler.go
37+ defName; a fn body clears it), so (def g (fn [a] ..)) reports as `<fn g ..>`
38+ in arity errors. Observed on lg 4e769212: a single-arity fn* anywhere in
39+ the value outside a fn body gets the name; a multi-arity fn* only when it
40+ IS the value (so the named-fn macro's `(fn* ([n] ..))`, inside a let, stays
41+ `<mfn ..>`). Reproduced on the expanded value by giving such fn* forms the
42+ def's name, which ir.build keeps as the template name. Skipped when the
43+ body mentions the name (a fn* name would shadow the var)."
44+ ([nm form] (name-fns nm form true))
45+ ([nm form top?]
46+ (cond
47+ (vector? form) (mapv #(name-fns nm % false) form)
48+ (map? form) (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(name-fns nm k false) (name-fns nm v false)]) form))
49+ (not (seq? form)) form
50+ (= 'quote (first form)) form
51+ (= 'fn* (first form))
52+ (let [multi? (seq? (second form))]
53+ (if (or (symbol? (second form)) (and multi? (not top?))
54+ (some #(= nm %) (tree-seq coll? seq (rest form))))
55+ form
56+ (apply list 'fn* nm (rest form))))
57+ :else (apply list (map #(name-fns nm % false) form)))))
58+
59+(defn expand-top [form]
60+ (let [e (expand form)]
61+ (if (def-form? e)
62+ (apply list 'def (second e) (map #(name-fns (def-sym e) %) (drop 2 e)))
63+ e)))
64+
65+(defn expand-defn
66+ "Macroexpand the body exactly as the IR pipeline does before build; the
67+ defn head and args vector stay intact for build-fn's structural reader.
68+ A docstring is dropped (it has no runtime effect)."
69+ [[_ name & more]]
70+ (let [name (if (and (seq? name) (= 'with-meta (first name))) (second name) name)
71+ more (if (string? (first more)) (rest more) more)
72+ more (if (map? (first more)) (rest more) more)]
73+ (cond
74+ (vector? (first more)) (let [[params body] (lw/split-rest-pattern (first more) (rest more))]
75+ [(apply list 'defn name params (map expand body))])
76+ ;; multi-arity (P2.1): one fn per arity, `name#argc` in wasm
77+ (and (seq more) (every? #(and (seq? %) (vector? (first %))) more))
78+ (vec (for [[params & body] more
79+ :let [[params body] (lw/split-rest-pattern params body)]]
80+ (with-meta (apply list 'defn name params (map expand body)) {::multi true})))
81+ :else (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: unsupported defn shape (attr-map or return hint) in " name)
82+ {:name name})))))
83+
84+;; Every program defn and the _main body are analysed inside the session,
85+;; each after the runtime defns it reaches (P2.1: typeinfer then sees their
86+;; return types), and its signature is registered before the next one.
87+;; --test only: a defn that does not compile becomes a stub that throws
88+;; when called (lower-wasm/stub-fn), so the file's other tests still run and
89+;; the failure is reported as that test's ERROR rather than hiding the file.
90+(def ^:dynamic *stub-failures* false)
91+
92+(defn arity-key
93+ "A defn arity's key: its param count, or \"v\" for the variadic one
94+ (P2.12: `[a & r]` and `[a b c]` both have 3 symbols)."
95+ [params]
96+ (if (lw/variadic-params? params) "v" (count params)))
97+
98+(defn param-count
99+ "The wasm param count of an arity: a variadic one takes the rest seq as
100+ one more param after its fixed ones."
101+ [params]
102+ (if (lw/variadic-params? params) (inc (lw/fixed-count params)) (count params)))
103+
104+(defn wasm-name
105+ "The wasm function id of a program defn form (P1.7 bug-09: mangled into
106+ its own namespace) and the export string that keeps its lg name."
107+ [src]
108+ (let [nm (str (second src)) argc (arity-key (nth src 2))]
109+ (if (::multi (meta src))
110+ [(lw/prog-id nm argc) (str nm "#" argc)]
111+ [(lw/prog-id nm) nm])))
112+
113+(defn stub-info [src e]
114+ (let [nm (first (wasm-name src)) n (param-count (nth src 2))]
115+ {:stub (lw/stub-fn {:name nm :params (vec (repeat n :box)) :ret :box}
116+ (let [m (str (ex-message e))] (subs m 0 (min 100 (count m)))))
117+ :name nm :params (vec (repeat n :box)) :ret :box}))
118+
119+(defn analyze-program!
120+ "boxed: #{[var argc]} whose params must stay boxed (bug-01's fixpoint)."
121+ [defns main-src boxed]
122+ (doall
123+ (for [src (conj defns main-src)]
124+ (do ;; P2.14: in --test a library defn the test reaches that fails
125+ ;; to compile stubs the test (below) instead of the whole file
126+ (if *stub-failures*
127+ (try (lw/analyze-deps! src) (catch e nil))
128+ (lw/analyze-deps! src))
129+ (let [main? (= main-src src)
130+ multi? (::multi (meta src))
131+ argc (arity-key (nth src 2))
132+ v (when-not main? (resolve (second src)))
133+ [wname ename] (if main? ["_main" "lw main"] (wasm-name src))
134+ info (try (binding [lw/*box-params* (contains? boxed [v argc])]
135+ (assoc (lw/analyze-fn src wname (boolean multi?)) :export-name ename))
136+ ;; P1.4's refusals compare the error's first line: rethrow as is
137+ (catch e (if (and *stub-failures* (not main?))
138+ (stub-info src e)
139+ (throw e))))]
140+ (when v
141+ (swap! lw/*sigs* update v
142+ (fn [e] (let [e (or e {:base (str (second src)) :multi? (boolean multi?) :var v})
143+ sig (select-keys info [:name :params :ret])]
144+ (if (= "v" argc)
145+ (assoc e :variadic (assoc sig :fixed (lw/fixed-count (nth src 2))))
146+ (assoc-in e [:arities (count (:params info))] sig))))))
147+ info)))))
148+
149+(defn boxing-needed
150+ "[var argc] keys of program defns whose typed params some call cannot
151+ honour (it holds a boxed value) or that are used as values (the fn-value
152+ wrapper unboxes per the signature), per the notes lowering recorded. Only
153+ keys whose signature still has an unboxed param count."
154+ [notes prog-vars]
155+ (let [typed? (fn [[v argc]] (some #(not= :box %) (get-in @lw/*sigs* [v :arities argc :params])))]
156+ (set (filter typed?
157+ (concat (filter #(contains? prog-vars (first %)) (:viol notes))
158+ (for [v (:value notes) :when (contains? prog-vars v)
159+ argc (keys (:arities (get @lw/*sigs* v)))]
160+ [v argc]))))))
161+
162+;; --test (checks/run-tests.sh): the test file's deftest/is/testing become
163+;; src/testshim.lg's, whose helper defs are injected after the ns form, and
164+;; _main ends by running every deftest in file order and printing native
165+;; run-tests' summary lines.
166+(def test-macros
167+ '[(defmacro is
168+ ([form]
169+ (let [head (when (seq? form) (first form))]
170+ (cond
171+ ;; native's assert-expr special forms; the class is a catch class
172+ ;; native's is returns the caught exception (thrown_test's
173+ ;; thrown-returns-the-exception reads it)
174+ (= head 'thrown?)
175+ `(try (do ~@(drop 2 form) (__t-report false) nil)
176+ (catch ~(second form) e# (__t-report true) e#)
177+ (catch Throwable e# (__t-report :__t-error) nil))
178+ (= head 'thrown-with-msg?)
179+ `(__t-report (try (do ~@(drop 3 form) false)
180+ (catch ~(second form) e# (if (re-find ~(nth form 2) (ex-message e#)) true false))
181+ (catch Throwable e# :__t-error)))
182+ :else `(__t-report (try (if ~form true false) (catch Throwable e# :__t-error))))))
183+ ([form msg] `(is ~form)))
184+ (defmacro testing [s & body] `(do ~@body))
185+ ;; P2.14: a set-test probe only runs through run-test-var (test-ns
186+ ;; reflection), which the shim does not have; the deftests that drive one
187+ ;; report their own ERROR
188+ (defmacro set-test [nm & body] nil)])
189+
190+(defn stub-deftest
191+ "P2.14: the defn for a deftest that fails to compile natively (thrown at
192+ macro expansion, e.g. a user macro whose body touches a program atom the
193+ driver only interned): it reports one ERROR for that test, so one bad
194+ form costs one test instead of the file."
195+ [nm]
196+ (list 'defn nm [] (list '__t-begin (str nm)) (list '__t-uncaught nil)))
197+
198+(defn deftest->defn [[_ nm & body]]
199+ (list 'defn nm [] (list '__t-begin (str nm))
200+ (list 'try (apply list 'do body) (list 'catch 'Throwable 'e (list '__t-uncaught 'e)))))
201+
202+(defn decl-form?
203+ "A program-level (wasm/defstruct ..), defarray or deffunc: a type for the
204+ module's rec group, not a run-time value."
205+ [form]
206+ (and (seq? form) (symbol? (first form))
207+ (contains? lw-rt/decl-heads (try (resolve (first form)) (catch e nil)))))
208+
209+;; P1.7 (bug-05): native lg keeps compiling a call to one of these as its
210+;; opcode after the program defines a var of the same name (the user fn only
211+;; runs as a value), and ir.build does not (it builds a call once the name
212+;; resolves elsewhere). Reproducing that split is not worth it: refused.
213+(def native-opcode-ops
214+ '#{+ - * inc dec < <= > >= = bit-and bit-or bit-xor bit-not bit-and-not bit-shift-left
215+ bit-shift-right unsigned-bit-shift-right unchecked-add unchecked-subtract unchecked-multiply})
216+
217+(defn refuse-core-op-redef! [sym]
218+ (when (and (symbol? sym) (contains? native-opcode-ops sym)
219+ (let [r (resolve sym)] (and (var? r) (= r (ns-resolve 'clojure.core sym)))))
220+ (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: redefining core op " sym " is not supported") {:var sym}))))
221+
222+;; P1.7 (bug-06/bug-11): native lg compiles and runs a program one top-level
223+;; form at a time, so a compile error (recur not in tail position, recur arity,
224+;; a symbol that does not resolve yet) stops it at that form, after the forms
225+;; before it ran. The driver compiles every form natively at its position
226+;; (defns are eval'd; other forms are compiled inside a (fn* [] ..) and not
227+;; run) and, on the first error, ends _main with a throw of native's message.
228+(defn native-msg
229+ "Native's compile-error chain as its report prints it: the first line is
230+ the outermost context, then `caused by: ` lines. strip? drops the
231+ `compiling fn body` layer the driver's own (fn* [] ..) wrapper adds."
232+ [e strip?]
233+ (let [parts (map #(clojure.string/replace % #"^CompileError: " "")
234+ (clojure.string/split (str (ex-message e)) #"\n\tcaused by "))
235+ parts (if (and strip? (= "compiling fn body" (first parts)) (next parts)) (rest parts) parts)]
236+ (clojure.string/join "\ncaused by: " parts)))
237+
238+(defn native!
239+ "Compile (and for defns, define) natively; a failure becomes ::native."
240+ ([form] (native! form false))
241+ ([form strip?]
242+ (try (eval form)
243+ (catch e (throw (ex-info "native compile error" {::native (native-msg e strip?)}))))))
244+
245+(defn compile-check! [form] (native! (list 'fn* [] form) true))
246+
247+(defn defining-sym [form]
248+ (when (and (seq? form) (#{'defn 'defn- 'def} (first form)))
249+ (def-sym form)))
250+
251+(defn defn->def
252+ "(defn f ..) as (def f (fn ..)): a var defined more than once is a
253+ var-table var (P1.7 bug-09), so each definition takes effect at its
254+ position, as natively, instead of one static function."
255+ [[_ nm & more]]
256+ (let [nm (if (and (seq? nm) (= 'with-meta (first nm))) (second nm) nm)
257+ more (if (string? (first more)) (rest more) more)
258+ more (if (map? (first more)) (rest more) more)]
259+ (list 'def nm (apply list 'fn more))))
260+
261+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
262+;; P3.2: multi-namespace programs. `-source-paths <dirs>` (lg's flag, the
263+;; same ':'-separated list) names the roots a program's `require`d library
264+;; namespaces load from. A require (top-level form or ns clause) is loaded
265+;; natively here (lg itself resolves it, so the driver's lg must be started
266+;; with the same roots on its own -source-paths), and every namespace it
267+;; reaches transitively that lives under a root is indexed, dependency first
268+;; (lg's own load order: a post-order walk of the :require clauses):
269+;; defn/defn- -> lw-rt/lib-defns, compiled on demand (tree-shaken, D64)
270+;; def -> a var-table global $var_<munged ns/name> (D54, D92)
271+;; other forms -> run in order by the namespace's init fn
272+;; Each namespace's init is a 0-arg lib defn `<ns>/__lw_nsinit` holding its
273+;; defs and top-level forms; the require's position in _main calls the inits
274+;; of the namespaces it loaded, so load-order side effects (xsofy's
275+;; defcreature/defitem registering templates) run where natively they do.
276+;; Namespaces outside the roots (string, math, term, ...) are the runtime's.
277+
278+(def source-paths (atom []))
279+
280+(defn path-exists? [p] (some? (try (os/stat p) (catch e nil))))
281+
282+(defn ns-file
283+ "The source file of ns-sym under the source paths, or nil (a native or
284+ runtime namespace)."
285+ [ns-sym]
286+ (let [rel (str (-> (str ns-sym) (clojure.string/replace "." "/") (clojure.string/replace "-" "_")) ".lg")]
287+ (some #(let [p (str % "/" rel)] (when (path-exists? p) p)) @source-paths)))
288+
289+(defn libspec-ns [spec]
290+ (cond (symbol? spec) spec
291+ (and (vector? spec) (symbol? (first spec))) (first spec)
292+ :else nil))
293+
294+(defn ns-form-requires [nsf]
295+ (for [clause (drop 2 nsf)
296+ :when (and (seq? clause) (#{:require :use} (first clause)))
297+ spec (rest clause)
298+ :let [n (libspec-ns spec)] :when n]
299+ n))
300+
301+(defn require-form-nss
302+ "Namespaces a top-level (require 'a '[b :as c]) names, or nil when form
303+ is not one."
304+ [form]
305+ (when (and (seq? form) (#{'require 'use} (first form)))
306+ (keep #(libspec-ns (if (and (seq? %) (= 'quote (first %))) (second %) %)) (rest form))))
307+
308+(def lib-loaded (atom #{})) ; namespaces already indexed (each inits once)
309+
310+(defn lib-order!
311+ "[[ns path] ...] not yet indexed that loading roots reaches, dependency
312+ first; a cycle is an error (lg would fail on it too)."
313+ [roots]
314+ (let [out (atom []) seen (atom @lib-loaded)]
315+ (letfn [(visit [n stack]
316+ (when-let [path (ns-file n)]
317+ (cond (some #{n} stack)
318+ (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: namespace cycle " (clojure.string/join " -> " (map str (conj stack n)))) {}))
319+ (contains? @seen n) nil
320+ :else
321+ (let [nsf (first (filter #(and (seq? %) (= 'ns (first %))) (read-program path)))]
322+ (doseq [r (ns-form-requires nsf)] (visit r (conj stack n)))
323+ (swap! seen conj n)
324+ (swap! out conj [n path])))))]
325+ (doseq [r roots] (visit r [])))
326+ @out))
327+
328+(defn strip-def-doc
329+ "(def x \"doc\" v) as (def x v)."
330+ [form]
331+ (if (and (= 4 (count form)) (string? (nth form 2))) (list 'def (second form) (nth form 3)) form))
332+
333+(declare expand-top)
334+
335+(defn index-lib-ns!
336+ "Index one loaded library namespace (see above). Returns the init var's
337+ symbol. var-globals collects the namespace's def vars."
338+ [ns-sym path var-globals]
339+ (binding [*ns* (the-ns ns-sym)]
340+ (let [forms (read-program path)
341+ init-forms (atom [])]
342+ (doseq [form forms]
343+ (let [head (when (seq? form) (first form))]
344+ (cond
345+ (#{'ns 'defmacro 'declare} head) nil
346+ (#{'defn 'defn-} head)
347+ (let [[nm _] (lw-rt/strip-meta-name (second form))
348+ v (lw-rt/ns-var ns-sym nm)]
349+ (when-not v (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: " ns-sym "/" nm " did not load") {})))
350+ (swap! lw-rt/lib-defns assoc v {:var v :ns ns-sym :name nm :lib true
351+ :arities (lw-rt/arities (drop 2 form))}))
352+ (#{'def 'defonce} head)
353+ (let [form (strip-def-doc (apply list 'def (rest form)))
354+ [nm _] (lw-rt/strip-meta-name (second form))
355+ v (lw-rt/ns-var ns-sym nm)]
356+ (swap! var-globals assoc v (str "$var_" (lw/munge-id (str ns-sym "/" nm))))
357+ ;; the name's reader meta (^:private, ^:dynamic) has no run-time
358+ ;; effect here, and ir.build would evaluate a (with-meta ..) name
359+ (swap! init-forms conj (expand-top (list 'def nm (nth form 2)))))
360+ (#{'defmulti 'deftype 'defprotocol 'defrecord} head)
361+ (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: unsupported top-level form " head " in " ns-sym) {:head head}))
362+ :else (swap! init-forms conj (expand-top form)))))
363+ (let [init-sym '__lw_nsinit
364+ v (intern ns-sym init-sym (fn [] nil))]
365+ (swap! lw-rt/lib-defns assoc v {:var v :ns ns-sym :name init-sym :lib true :pre-expanded true
366+ :arities [(into [[]] (conj @init-forms nil))]})
367+ (symbol (str ns-sym) (str init-sym))))))
368+
369+(defn load-libs!
370+ "Natively load what form requires, index each newly reached library
371+ namespace, and return the form _main runs in its place (the inits)."
372+ [form nss var-globals]
373+ (let [order (lib-order! nss)]
374+ (eval form)
375+ (let [inits (doall (for [[n path] order]
376+ (do (swap! lib-loaded conj n) (index-lib-ns! n path var-globals))))]
377+ (when (seq inits) (apply list 'do (map list inits))))))
378+
379+(defn -main [& argv]
380+ (let [sp-arg (second (drop-while #(not= "-source-paths" %) argv))
381+ _ (reset! source-paths (if sp-arg (vec (remove empty? (clojure.string/split sp-arg #":"))) []))
382+ argv (if sp-arg (remove #{"-source-paths" sp-arg} argv) argv)
383+ skip-arg (second (drop-while #(not= "--skip" %) argv))
384+ skip (set (map symbol (when skip-arg (clojure.string/split skip-arg #","))))
385+ argv (if skip-arg (remove #{"--skip" skip-arg} argv) argv)
386+ flags (set (filter #(clojure.string/starts-with? % "--") argv))
387+ [in out] (remove flags argv)
388+ opts {:rt (not (flags "--no-rt")) :shake (not (flags "--no-shake"))}
389+ rtlib? (and (:rt opts) (not (flags "--no-rtlib")))
390+ test? (flags "--test")
391+ opts (assoc opts :trap-throws (boolean test?))
392+ forms (mapcat splice-do (read-program in))
393+ tests (atom [])
394+ forms (if test?
395+ (let [[pre post] (split-with #(not (and (seq? %) (= 'ns (first %)))) forms)
396+ shim (read-program (str lw-rt/src-dir "/testshim.lg"))]
397+ (concat pre (take 1 post) [::install-test-macros] shim
398+ ;; --skip names deftests left out on both sides of the
399+ ;; comparison (checks/run-tests.skip says why)
400+ (keep #(cond (not (and (seq? %) (= 'deftest (first %)))) %
401+ (contains? skip (second %)) nil
402+ :else (do (swap! tests conj (second %)) (deftest->defn %)))
403+ (rest post))))
404+ forms)
405+ _ (eval '(ns user))
406+ defns (atom []) body (atom []) table (atom []) decls (atom [])
407+ lib-globals (atom {})
408+ ;; names defined by more than one defn/defn-/def form (bug-09)
409+ redef (set (for [[s n] (frequencies (keep defining-sym forms)) :when (> n 1)] s))
410+ process!
411+ (fn [form]
412+ (when (and (seq? form) (#{'defn 'defn- 'def 'declare} (first form)))
413+ (doseq [s (if (= 'declare (first form)) (rest form) [(def-sym form)])]
414+ (refuse-core-op-redef! s)))
415+ (let [form (if (and (seq? form) (#{'defn 'defn-} (first form)) (contains? redef (def-sym form)))
416+ (defn->def form)
417+ form)]
418+ (cond
419+ (= form ::install-test-macros)
420+ (do (doseq [s '[deftest is testing set-test]] (ns-unmap *ns* s))
421+ (doseq [m test-macros] (eval m)))
422+ (and (seq? form) (= 'defn- (first form))) (do (native! form) (swap! defns into (expand-defn form)))
423+ (decl-form? form) (do (native! form) (swap! decls conj (resolve (second form))))
424+ (and (seq? form) (= 'ns (first form)))
425+ (let [nss (ns-form-requires form)
426+ init (load-libs! form nss lib-globals)]
427+ (when init (swap! body conj init)))
428+ ;; P3.2: a require of library namespaces runs their inits here
429+ (require-form-nss form)
430+ (let [init (try (load-libs! form (require-form-nss form) lib-globals)
431+ (catch e (if (::native (ex-data e)) (throw e)
432+ (throw (ex-info "native compile error" {::native (native-msg e false)})))))]
433+ (when init (swap! body conj init)))
434+ ;; declare only interns forward vars: a later defn binds by name
435+ ;; (direct calls), anything else lands in the var table.
436+ (and (seq? form) (= 'declare (first form))) (do (native! form) (swap! table into (rest form)))
437+ (defn-form? form) (do (native! form) (swap! defns into (expand-defn form)))
438+ ;; intern only: the value is computed by _main at run time
439+ (def-form? form) (do (compile-check! form)
440+ (eval (list 'declare (def-sym form)))
441+ (swap! table conj (def-sym form))

444+ (and (seq? form) (= 'defmacro (first form))) (native! form)
445+ (and (seq? form) (#{'defmulti 'deftype 'defprotocol} (first form)))

447+ :else (do (compile-check! form) (swap! body conj form)))))

449+ ;; it (a def is only interned here, a defn's file is <read-string>);

476+ (map list @tests) ['(__t-summary)])

480+ (lw/with-session*
481+ ss
482+ (fn []
483+ (binding [*stub-failures* (boolean test?) lw/*stub-libs* (boolean test?) lw/*program-file* in]

490+ ;; params, and the program is analysed and lowered again until
491+ ;; nothing new needs boxing (monotone, so it terminates). Usually
492+ ;; one round: fib's calls all pass ints.

502+ (let [infos (analyze-program! @defns main-src boxed)
503+ notes (atom {})
504+ fns (binding [lw/*abi-notes* notes] (vec (doall (map lower-one infos))))

506+ (if (empty? more) fns (recur (into boxed more)))))]

508+ (when (and (:rt opts) (not rtlib?) (not (:shake opts)))
509+ (doseq [d lw-rt/defns] (lw/rt-analyze! (:var d))))
510+ (spit out (lw/session-module ss fns)))))))))

152+ (if (contains? *func-vals* nid)
153+ :func
154+ (let [t (ir/type-of nid *f*)]

161+;; :func is a wasm funcref (wasm/funcref, a :funcref field); it never boxes.

165+(defn coerce [from to]

198+(defn- incoming
199+ "Values feeding param `idx` of block `bid` across all predecessor edges."
200+ [bid idx]
201+ (for [p (ir/block-preds bid *f*)
202+ :let [t (ir/block-term p *f*) o (ir/op t *f*) a (ir/aux t *f*)]
203+ bt (cond (= o :branch) [a]
204+ (= o :branch-if) [(ir/cond-target-true a) (ir/cond-target-false a)]
205+ :else [])
206+ :when (= bid (ir/branch-target-target bt))
207+ :let [args (ir/branch-target-args bt)]
208+ :when (< idx (count args))]
209+ (nth args idx)))

213+(defn src-of
214+ "Legalize threads values that get no local (vars, closures, symbol consts)
215+ through blocks as block-args; this is the one value a block-arg carries,
216+ or nid itself for a genuine merge. Unlike ir/resolve-single-source it sees
217+ through loop-carried cycles: a loop header's param fed by the entry value
218+ and by its own copy on the back-edge still has one source."
219+ [nid]
220+ (if-let [m *memo*]
221+ (if-let [r (get @m nid)]
222+ r
223+ (let [r (src-of* nid)] (swap! m assoc nid r) r))
224+ (src-of* nid)))

226+(defn block-arg-leaves
227+ "{block-arg #{leaf ...}} for the whole fn, solved once as a fixpoint: a
228+ block-arg's leaves are the union over its incoming values (a block-arg's
229+ own leaves, any other value itself). Cycles (loop-carried params)
230+ converge because the sets only grow."
231+ []
232+ (let [inc-of (into {} (for [b (ir/blocks *f*)
233+ [idx p] (map-indexed vector (ir/block-params b *f*))]
234+ [p (vec (incoming b idx))]))
235+ step (fn [L] (into {} (for [[ba xs] inc-of]
236+ [ba (reduce (fn [acc x] (if (contains? inc-of x) (into acc (get L x)) (conj acc x)))
237+ (get L ba #{}) xs)])))]
238+ (loop [L {}]
239+ (let [L2 (step L)] (if (= L2 L) L (recur L2))))))

241+;; P2.11 (F2): two constants are the same value only when they are the same
242+;; kind with the same bits, all the way down. `=` is not that: [] = (), 0.0 =
243+;; -0.0, {:a 1 :b 2} = {:b 2 :a 1} (whose print order differs), so anything
244+;; that merges constants by `=` (ir.passes.cse's (op refs aux) table, src-of's
245+;; leaf test) let the first spelling win. Floats key by their printed digits
246+;; plus their hash, a function of the bits (-0.0 stays apart, and so do NaNs
247+;; with different payloads, which `=` never merges), collections by kind,
248+;; element keys in order, and meta.
249+(defn strict-key [v]
250+ ;; var? first: lg's collection predicates see through a Var to its value
251+ ;; (a :load-var leaf's aux is the Var of a def'd vector), while mapv does not
252+ (cond (var? v) [:var v]
253+ (float? v) [:float (str v) (hash v)] ; hash: NaN payloads print alike
254+ (vector? v) [:vector (mapv strict-key v) (meta v)]
255+ (seq? v) [:list (mapv strict-key v) (meta v)]
256+ (map? v) [:map (mapv (fn [[k x]] [(strict-key k) (strict-key x)]) v) (meta v)]
257+ (set? v) [:set (mapv strict-key v) (meta v)]
258+ :else [(str (type v)) v]))
259+
260+(defn src-of*
261+ [nid]
262+ (if (= :block-arg (ir/op nid *f*))
263+ (let [L (if *memo*
264+ (or (get @*memo* ::leaves) (let [l (block-arg-leaves)] (swap! *memo* assoc ::leaves l) l))
265+ (block-arg-leaves))
266+ leaves (sort (get L nid))
267+ rep (first leaves)
268+ same? (fn [x] (or (= x rep)
269+ (and (empty? (ir/refs x *f*)) (empty? (ir/refs rep *f*))
270+ (= (ir/op x *f*) (ir/op rep *f*)) (= (strict-key (ir/aux x *f*)) (strict-key (ir/aux rep *f*))))))]
271+ (if (and rep (every? same? leaves)) rep nid))
272+ nid))

274+(defn var-of
275+ "The var a value denotes when it is a :load-var, or a block-arg that only
276+ ever carries one var (legalize threads :load-var through blocks), else nil."
277+ [nid]
278+ (let [r (src-of nid)]
279+ (when (= :load-var (ir/op r *f*)) (ir/aux r *f*))))

282+ "A var read from a mutable global: the program's def/declare vars (the var
283+ table, D54) and the runtime's top-level defs (D39)."
284+ [v]
285+ (or (contains? *var-globals* v) (and *rt* (contains? lw-rt/global-by-var v))))

292+(defn var-hidden?
293+ "A var value that gets no local: everything but the var table's vars. Defn
294+ and core-op vars are constants, so a value use re-materialises them at
295+ the use site; table vars are read where the :load-var sits (they can be
296+ re-def'd between load and use)."
297+ [nid]

300+(defn dead? [nid] (= :invalid (ir/op nid *f*)))

303+(defn typed-aux?
304+ "typeinfer rewrites some consts' aux to [:const <type> <value>]; any other
305+ vector aux is a vector literal."
306+ [a]
307+ ;; P3.2: not a Var: lg's vector?/string?/keyword? see through a Var to its
308+ ;; value, and a library def's var is bound at compile time
309+ (and (not (var? a)) (vector? a) (= 3 (count a)) (= :const (first a)) (keyword? (second a))))

311+(defn const-val [nid]
312+ (let [a (ir/aux (src-of nid) *f*)] (if (typed-aux? a) (nth a 2) a)))

314+(defn template? [nid]
315+ (and (= :const (ir/op nid *f*))
316+ (let [a (ir/aux nid *f*)] (and (not (var? a)) (map? a) (contains? #{:fn-template :multi-fn-template} (:kind a))))))

318+(defn closure-val?
319+ "An fn* value: its template const, :make-closure, or a :push-closed link."
320+ [nid]
321+ (let [r (src-of nid)]
322+ (or (template? r) (contains? #{:make-closure :push-closed} (ir/op r *f*)))))

324+(defn closure-hidden?
325+ "A closure value with no local: a chain link (only the chain's last node is
326+ the closure) or a chain consumed by :try (lambda-lifted as a region)."
327+ [nid]
328+ (and (closure-val? nid)
329+ (let [r (src-of nid)] (or (contains? *linked* r) (contains? *try-srcs* r)))))
330+
331+(defn symbol-const? [nid]
332+ (and (= :const (ir/op (src-of nid) *f*)) (let [v (const-val nid)] (and (not (var? v)) (symbol? v)))))
333+
334+(defn var-const?
335+ "A Var object constant (a :def's target, or #'x)."
336+ [nid]
337+ (and (= :const (ir/op (src-of nid) *f*)) (var? (const-val nid))))
338+
339+(defn def-val? [nid] (= :def (ir/op (src-of nid) *f*)))
340+
341+(defn int-const-val
342+ "The value of an :int-typed int constant (or a block-arg that only carries
343+ one). Such values get no local: each use is an i64.const, which keeps
344+ fns small (V8 sizes a caller's inlining budget from its wire size)."
345+ [nid]
346+ (let [r (src-of nid)]
347+ (when (and (= :const (ir/op r *f*)) (= :int (ty nid)))
348+ (let [a (ir/aux r *f*) v (if (typed-aux? a) (nth a 2) a)]
349+ (when (int? v) v)))))
350+
351+(defn string-const?
352+ "A string literal: materialised at each use, so an intrinsic that wants the
353+ literal itself (bytes-of-string, trap) reads it without a Str being built."
354+ [nid]
355+ (and (= :const (ir/op (src-of nid) *f*)) (let [v (const-val nid)] (and (not (var? v)) (string? v)))))
356+
357+(defn call-var
358+ "The var a :call inst calls directly, or nil."
359+ [nid]
360+ (when (= :call (ir/op nid *f*))
361+ (when-let [c (first (ir/refs nid *f*))] (var-of c))))
362+
363+(defn null-call?
364+ "(wasm/null): pure, so it takes no local and each use materialises the
365+ null of the slot's hierarchy (none for eq, nofunc for a funcref slot)."
366+ [nid]
367+ (= #'wasm.intrinsics/null (call-var (src-of nid))))
368+
369+(defn nullish? [nid]
370+ (or (null-call? nid)
371+ (let [r (src-of nid)] (and (= :const (ir/op r *f*)) (nil? (const-val nid))))))
372+
373+(defn no-local?
374+ "Values that never occupy a wasm local: dead params, constant vars,
375+ closure links and :try regions, symbol consts (consumed by
376+ catch-matches?), Var objects and :def results (consumed by nothing),
377+ string literals and (wasm/null) (materialised at each use)."
378+ [nid]
379+ (or (dead? nid) (var-hidden? nid) (closure-hidden? nid) (symbol-const? nid)
380+ (var-const? nid) (def-val? nid) (some? (int-const-val nid))
381+ (string-const? nid) (null-call? nid)))
382+
383+(declare var-value-wat extern-global phase2-const-wat)
384+
385+(defn arg-as [nid k]
386+ (cond
387+ (and (= k :func) (nullish? nid)) "(ref.null nofunc)"
388+ (null-call? nid) (str "(ref.null none)" (coerce :box k))
389+ (string-const? nid) (str (str-wat (const-val nid)) (coerce :box k))
390+ (and *rt* (symbol-const? nid)) (str (const-box-wat (const-val nid)) (coerce :box k))
391+ ;; P2.14: (var x) / #'x as a value (var-const-form)
392+ (and *rt* (var-const? nid)) (str (const-box-wat (const-val nid)) (coerce :box k))
393+ (var-hidden? nid) (str (var-value-wat (var-of nid)) (coerce :box k))
394+ (closure-hidden? nid) (fail "unsupported closure used as a value (a :try region)" {:nid nid :fn *fname*})
395+ ;; quoted symbols and #'vars as values are Phase 2's value kinds; the
396+ ;; placeholder throw is stack-polymorphic, so it stands in for any kind k
397+ (symbol-const? nid) (phase2-const-wat (const-val nid))
398+ (var-const? nid) (phase2-const-wat (const-val nid))
399+ (def-val? nid) (fail "unsupported :def result used as a value" {:nid nid :fn *fname*})
400+ (some? (int-const-val nid)) (str "(i64.const " (int-const-val nid) ")" (coerce :int k))
401+ :else (str (lget nid) (coerce (ty nid) k))))
402+
403+(def int-binops {:add "i64.add" :sub "i64.sub" :mul "i64.mul"})
404+(def chk-binops {:add "call $add_chk" :sub "call $sub_chk" :mul "call $mul_chk"})
405+(defn binop [op] (if (= *checked* :call) (chk-binops op) (int-binops op)))
406+(defn hex32 [x] (format "%08x" (bit-and (hash x) 0xffffffff)))
407+
408+(defn safe-id [s] (str/replace s #"[^A-Za-z0-9!#%&'*+./:<=>?@^_`|~-]" "_"))
409+
410+;; P1.7 (bug-09): every program identifier gets its own namespace of wasm
411+;; ids, `$u_<munged>`, so a defn named `mem`, `_main`, `rt_box_int`, `lgex`
412+;; or `λ` cannot collide with the backend's ids or be rejected by the WAT
413+;; parser. Reversible: ASCII letters, digits and `!%&'*+-.:<=>?@^`|~` stay,
414+;; `_` doubles, every other byte (UTF-8 included) is `_` + two hex digits.
415+;; `#` is escaped so it stays free as the multi-arity separator (`$u_f#2`).
416+(def ^:private id-keep (set "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!%&'*+-.:<=>?@^`|~"))
417+
418+(defn munge-id [s]
419+ (apply str (map (fn [b] (let [b (bit-and b 255) c (char b)]
420+ (cond (= c \_) "__"
421+ (and (< b 128) (contains? id-keep c)) (str c)
422+ :else (format "_%02x" b))))
423+ (.getBytes (str s)))))
424+
425+(defn prog-id
426+ "The wasm id (without `$`) of program defn `nm`, arity argc for a
427+ multi-arity defn's per-arity function."
428+ ([nm] (str "u_" (munge-id nm)))
429+ ([nm argc] (str "u_" (munge-id nm) "#" argc)))
430+
431+(defn wat-str [s] (-> (str s) (str/replace "\\" "\\\\") (str/replace "\"" "\\\"")))
432+
433+;; Generated names are content-addressed, not counters, so the cached
434+;; runtime library (rt-library) and a program compiled against it agree on
435+;; every name without renumbering.
436+(defn string-name [s]
437+ (or (get @*strings* s)
438+ ;; short strings are named by their bytes (exact: phm_test interns
439+ ;; murmur3-colliding keys on purpose); long ones by two hashes, one of
440+ ;; the reversed text, so a shared-suffix collision does not carry over
441+ (let [bs (map #(bit-and % 255) (.getBytes s))
442+ nm (if (<= (count bs) 24)
443+ (str "$s_" (apply str (map #(format "%02x" %) bs)))
444+ (str "$s" (hex32 s) (hex32 (apply str (reverse s))) "_" (count bs)))]
445+ (when (some #(= nm %) (vals @*strings*))
446+ (fail "string data name collision" {:s s :name nm :other (first (filter #(= nm (get @*strings* %)) (keys @*strings*)))}))
447+ (swap! *strings* assoc s nm)
448+ nm)))
449+
450+(defn bytes-wat [s]
451+ (str "(array.new_data $Bytes " (string-name s) " (i32.const 0) (i32.const "
452+ (count (.getBytes s)) "))"))
453+
454+(defn rt-error-wat
455+ "A Go-side runtime error as an lg exception payload: `msg` is what lg
456+ prints when it escapes uncaught, `cmsg` is what (ex-message e) returns once
457+ a catch has reified it (native wraps some errors, e.g. overflow gets an
458+ `ExecutionError: ` prefix, D16)."
459+ [msg cmsg]
460+ (str "(struct.new $Err (i32.const 1) " (bytes-wat msg) " " (bytes-wat cmsg) " (ref.null none) (ref.null none))"))
461+
462+(defn str-wat
463+ "A string literal as a value: the runtime's Str box (D38), hash not yet cached."
464+ [s] (str "(struct.new $Str " (bytes-wat s) " (i64.const -1))"))
465+
466+(defn raise-wat []
467+ (str "(throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat "integer overflow" "ExecutionError: integer overflow") ")"))
468+(defn raise
469+ ;; A call, not the throw itself: building the $Err inline at every check
470+ ;; doubled fib's wire size, and V8 sizes its inlining budget from the
471+ ;; caller's size (2x in a module this big), so fib stopped inlining its
472+ ;; callees (P1.GATE, bench-fib.sh).
473+ [] (if *trap* "unreachable" "(call $rt_raise_overflow)"))
474+(defn literal-int
475+ "The value of an `(i64.const N)` operand expression, else nil."
476+ [e]
477+ (when-let [[_ n] (re-find #"^\(i64\.const (-?[0-9]+)\)$" e)] (parse-long n)))
478+
479+(defn const-check
480+ "Overflow test of r = a op c for a literal c: one compare of the wrapped
481+ result with a, smaller and cheaper than the sign-xor form (fib's (- n 1),
482+ inc/dec). Moving by c != 0 overflowed iff r landed on the wrong side of a:
483+ a + c (c > 0) and a - c (c < 0) overflow iff r < a, the other two iff
484+ r > a (c = MinInt64 included: a - MIN overflows iff a >= 0, iff r < a)."
485+ [op a c r]
486+ (let [up? (if (= op :add) (pos? c) (neg? c))]
487+ (if (zero? c)
488+ ""
489+ (str "(if (" (if up? "i64.lt_s" "i64.gt_s") " " r " " a ") (then " (raise) "))"))))
490+
491+(defn inline-check
492+ "Overflow test on an already-computed result r (same sign-xor tests as $add_chk/$sub_chk)."
493+ [op a b r]
494+ (if-let [c (literal-int b)]
495+ (const-check op a c r)
496+ (if-let [c (when (= op :add) (literal-int a))]
497+ (const-check op b c r)
498+ (let [x (if (= op :add) (str "(i64.xor " b " " r ")") (str "(i64.xor " a " " b ")"))]
499+ (str "(if (i64.lt_s (i64.and (i64.xor " a " " r ") " x ") (i64.const 0)) (then " (raise) "))")))))
500+(defn inline-checked? [op] (and (= *checked* :inline) (#{:add :sub :inc :dec} op)))
501+(defn int-arith
502+ "Instructions computing a op b (i64 operand exprs) into local nid, checked per
503+ *checked*. :mul has no inline form, so :inline routes it through $mul_chk."
504+ [nid op a b]
505+ (let [inst (if (and (= op :mul) *checked*) "call $mul_chk" (binop op))
506+ r (str "(" inst " " a " " b ")")]
507+ (if (= (ty nid) :int)
508+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " " r ")"
509+ (when (inline-checked? op) (str " " (inline-check op a b (lget nid)))))
510+ ;; result typed :box: compute in a scratch i64, check, then box
511+ (str "(local.set $tmp " r ")"
512+ (when (inline-checked? op) (str " " (inline-check op a b "(local.get $tmp)")))
513+ " (local.set $v" nid " (local.get $tmp)" (coerce :int (ty nid)) ")"))))
514+
515+(def cmp-ops {:lt "i64.lt_s" :lte "i64.le_s" :gt "i64.gt_s" :gte "i64.ge_s" :eq "i64.eq"})
516+
517+;; P1.1 int ops that never overflow-check: bit ops, Go-semantics shifts, quot
518+;; and the unchecked-* family. Operand exprs must be side-effect free and cheap
519+;; to repeat (prim-wat stages anything else into $ta/$tb first).
520+(def plain-binops {:bit-and "i64.and" :bit-or "i64.or" :bit-xor "i64.xor"
521+ :unchecked-add "i64.add" :unchecked-sub "i64.sub" :unchecked-mul "i64.mul"})
522+(def int-ops (into #{:bit-and-not :bit-shift-left :bit-shift-right :unsigned-bit-shift-right :quot}
523+ (keys plain-binops)))
524+
525+(defn int-op-wat
526+ "[pre expr]: statements that must run first (quot's zero test) and the i64
527+ expression for a op b."
528+ [op a b]
529+ (let [lt64 (str "(i64.lt_u " b " (i64.const 64))")]
530+ (cond
531+ (plain-binops op) [nil (str "(" (plain-binops op) " " a " " b ")")]
532+ (= op :bit-and-not) [nil (str "(i64.and " a " (i64.xor " b " (i64.const -1)))")]
533+ ;; Go shifts, not wasm's count-mod-64: a count >= 64, or negative (huge
534+ ;; as unsigned), shifts every bit out (D16).
535+ (= op :bit-shift-left) [nil (str "(select (i64.shl " a " " b ") (i64.const 0) " lt64 ")")]
536+ (= op :bit-shift-right) [nil (str "(select (i64.shr_s " a " " b ") (i64.shr_s " a " (i64.const 63)) " lt64 ")")]
537+ (= op :unsigned-bit-shift-right) [nil (str "(select (i64.shr_u " a " " b ") (i64.const 0) " lt64 ")")]
538+ ;; i64.div_s traps on MinInt64/-1 where Go wraps to MinInt64 (D16), and
539+ ;; a/-1 is 0-a for every a, so -1 takes the wrapping negate.
540+ (= op :quot) [(str "(if (i64.eqz " b ") (then (throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat "divide by zero" "divide by zero") ")))")
541+ (str "(if (result i64) (i64.eq " b " (i64.const -1)) (then (i64.sub (i64.const 0) " a
542+ ")) (else (i64.div_s " a " " b ")))")])))
543+
544+;; Native spelling of each op, for the boxed-operand error text.
545+(def op-names {:add "+" :sub "-" :mul "*" :lt "<" :lte "<=" :gt ">" :gte ">=" :eq "="
546+ :inc "inc" :dec "dec" :quot "quot" :bit-not "bit-not"
547+ :unchecked-add "unchecked-add" :unchecked-sub "unchecked-subtract"
548+ :unchecked-mul "unchecked-multiply" :bit-and "bit-and" :bit-or "bit-or"
549+ :bit-xor "bit-xor" :bit-and-not "bit-and-not" :bit-shift-left "bit-shift-left"
550+ :bit-shift-right "bit-shift-right" :unsigned-bit-shift-right "unsigned-bit-shift-right"
551+ :zero? "zero?" :pos? "pos?" :neg? "neg?" :div "/"})
552+
553+(defn bit-op? [op] (or (= op :bit-not) (str/starts-with? (name op) "bit-") (= op :unsigned-bit-shift-right)))
554+
555+(defn unbox-msg
556+ "What a non-Int boxed operand throws. Bit ops reproduce native's text; the
557+ numeric ops would need the Phase-2 numeric tower (floats, ratios, type
558+ names in `cannot add X and Y`), so they throw a named Phase-1 limit."
559+ [op]
560+ (if (bit-op? op)
561+ (str (op-names op) " expected Int")
562+ (str "lower-wasm: " (op-names op) " on a non-Int operand (numeric tower is Phase 2)")))
563+
564+(def unbox-slot-msg "lower-wasm: a non-Int value reached an Int-typed slot (numeric tower is Phase 2)")
565+
566+(defn unbox-fn [op] (str "$rt_int_" (str/replace (name op) "-" "_")))
567+
568+(defn op-int-arg
569+ "Operand nid as i64 for op: an unboxed int as is, a boxed value through the
570+ op's checked unbox (never a bare ref.cast, which would trap uncatchably)."
571+ [op nid]
572+ (if (= (ty nid) :box)
573+ (str "(call " (unbox-fn op) " " (arg-as nid :box) ")")
574+ (arg-as nid :int)))
575+
576+(defn guard-call [call]
577+ ;; try_table whose only handler re-raises: the "cleanup" shape of the EH
578+ ;; proposal, so the hot path pays for the table and nothing else.
579+ (if *guard-calls*
580+ (str "(block $done (result " (wt *ret-type*) ") (throw_ref (block $caught (result exnref) "
581+ "(br $done (try_table (result " (wt *ret-type*) ") (catch_all_ref $caught) " call ")))))")
582+ call))
583+
584+(defn note! [k v]
585+ (when *unit-notes* (swap! *unit-notes* update k (fnil conj []) v)))
586+
587+(defn const-kind [v]
588+ (cond (var? v) "var" (vector? v) "vector" (map? v) "map" (set? v) "set" (char? v) "char"
589+ (float? v) "float" (seq? v) "list" (symbol? v) "symbol" :else (str (type v))))
590+
591+(defn phase2-const-wat
592+ "A constant whose value kind is Phase 2's (P1.5): compiles, and throws a
593+ named error if it is ever evaluated, so the census measures Phase 1's
594+ coverage instead of stopping at the first vector literal."
595+ [aux]
596+ (let [k (const-kind aux) m (str "lower-wasm: Phase-2 constant " k)]
597+ (note! :phase2 k)
598+ (str "(throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat m m) ")")))
599+
600+(declare const-global!)
601+
602+;; P2.11 (review2 bug-16, D80): NaNs differ in bits, and the bits are
603+;; observable through hash. Go's ##NaN literal is 0x7FF8000000000001
604+;; (math.NaN), Inf-Inf on this host is the canonical 0x7FF8000000000000, and
605+;; negation flips the sign of either. lg cannot read a float's bits, but its
606+;; hash is a function of them, so each NaN constant is told apart by hash and
607+;; emitted with the exact payload (wasm's bare `nan` is the canonical one).
608+(def nan-spellings
609+ (let [lit ##NaN canon (- ##Inf ##Inf)]
610+ {(hash lit) "nan:0x8000000000001" (hash (- lit)) "-nan:0x8000000000001"
611+ (hash canon) "nan" (hash (- canon)) "-nan"}))
612+
613+(defn f64-lit [x]
614+ (str "(f64.const " (cond (NaN? x) (get nan-spellings (hash x) "nan") (= x ##Inf) "inf" (= x ##-Inf) "-inf" :else (str x)) ")"))
615+
616+(defn float-wat [x] (str "(struct.new $Float " (f64-lit x) ")"))
617+
618+(defn named-text [x] (if (namespace x) (str (namespace x) "/" (name x)) (name x)))
619+
620+(defn kw-wat
621+ "A keyword constant: the interned runtime Kw (one global per keyword,
622+ interned by wasm.str at init) when the runtime is compiled; otherwise an
623+ uninterned Kw of the same layout (the census only validates)."
624+ [kw]
625+ (if *rt*
626+ (str "(global.get " (const-global! kw) ")")
627+ (str "(struct.new $Kw " (if (namespace kw) (bytes-wat (namespace kw)) "(ref.null none)") " "
628+ (bytes-wat (name kw)) " (i64.const 0))")))
629+
630+(def regex-metachars (set ".[]{}()*+?^$|\\"))
631+;; P2.14: an escape that denotes one literal char (Go RE2 syntax): an escaped
632+;; metachar or punctuation, or a control escape. \d \w \s \b \pL \x.. etc.
633+;; are classes or assertions, so a pattern using one stays a named limit.
634+(def regex-literal-escapes
635+ (merge (into {} (for [c ".[]{}()*+?^$|\\/-#&~,:;=<>!@%'\"`"] [c (str c)]))
636+ {\n "\n" \t "\t" \r "\r" \f "\f"}))
637+
638+(defn literal-regex
639+ "The text regex v matches when it matches only itself (no metacharacter,
640+ escapes only of literal chars), else nil."
641+ [v]
642+ (when-let [src (lw-ext/regex-source v)]
643+ (loop [cs (seq src) out ""]
644+ (cond (empty? cs) out
645+ (= \\ (first cs)) (when-let [lit (regex-literal-escapes (second cs))]
646+ (recur (drop 2 cs) (str out lit)))
647+ (contains? regex-metachars (first cs)) nil
648+ :else (recur (rest cs) (str out (first cs)))))))
649+
650+(defn regex-standin
651+ "P2.14: regex v as lw-ext's stand-in (the Symbol it prints as, carrying the
652+ pattern parsed at build time), or nil when v is not a regex or uses
653+ syntax outside the engine's subset (then it stays a Phase-2 constant)."
654+ [v]
655+ (when-let [src (lw-ext/regex-source v)]
656+ (when-let [p (try (lw-ext/regex-parse src) (catch e nil))]
657+ (with-meta (symbol (str v)) {:lw/regex (:ast p) :lw/groups (:groups p) :lw/src src}))))
658+
659+(defn const-box-wat
660+ "A boxed constant of a value kind the runtime owns, or nil."
661+ [v]
662+ (cond (string? v) (str-wat v)
663+ (keyword? v) (kw-wat v)
664+ (char? v) (str "(struct.new $Char (i32.const " (int v) "))")
665+ (float? v) (float-wat v)
666+ ;; P3.2: a regex whose source has no metacharacter is matched as a
667+ ;; plain string (lw-ext/re-find-lit); others stay Phase-2 constants
668+ (and *rt* (literal-regex v)) (str-wat (literal-regex v))
669+ ;; P2.14: other regexes in lw-ext's supported subset (regex-standin)
670+ (and *rt* (regex-standin v)) (str "(global.get " (const-global! (regex-standin v)) ")")
671+ (and *rt* (or (vector? v) (map? v) (set? v) (seq? v) (symbol? v)))
672+ (str "(global.get " (const-global! v) ")")
673+ ;; P2.14: (var x) / #'x, see var-const-form
674+ (and *rt* (var? v)) (str "(global.get " (const-global! v) ")")
675+ :else nil))
676+
677+(defn const-wat [nid aux]
678+ (let [k (ty nid)]
679+ (cond
680+ ;; typeinfer rewrites some consts' aux to [:const <type> <value>]
681+ (typed-aux? aux) (const-wat nid (nth aux 2))
682+ (int? aux) (str "(i64.const " aux ")" (coerce :int k))
683+ (nil? aux) (if (= k :box) "(ref.null none)" (fail "nil const in unboxed slot" {:nid nid :fn *fname*}))
684+ (boolean? aux) (str "(i32.const " (if aux 1 0) ")" (coerce :bool k))
685+ (and (float? aux) (= k :float)) (f64-lit aux)
686+ (const-box-wat aux) (str (const-box-wat aux) (coerce :box k))
687+ :else (phase2-const-wat aux))))
688+
689+(def core-println #'println)
690+
691+;; catch-matches? class symbol -> $rt_catch_matches code. Strict: a class
692+;; outside this table is a compile error, not a clause that never matches.
693+(def catch-classes
694+ {'Throwable 0 'java.lang.Throwable 0
695+ 'Exception 1 'java.lang.Exception 1
696+ 'ExceptionInfo 2 'clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo 2
697+ 'String 3 'java.lang.String 3})
698+
699+(defn exn-call-wat
700+ "throw / ex-info / ex-message / ex-data / catch-matches?; nil for other vars."
701+ [nid v args]
702+ (let [set (fn [expr] (str "(local.set $v" nid " " expr (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")"))
703+ arity (fn [n] (when (not= n (count args))
704+ (fail "unsupported arity" {:var v :argc (count args) :fn *fname*})))]
705+ (condp = v
706+ #'throw (do (arity 1) (str "(throw $lgex " (arg-as (first args) :box) ")"))
707+ #'catch-matches?
708+ (do (arity 2)
709+ (let [c (first args)
710+ code (when (symbol-const? c) (catch-classes (const-val c)))]
711+ (when-not code
712+ (fail "unsupported catch class" {:class (when (symbol-const? c) (const-val c)) :fn *fname*}))
713+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " (call $rt_catch_matches (i32.const " code ") "
714+ (arg-as (second args) :box) ")" (coerce :bool (ty nid)) ")")))
715+ nil)))
716+
717+(def print-fn-msg "lower-wasm: printing a fn value (native prints its heap address)")
718+
719+(defn print-wat [nid]
720+ ;; one value of println's argument list
721+ (case (ty nid)
722+ :int (str "(call $print_i64 " (arg-as nid :int) ")")
723+ :bool (str "(call $rt_print_bool " (lget nid) ")")
724+ (str "(call $rt_print " (arg-as nid :box) ")")))

726+(defn atom-call-wat
727+ "The minimal atom: the `fn` macro expands (fn name [..] ..) to an atom
728+ holding the fn (letfn style), so named fns need atom/deref/reset!; swap!
729+ comes free with fn values. Validators, watches and meta are Phase 2."
730+ [nid v args]
731+ (let [n (count args)
732+ set (fn [e] (str "(local.set $v" nid " " e (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")"))
733+ bx (fn [] (str/join " " (map #(arg-as % :box) args)))]
734+ (condp = v
735+ #'atom (when (= n 1) (set (str "(struct.new $Atom " (bx) ")")))
736+ #'deref (when (= n 1) (set (str "(call $rt_deref " (bx) ")")))
737+ #'reset! (when (= n 2) (set (str "(call $rt_reset " (bx) ")")))
738+ #'swap! (when (<= 2 n 4) (set (str "(call $rt_swap" (- n 2) " " (bx) ")")))
739+ nil)))
740+
741+(defn rest-list-wat
742+ "The rest seq of a variadic call as natively built: a PersistentList of the
743+ leftover args (boxed WAT exprs, in order; counts are static), or nil when
744+ none is left (`(fn [& r] r)` called with no args gets nil)."
745+ [exprs]
746+ (if (empty? exprs)
747+ "(ref.null none)"
748+ (reduce (fn [acc [i e]] (str "(struct.new $List " e " " acc " (i64.const " i ") (ref.null none))"))
749+ "(struct.new $List (ref.null none) (ref.null none) (i64.const 0) (ref.null none))"
750+ (map vector (range 1 (inc (count exprs))) (reverse exprs)))))
751+
752+(defn variadic-params? [params] (boolean (some #{'&} params)))
753+(defn fixed-count
754+ "The number of fixed params of an arity vector (all of them when it has no `&`)."
755+ [params] (count (take-while #(not= '& %) params)))
756+
757+(defn split-rest-pattern
758+ "[params body] with a destructuring rest param ([a & [b c]], [& {:keys
759+ [k]}]) replaced by a gensym bound by a let around the body, as core's fn
760+ macro does: ir.build binds a variadic arity's rest only as a symbol
761+ (P2.12). Anything else comes back unchanged."
762+ [params body]
763+ (let [k (fixed-count params) pat (nth params (inc k) nil)]
764+ (if (or (not (variadic-params? params)) (nil? pat) (symbol? pat))
765+ [params body]
766+ (let [r (gensym "rest__")
767+ binds (if (map? pat)
768+ (let [m (gensym "map__")] [m (list 'seq-to-map-for-destructuring r) pat m])
769+ [pat r])]
770+ [(conj (vec (take k params)) '& r) (list (list* 'let binds body))]))))
771+
772+(defn arity-error-msg
773+ "Native's message for a wrong-arity call of a single-arity fn (the uncaught
774+ form; caught, ex-message adds `ExecutionError: `). The address is a fixed
775+ 0x0: oracle.sh normalises addresses."
776+ [fname declared got]
777+ (str "function <fn " (when fname (str fname " ")) "0x0> expected " declared " args, got " got))
778+
779+(declare callee-sig rt-target)
780+
781+(declare rt-call-expr)
782+
783+(def seq-variant-table
784+ ;; P2.12: natives whose `-seq` form does not take the twin's leading args
785+ ;; as its own (max-seq and cmp-seq lead with a mode), or that have none in
786+ ;; rt/ (map* over several colls: lw-ext/map-n): twin -> [seq fn, fixed
787+ ;; args, boxed WAT exprs passed before them]
788+ {#'wasm.core/max [#'wasm.core/max-seq 0 ["(call $rt_box_bool (i32.const 0))"]]
789+ #'wasm.core/min [#'wasm.core/max-seq 0 ["(call $rt_box_bool (i32.const 1))"]]
790+ #'wasm.core/lt [#'wasm.core/cmp-seq 0 ["(ref.i31 (i32.const 0))"]]
791+ #'wasm.core/le [#'wasm.core/cmp-seq 0 ["(ref.i31 (i32.const 1))"]]
792+ #'wasm.core/gt [#'wasm.core/cmp-seq 0 ["(ref.i31 (i32.const 2))"]]
793+ #'wasm.core/ge [#'wasm.core/cmp-seq 0 ["(ref.i31 (i32.const 3))"]]
794+ #'wasm.seq/map* [#'lw-ext/map-n 1 []]
795+ #'wasm.seq/list [#'lw-ext/list-n 0 []]
796+ ;; P4.1: n-ary dissoc (main.lg's screen exits)
797+ #'wasm.core/dissoc [#'lw-ext/dissoc-n 1 []]})
798+
799+;; natives the backend builds inline when called (coll-ctors) and that have
800+;; no runtime defn to be a value: as values they are lw-ext's variadic fns
801+(def value-substs {#'vector #'lw-ext/vector-v #'hash-map #'lw-ext/hash-map-v #'hash-set #'lw-ext/hash-set-v})
802+
803+(defn seq-adapter
804+ "How a variadic native takes args past its fixed arities: [seq fn, k fixed
805+ args, pre exprs], from seq-variant-table or the runtime's convention (a
806+ public `<name>-seq` taking the leading fixed args, then the rest as one
807+ seq), or nil."
808+ [ent]
809+ (when-let [v (:var ent)]
810+ (or (get seq-variant-table v)
811+ (let [sv (lw-rt/ns-var (symbol (namespace (var-sym v))) (symbol (str (name (var-sym v)) "-seq")))
812+ d (when (and sv (not (:private (meta sv)))) (lw-rt/source-defn sv))
813+ k (when d (count (first (first (:arities d)))))]
814+ (when (and k (= 1 (count (:arities d))) (<= 1 k))
815+ [sv (dec k) []])))))
816+
817+(defn seq-variant
818+ "seq-adapter's [seq fn, k, pre] when argc is past every fixed arity of ent
819+ and covers k, else nil."
820+ [ent argc]
821+ (when-let [[_ k :as a] (seq-adapter ent)]
822+ (when (and (<= k argc) (> argc (apply max -1 (keys (:arities ent)))))
823+ a)))
824+
825+(defn variadic-call
826+ "[sig arg-exprs] for a call of ent through its variadic arity (P2.12: no
827+ fixed arity takes argc and argc covers the fixed args): the fixed args
828+ per the sig, then the leftover args as the rest seq; else nil."
829+ [ent args]
830+ (when-let [vs (:variadic ent)]
831+ (let [k (:fixed vs)]
832+ (when (and (>= (count args) k) (not (get-in ent [:arities (count args)])))
833+ [vs (concat (map arg-as (take k args) (:params vs))
834+ [(str (rest-list-wat (map #(arg-as % :box) (drop k args))) (coerce :box (nth (:params vs) k)))])]))))
835+
836+(defn call-arity-error-msg
837+ "Native's message for a call of ent that no arity takes."
838+ [ent argc]
839+ (cond (:multi? ent) (str "function <mfn " (:base ent) " 0x0> doesn't have a " argc "-arity variant")
840+ (:variadic ent) (str "function <fn " (when (:base ent) (str (:base ent) " ")) "0x0> expected at least "
841+ (:fixed (:variadic ent)) " args, got " argc)
842+ :else (let [[n s] (first (:arities ent))] (arity-error-msg (:base ent) n argc))))
843+
844+(defn note-call-abi!
845+ "Record a call that hands a boxed value to an unboxed param (*abi-notes*)."
846+ [ent args sig]
847+ (when (and *abi-notes* (:var ent)
848+ (some (fn [[a k]] (or (and (not= k :box) (not= k :func) (= :box (ty a)))
849+ (and (= k :int) (= :float (ty a)))))
850+ (map vector args (:params sig))))
851+ (swap! *abi-notes* update :viol (fnil conj #{}) [(:var ent) (count args)])))
852+
853+(defn direct-call-wat
854+ "A call of a defn (program or runtime) by its signature entry."
855+ [nid ent args]
856+ (if-let [sig (get-in ent [:arities (count args)])]
857+ (let [_ (note-call-abi! ent args sig)
858+ call (guard-call (str "(call $" (:name sig) " " (str/join " " (map arg-as args (:params sig))) ")"))]
859+ (if (no-local? nid)
860+ (str "(drop " call ")")
861+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " " call (coerce (:ret sig) (ty nid)) ")")))
862+ (if-let [[vs exprs] (variadic-call ent args)]
863+ (let [call (guard-call (str "(call $" (:name vs) " " (str/join " " exprs) ")"))]
864+ (if (no-local? nid)
865+ (str "(drop " call ")")
866+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " " call (coerce (:ret vs) (ty nid)) ")")))
867+ (if-let [[sv k pre] (seq-variant ent (count args))]
868+ ;; (str a b c d e) -> (str-seq [a b c d e]): past the fixed arities
869+ (let [bx (map #(arg-as % :box) args)
870+ ;; P2.12: the rest as the variadic ABI's PersistentList (it was an
871+ ;; ArrayVector; every -seq form only seqs it, and lw-ext/list-n
872+ ;; returns it as is)
873+ rest-v (let [r (rest-list-wat (drop k bx))]
874+ (if (= r "(ref.null none)") "(struct.new $List (ref.null none) (ref.null none) (i64.const 0) (ref.null none))" r))
875+ call (rt-call-expr sv (concat pre (take k bx) [rest-v]))]
876+ (if (no-local? nid)
877+ (str "(drop " call ")")
878+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " " call (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")")))
879+ ;; native compiles this and fails when the call runs
880+ (let [m (call-arity-error-msg ent (count args))]
881+ (str "(throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat m (str "ExecutionError: " m)) ")"))))))
882+
883+;; Runtime defns the backend lowers as an instruction instead of a call:
884+;; float-bits is the stand-in for f64-bits (D28/D45), i64.reinterpret_f64.
885+;; P2.11 (F6/F7): the runtime's own invoke helpers are a bare call_ref
886+;; through the Fn's code slot: a closure without that arity derefs a null
887+;; (reduce/map twins given a wrong-arity fn trapped uncatchably) and a
888+;; keyword/set/map callable fails the cast. They lower as the backend's
889+;; $rt_invokeN instead, which raises native's arity error for an empty slot
890+;; and calls a non-Fn callable through wasm.core/invoke-args.
891+(defn- rt-invoke-override [n]
892+ (fn [nid args]
893+ (let [call (str "(call $rt_invoke" n (apply str (map #(str " " (arg-as % :box)) args)) ")")]
894+ (if (no-local? nid)
895+ (str "(drop " call ")")
896+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " " call (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")")))))
897+
898+(def rt-overrides
899+ {#'wasm.seq/float-bits
900+ (fn [nid args]
901+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " (i64.reinterpret_f64 " (f64-arg (first args)) ")" (coerce :int (ty nid)) ")"))
902+ #'wasm.seq/invoke0 (rt-invoke-override 0)
903+ #'wasm.seq/invoke1 (rt-invoke-override 1)
904+ #'wasm.seq/invoke2 (rt-invoke-override 2)
905+ #'wasm.core/invoke3 (rt-invoke-override 3)
906+ #'wasm.core/invoke4 (rt-invoke-override 4)
907+ ;; P2.12: the runtime's own dispatch stops at 4 args and knows no
908+ ;; variadic slot; these two reach $rt_invokeN's and spread any count
909+ #'wasm.core/invoke-args
910+ (fn [nid [f n & xs]]
911+ (let [call (str "(call $rt_invoke_args " (arg-as f :box) " " (arg-as n :int)
912+ (apply str (map #(str " " (arg-as % :box)) xs)) ")")]
913+ (if (no-local? nid) (str "(drop " call ")") (str "(local.set $v" nid " " call (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")"))))
914+ #'wasm.core/invoke-vec
915+ (fn [nid [f v]]
916+ (let [call (str "(call $rt_apply_vec " (arg-as f :box) " " (arg-as v :box) ")")]
917+ (if (no-local? nid) (str "(drop " call ")") (str "(local.set $v" nid " " call (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")"))))})
918+
919+(defn rt-call-expr
920+ "A boxed-result call of runtime defn v on boxed operand exprs."
921+ [v box-exprs]
922+ (let [s (get-in (callee-sig v) [:arities (count box-exprs)])]
923+ (when-not s (fail "runtime call arity" {:var v :argc (count box-exprs) :fn *fname*}))
924+ (str "(call $" (:name s) (apply str (map (fn [e k] (str " " e (coerce :box k))) box-exprs (:params s))) ")"
925+ (coerce (:ret s) :box))))
926+
927+;; Collection literals with non-constant elements: ir.build calls these core
928+;; fns; they build through the runtime's constructors (constant literals are
929+;; globals, const-global!).
930+(def coll-ctors
931+ ;; a literal or `vector` is an ArrayVector at any size, while conj promotes
932+ ;; past 32 (D79): the chain is retagged at the end
933+ {#'vector (fn [xs] (rt-call-expr #'wasm.pvec/varray
934+ [(reduce (fn [acc x] (rt-call-expr #'wasm.pvec/vconj [acc x]))
935+ (rt-call-expr #'wasm.pvec/empty-vec []) xs)]))
936+ #'hash-set (fn [xs] (reduce (fn [acc x] (rt-call-expr #'wasm.phs/sconj [acc x]))
937+ (rt-call-expr #'wasm.phs/empty-set []) xs))
938+ #'array-map (fn [xs] (reduce (fn [acc [k x]] (rt-call-expr #'wasm.core/assoc [acc k x]))
939+ (rt-call-expr #'wasm.phm/empty-map []) (partition 2 xs)))
940+ #'hash-map (fn [xs] (reduce (fn [acc [k x]] (rt-call-expr #'wasm.core/assoc [acc k x]))
941+ (rt-call-expr #'wasm.phm/empty-map []) (partition 2 xs)))})
942+
943+(defn neg-wat
944+ "lower-wasm/neg: NumNeg. An int wraps ((- MinInt64) = MinInt64, D16), a
945+ float is Go's -x (f64.neg: the sign flips, NaN included), anything else
946+ goes to the runtime's 1-arity `-` (wasm.core/sub), which raises native's
947+ message for a non-number."
948+ [nid [x]]
949+ (let [set (fn [e k] (str "(local.set $v" nid " " e (coerce k (ty nid)) ")"))]
950+ (case (ty x)
951+ :int (set (str "(i64.sub (i64.const 0) " (arg-as x :int) ")") :int)
952+ :float (set (str "(f64.neg " (arg-as x :float) ")") :float)
953+ (if *rt*
954+ (set (rt-call-expr #'wasm.core/sub [(arg-as x :box)]) :box)
955+ (set (str "(i64.sub (i64.const 0) (call $rt_int_sub " (arg-as x :box) "))") :int)))))
956+
957+(defn push-out!
958+ "Stand-in for (push-binding! #'*out* h) in lowered code (P3.2,
959+ binding-out); never called natively."
960+ [h] nil)
961+(defn pop-out! "Stand-in for (pop-binding! #'*out*)." [] nil)
962+(defn push-var! "Stand-in for (push-binding! #'v x); k names v." [k x] nil)
963+(defn pop-var! "Stand-in for (pop-binding! #'v)." [k] nil)
964+
965+(declare print->rt)
966+
967+(defn binding-out
968+ "P3.2: (binding [*out* h] ..) expands to push-binding!/pop-binding! of
969+ (var *out*); a var constant would be a Phase-2 value (and a capture in the
970+ finally region), so the expanded form is rewritten to push-out!/pop-out!,
971+ which the backend lowers onto a stack of output fds that host-write's fd 1
972+ follows. Binding any other dynamic var is refused by name."
973+ [form]
974+ (cond
975+ (vector? form) (mapv binding-out form)
976+ (map? form) (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(binding-out k) (binding-out v)]) form))
977+ (not (seq? form)) form
978+ (= 'quote (first form)) form
979+ (and (symbol? (first form)) (#{#'push-binding! #'pop-binding!} (try (resolve (first form)) (catch e nil))))
980+ (let [[_ vf & more] form
981+ vr (when (and (seq? vf) (= 'var (first vf))) (try (resolve (second vf)) (catch e nil)))]
982+ (when-not (var? vr)
983+ (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: binding of " (pr-str vf) " is not supported") {})))
984+ ;; never in tail position: a tail call skips call-wat's intercept.
985+ ;; Any other var is a var-table var (checked at lowering): binding
986+ ;; saves its global on a stack and restores it in the finally, which is
987+ ;; exact for a single-threaded program (no binding conveyance)
988+ (let [push? (= #'push-binding! (resolve (first form)))
989+ k (keyword (namespace (symbol vr)) (name (symbol vr)))]
990+ (cond (and push? (= vr #'*out*)) (list 'do (list 'lower-wasm/push-out! (binding-out (first more))) nil)
991+ (= vr #'*out*) (list 'do (list 'lower-wasm/pop-out!) nil)
992+ push? (list 'do (list 'lower-wasm/push-var! k (binding-out (first more))) nil)
993+ :else (list 'do (list 'lower-wasm/pop-var! k) nil))))
994+ ;; the binding's body: the backend's own println (env.print_*) knows no
995+ ;; fds, so a print call written inside it goes through the runtime's
996+ ;; twin, which writes with host-write (named limit: one in a fn called
997+ ;; from the body still prints to stdout)
998+ (and (= 'do (first form)) (seq? (second form)) (symbol? (first (second form)))
999+ (= #'push-binding! (try (resolve (first (second form))) (catch e nil))))
1000+ (apply list 'do (binding-out (second form)) (map #(binding-out (print->rt %)) (drop 2 form)))
1001+ :else (apply list (map binding-out form))))
1002+
1003+(def print-twins {#'println 'wasm.host/println #'print 'wasm.host/print #'prn 'wasm.host/prn #'pr 'wasm.host/pr})
1004+
1005+(defn print->rt [form]
1006+ (cond (vector? form) (mapv print->rt form)
1007+ (map? form) (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(print->rt k) (print->rt v)]) form))
1008+ (symbol? form) (or (print-twins (try (resolve form) (catch e nil))) form)
1009+ (not (seq? form)) form
1010+ (= 'quote (first form)) form
1011+ :else (apply list (map print->rt form))))
1012+
1013+(defn binding-call-wat [nid v args]
1014+ (let [bound-global
1015+ (fn []
1016+ (let [k (const-val (first args))
1017+ vr (when (keyword? k) (try (resolve (symbol (namespace k) (name k))) (catch e nil)))
1018+ g (when vr (var-global vr))]
1019+ (or g (fail (str "lower-wasm: binding of " (namespace k) "/" (name k)
1020+ " is not supported (not a var-table var)") {:var vr :fn *fname*}))))]
1021+ (str (condp = v
1022+ #'push-out! (str "(call $rt_push_out " (arg-as (first args) :box) ")")
1023+ #'pop-out! "(call $rt_pop_out)"
1024+ #'push-var! (let [g (bound-global)]
1025+ (str "(global.set $bind_stack (struct.new $List (global.get " g ") (global.get $bind_stack) (i64.const 1) (ref.null none)))"
1026+ " (global.set " g " " (arg-as (second args) :box) ")"))
1027+ #'pop-var! (let [g (bound-global)]
1028+ (str "(global.set " g " (struct.get $List 0 (ref.cast (ref $List) (global.get $bind_stack))))"
1029+ " (global.set $bind_stack (struct.get $List 1 (ref.cast (ref $List) (global.get $bind_stack))))")))
1030+ " (local.set $v" nid " (ref.null none)" (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")")))
1031+
1032+(defn call-wat [nid v args]
1033+ (let [ent (get @*sigs* v)]
1034+ (cond
1035+ (and (= v #'neg) (= 1 (count args))) (neg-wat nid args)
1036+ (and *rt* (rt-overrides v)) ((rt-overrides v) nid args)
1037+ ent (direct-call-wat nid ent args)
1038+ (exn-call-wat nid v args) (exn-call-wat nid v args)
1039+ (#{#'push-out! #'pop-out! #'push-var! #'pop-var!} v) (binding-call-wat nid v args)
1040+ (atom-call-wat nid v args) (atom-call-wat nid v args)
1041+ (= v core-println)
1042+ (str (str/join " (call $rt_print_space) " (map print-wat args))
1043+ " (call $print_nl)"
1044+ (if (= (ty nid) :box)
1045+ (str " (local.set $v" nid " (ref.null none))")
1046+ (fail "println result in unboxed slot" {:nid nid :fn *fname*})))
1047+ (and *rt* (coll-ctors v) (or (not (#{#'array-map #'hash-map} v)) (even? (count args))))
1048+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " " ((coll-ctors v) (map #(arg-as % :box) args)) (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")")
1049+ ;; a runtime defn, a native the runtime twins (D58), or an lg core fn
1050+ (and *rt* (rt-target v) (callee-sig v)) (direct-call-wat nid (callee-sig v) args)
1051+ ;; a var with no wasm definition: call through its (nil) var-table slot
1052+ (<= (count args) max-invoke)
1053+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " (call $rt_invoke" (invoke-n! (count args)) " (global.get " (extern-global v) ")"
1054+ (apply str (map #(str " " (arg-as % :box)) args)) ")" (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")")
1055+ ;; no $Fn arity slot past 4 (D52); the slot is nil anyway, so evaluate
1056+ ;; the args and fail exactly as the invoke would
1057+ :else
1058+ (str (apply str (map #(str "(drop " (arg-as % :box) ") ") args))
1059+ "(call $rt_not_fn (global.get " (extern-global v) ")) unreachable"))))
1060+
1061+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1062+;; Intrinsics (P2.1, D24). A :call whose callee is a wasm.intrinsics var is
1063+;; emitted inline. Operands and results are lg kinds (:int i64, :bool i32,
1064+;; :box (ref null eq), plus :func for funcrefs); i32/i8 storage is wrapped and
1065+;; extended inside the expansion. Decl operands are vars resolved statically
1066+;; through lw-rt's one rec group. Indices are wrapped to i32 with
1067+;; i32.wrap_i64 and not range-checked in i64 (D26, decided here: wasm's own
1068+;; bounds check runs on the wrapped index, so an index >= 2^32 can alias;
1069+;; the reference impl traps on it and the runtime never produces one).
1070+
1071+(def funcref-fields
1072+ ;; D52: $Fn's code slots are typed code refs; every other :funcref slot is funcref
1073+ {"$Fn" {0 "$Code0" 1 "$Code1" 2 "$Code2" 4 "$Code3" 5 "$Code4"}})
1074+
1075+(defn decl-arg
1076+ "[type-name decl] of an intrinsic's declaration operand."
1077+ [nid who]
1078+ (let [v (var-of nid) tn (when v (decl-type-name v))]
1079+ (when-not tn (fail "intrinsic needs a declaration var" {:intrinsic who :nid nid :fn *fname*}))
1080+ [tn @v]))
1081+
1082+(defn const-int-arg [nid who]
1083+ (let [r (src-of nid) a (when (= :const (ir/op r *f*)) (const-val nid))]
1084+ (when-not (int? a) (fail "intrinsic needs a literal int" {:intrinsic who :nid nid :fn *fname*}))
1085+ a))
1086+
1087+(defn field-type [decl idx] (:type (nth (:fields decl) idx)))
1088+
1089+(defn f64-arg [nid]
1090+ (if (#{:box :float} (ty nid))
1091+ (arg-as nid :float)
1092+ (fail "f64 operand that is not a float" {:nid nid :kind (ty nid) :fn *fname*})))
1093+
1094+(defn store-wat
1095+ "Operand nid as storage of slot type t (typed: the code-ref type of a typed funcref slot)."
1096+ [t nid typed]
1097+ (case t
1098+ :i64 (arg-as nid :int)
1099+ (:i32 :i8) (str "(i32.wrap_i64 " (arg-as nid :int) ")")
1100+ :f64 (f64-arg nid)
1101+ :ref (arg-as nid :box)
1102+ :funcref (if typed
1103+ (if (nullish? nid) (arg-as nid :func) (str "(ref.cast (ref null " typed ") " (arg-as nid :func) ")"))
1104+ (arg-as nid :func))))

1106+(defn load-wat
1107+ "[expr raw-kind] for a slot of type t read by expr."
1108+ [t expr]
1109+ (case t
1110+ :i64 [expr :int]
1111+ :i32 [(str "(i64.extend_i32_s " expr ")") :int]
1112+ :i8 [(str "(i64.extend_i32_u " expr ")") :int]
1113+ :f64 [expr :float]
1114+ :ref [expr :box]
1115+ :funcref [expr :func]))

1117+(defn wrap-idx [nid] (str "(i32.wrap_i64 " (arg-as nid :int) ")"))
1118+(defn cast-ref [tn nid] (str "(ref.cast (ref " tn ") " (arg-as nid :box) ")"))

1122+(defn misuse
1123+ "An intrinsic applied in a way the reference rejects at run time (a field
1124+ index out of range, a wrong operand count, set! of an immutable field):
1125+ the same catchable error when it runs, not a compile failure."
1126+ [msg] [(str "(throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat msg msg) ")") :bottom])

1128+(defn emit-intrinsic
1129+ "[expr raw-kind] for intrinsic `nm` applied to arg nids. raw-kind :void
1130+ means no value, :bottom never returns."
1131+ [nm args]
1132+ (let [a (vec args)
1133+ decl-name (fn [d] (str (:name d)))
1134+ bin (fn [op k] [(str "(" op " " (arg-as (a 0) :int) " " (arg-as (a 1) :int) ")") k])
1135+ un (fn [op] [(str "(" op " " (arg-as (a 0) :int) ")") :int])]
1136+ (case nm
1137+ "new" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm) fs (:fields d)]
1138+ (if-not (= (count fs) (dec (count a)))
1139+ (misuse (str "wasm/new " (decl-name d) ": " (count fs) " fields, got " (dec (count a))))
1140+ [(str "(struct.new " tn
1141+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i f] (str " " (store-wat (:type f) (a (inc i)) (get-in funcref-fields [tn i]))))
1142+ fs)) ")") :box]))
1143+ "get" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm) i (const-int-arg (a 1) nm) n (count (:fields d))]
1144+ (if (< -1 i n)
1145+ (load-wat (field-type d i) (str "(struct.get " tn " " i " " (cast-ref tn (a 2)) ")"))
1146+ (misuse (str "wasm/get " (decl-name d) ": field index " i " out of range 0.." (dec n)))))
1147+ "set!" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm) i (const-int-arg (a 1) nm) n (count (:fields d))]
1148+ (cond (not (< -1 i n)) (misuse (str "wasm/set! " (decl-name d) ": field index " i " out of range 0.." (dec n)))
1149+ (not (:mut (nth (:fields d) i))) (misuse (str "wasm/set! " (decl-name d) ": field " i " is immutable"))
1150+ :else [(str "(struct.set " tn " " i " " (cast-ref tn (a 2)) " "
1151+ (store-wat (field-type d i) (a 3) (get-in funcref-fields [tn i])) ")") :void]))
1152+ "is?" (let [[tn] (decl-arg (a 0) nm)] [(str "(ref.test (ref " tn ") " (arg-as (a 1) :box) ")") :bool])
1153+ "as" (let [[tn] (decl-arg (a 0) nm)] [(cast-ref tn (a 1)) :box])
1154+ "array-new" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm)]
1155+ [(str "(array.new " tn " " (store-wat (:elem d) (a 2) nil) " " (wrap-idx (a 1)) ")") :box])
1156+ "aget" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm)]
1157+ (load-wat (:elem d) (str "(array.get" (when (= :i8 (:elem d)) "_u") " " tn " " (cast-ref tn (a 1)) " "
1158+ (wrap-idx (a 2)) ")")))
1159+ "aset!" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm)]
1160+ [(str "(array.set " tn " " (cast-ref tn (a 1)) " " (wrap-idx (a 2)) " " (store-wat (:elem d) (a 3) nil) ")") :void])
1161+ "alen" [(str "(i64.extend_i32_u (array.len (ref.cast (ref array) " (arg-as (a 0) :box) ")))") :int]
1162+ "array-copy" (let [[tn] (decl-arg (a 0) nm)]
1163+ [(str "(array.copy " tn " " tn " " (cast-ref tn (a 1)) " " (wrap-idx (a 2)) " "
1164+ (cast-ref tn (a 3)) " " (wrap-idx (a 4)) " " (wrap-idx (a 5)) ")") :void])
1165+ "ref-eq" [(str "(ref.eq " (arg-as (a 0) :box) " " (arg-as (a 1) :box) ")") :bool]
1166+ "null" ["(ref.null none)" :box]
1167+ "null?" [(str "(ref.is_null " (arg-as (a 0) (if (= :func (ty (a 0))) :func :box)) ")") :bool]
1168+ "i31" [(str "(ref.i31 (i32.wrap_i64 " (arg-as (a 0) :int) "))") :box]
1169+ "i31?" [(str "(ref.test (ref i31) " (arg-as (a 0) :box) ")") :bool]
1170+ "i31-get" [(str "(i64.extend_i32_s (i31.get_s (ref.cast (ref i31) " (arg-as (a 0) :box) ")))") :int]
1171+ "i64-add" (bin "i64.add" :int)
1172+ "i64-sub" (bin "i64.sub" :int)
1173+ "i64-mul" (bin "i64.mul" :int)
1174+ "i64-shl" (bin "i64.shl" :int)
1175+ "i64-shr-s" (bin "i64.shr_s" :int)
1176+ "i64-shr-u" (bin "i64.shr_u" :int)
1177+ "i64-lt-u" (bin "i64.lt_u" :bool)
1178+ "i64-clz" (un "i64.clz")
1179+ "i64-ctz" (un "i64.ctz")
1180+ "i64-popcnt" (un "i64.popcnt")
1181+ "i32-wrap" [(str "(i64.extend_i32_s (i32.wrap_i64 " (arg-as (a 0) :int) "))") :int]
1182+ "i64-extend-i32-u" [(str "(i64.extend_i32_u (i32.wrap_i64 " (arg-as (a 0) :int) "))") :int]
1183+ "i64-to-f64" [(str "(f64.convert_i64_s " (arg-as (a 0) :int) ")") :float]
1184+ "f64-to-i64" [(str "(i64.trunc_f64_s " (f64-arg (a 0)) ")") :int]
1185+ "f64-neg" [(str "(f64.neg " (f64-arg (a 0)) ")") :float]
1186+ "f64-bits" [(str "(i64.reinterpret_f64 " (f64-arg (a 0)) ")") :int]
1187+ "bytes-new" [(str "(array.new_default $Bytes " (wrap-idx (a 0)) ")") :box]
1188+ "bget" [(str "(i64.extend_i32_u (array.get_u $Bytes " (cast-ref "$Bytes" (a 0)) " " (wrap-idx (a 1)) "))") :int]
1189+ "bset!" [(str "(array.set $Bytes " (cast-ref "$Bytes" (a 0)) " " (wrap-idx (a 1)) " " (wrap-idx (a 2)) ")") :void]
1190+ ;; the runtime only passes literals (D27); a program may pass any
1191+ ;; string, whose Str bytes are copied (the reference returns fresh bytes)
1192+ "bytes-of-string" (if (string-const? (a 0))
1193+ [(bytes-wat (const-val (a 0))) :box]
1194+ [(str "(call $rt_bytes_copy (call $rt_bytes_of (struct.get $Str 0 " (cast-ref "$Str" (a 0)) ")))") :box])
1195+ ;; the boundary helper: in wasm the bytes already are the string (D5);
1196+ ;; as an lg value a string is the Str box
1197+ "string-of-bytes" [(str "(struct.new $Str " (arg-as (a 0) :box) " (i64.const -1))") :box]
1198+ "host-write" [(str "(i64.extend_i32_s (call $rt_host_write (call $rt_out_fd (i32.wrap_i64 " (arg-as (a 0) :int) ")) "
1199+ (cast-ref "$Bytes" (a 1)) "))") :int]
1200+ "host-sleep" [(str "(call $host_sleep " (arg-as (a 0) :int) ")") :void]
1201+ "host-nanotime" ["(call $host_nanotime)" :int]
1202+ ;; the reference's *host-env* is {} (deterministic, D27): every name is unset
1203+ "host-getenv" [(str "(block (result (ref null eq)) (drop " (arg-as (a 0) :box) ") (ref.null none))") :box]
1204+ ;; D97: the term host intrinsics (rt/wasm/term.lg, host/ABI.md)
1205+ "term-read-key" ["(call $rt_term_read_key)" :box]
1206+ "term-key-pending" ["(call $term.key_pending)" :bool]
1207+ "term-size" ["(call $rt_term_size)" :int]
1208+ ;; D100: js/emit and js/url-param's host imports (P4.1-backend)
1209+ "host-emit" [(str "(call $rt_host_emit " (cast-ref "$Bytes" (a 0)) " " (cast-ref "$Bytes" (a 1)) ")") :void]
1210+ "host-url-param" [(str "(call $rt_host_url_param " (cast-ref "$Bytes" (a 0)) ")") :box]
1211+ ;; P2.14: with-out-str (lw-ext/with-out-str-v)
1212+ "capture-begin" ["(call $rt_capture_begin)" :void]
1213+ "capture-end" ["(call $rt_capture_end)" :box]
1214+ "trap" (if (string-const? (a 0))
1215+ [(str "(call $rt_trap " (bytes-wat (const-val (a 0))) ")") :bottom]
1216+ (fail "wasm/trap needs a string literal" {:nid (a 0) :fn *fname*}))
1217+ ;; a funcref names a defn: an fn* literal has no function of its own
1218+ ;; to refer to (and a capture would have nowhere to live)
1219+ "funcref" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm) fv (var-of (a 1))]

1221+ [(str "(ref.func $" (funcref-wrapper tn d fv) ")") :func]
1222+ (misuse "lower-wasm: wasm/funcref of a fn value, not a defn var")))
1223+ "call-ref" (let [[tn d] (decl-arg (a 0) nm) ps (:params d)]
1224+ (if-not (= (count ps) (- (count a) 2))
1225+ (misuse (str "wasm/call-ref " (decl-name d) ": " (count ps) " params, got " (- (count a) 2)))
1226+ (load-wat (:result d)
1227+ (str "(call_ref " tn
1228+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i t] (str " " (store-wat t (a (+ 2 i)) nil))) ps))
1229+ " (ref.cast (ref null " tn ") " (arg-as (a 1) :func) "))"))))
1230+ (fail "unknown intrinsic" {:intrinsic nm :fn *fname*}))))

1232+(def emitted-intrinsics
1233+ #{"new" "get" "set!" "is?" "as" "array-new" "aget" "aset!" "alen" "array-copy" "ref-eq" "null" "null?"
1234+ "i31" "i31?" "i31-get" "i64-add" "i64-sub" "i64-mul" "i64-shl" "i64-shr-s" "i64-shr-u" "i64-lt-u"
1235+ "i64-clz" "i64-ctz" "i64-popcnt" "i32-wrap" "i64-extend-i32-u" "i64-to-f64" "f64-to-i64" "f64-bits" "f64-neg"
1236+ "bytes-new" "bget" "bset!" "bytes-of-string" "string-of-bytes" "host-write" "host-sleep"
1237+ "host-nanotime" "host-getenv" "trap" "funcref" "call-ref"
1238+ "term-read-key" "term-key-pending" "term-size" "host-emit" "host-url-param"
1239+ "capture-begin" "capture-end"})

1241+;; every ^:intrinsic var has an emitter: a new intrinsic fails the backend's
1242+;; load, not a program's compile (D24: the set is read from the metadata)
1243+(let [missing (for [v (lw-rt/intrinsic-vars)
1244+ :let [s (name (symbol v))]
1245+ :when (not (contains? emitted-intrinsics s))]
1246+ (symbol v))]
1247+ (when (seq missing)
1248+ (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: intrinsics without an emitter: " (vec (sort missing))) {}))))

1250+(defn intrinsic-call-wat [nid v args]
1251+ (let [[expr raw] (emit-intrinsic (name (symbol v)) args)
1252+ has-local (not (no-local? nid))]
1253+ (case raw
1254+ :void (str expr (when has-local (str " (local.set $v" nid " " (if (= :box (ty nid)) "(ref.null none)"
1255+ (fail "void intrinsic in unboxed slot" {:nid nid :fn *fname*})) ")")))
1256+ :bottom (str expr " unreachable")
1257+ (if has-local
1258+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " " expr (coerce raw (ty nid)) ")")
1259+ (str "(drop " expr ")")))))

1261+(defn slot-lattice [t] (cond (#{:i64 :i32 :i8} t) :int (= :f64 t) :float :else nil))
1262+
1263+(defn intrinsic-type
1264+ "The typeinfer type of an intrinsic call (from its :type metadata), or nil."
1265+ [v args]
1266+ (let [r (str/trim (last (str/split (:type (meta v)) #"->")))
1267+ decl (fn [] (let [x (var-of (first args))] (when (and x (decl-type-name x)) @x)))]
1268+ (case r
1269+ ":int" :int
1270+ ":bool" :bool
1271+ ":float" :float
1272+ ":nil" :nil
1273+ "field type" (let [d (decl) i (const-val (second args))]
1274+ (when (and d (int? i) (< -1 i (count (:fields d)))) (slot-lattice (field-type d i))))
1275+ "T" (when-let [d (decl)] (slot-lattice (:elem d)))
1276+ "result" (when-let [d (decl)] (slot-lattice (:result d)))
1277+ nil)))

1279+(defn int-const-of [nid]
1280+ (when (and (= :const (ir/op (src-of nid) *f*)) (int? (const-val nid))) (const-val nid)))

1282+(def float-binops {:add "f64.add" :sub "f64.sub" :mul "f64.mul" :div "f64.div"})
1283+(def float-cmps {:lt "f64.lt" :lte "f64.le" :gt "f64.gt" :gte "f64.ge"})
1284+;; the runtime's numeric twins: boxed operands that are not both ints
1285+(def num-twins {:add #'wasm.core/add :sub #'wasm.core/sub :mul #'wasm.core/mul
1286+ :lt #'wasm.core/lt :lte #'wasm.core/le :gt #'wasm.core/gt :gte #'wasm.core/ge})
