1288+(defn prim-wat
1289+ "Arithmetic/compare op `op` over value ids `refs`, result into local nid;
1290+ nil when op is not one of these."
1291+ [nid op refs]
1292+ (let [set (fn [expr] (str "(local.set $v" nid " " expr ")"))
1293+ all-int? (every? #(= (ty %) :int) refs)
1294+ some-float? (some #(= (ty %) :float) refs)
1295+ numeric? (every? #(#{:int :float :box} (ty %)) refs)]
1296+ (cond
1297+ ;; float arithmetic: a float-typed operand makes the op f64 (an int or
1298+ ;; a boxed number operand converts); Go float semantics, no checks
1299+ (and some-float? numeric? (float-binops op) (= 2 (count refs)))
1300+ (set (str "(" (float-binops op) " " (arg-as (first refs) :float) " " (arg-as (second refs) :float) ")"
1301+ (coerce :float (ty nid))))
1302+ (and some-float? numeric? (float-cmps op) (= 2 (count refs)))
1303+ (set (str "(" (float-cmps op) " " (arg-as (first refs) :float) " " (arg-as (second refs) :float) ")"
1304+ (coerce :bool (ty nid))))
1305+ (and (= op :eq) (= 2 (count refs)) (every? #(= (ty %) :float) refs))
1306+ (set (str "(f64.eq " (arg-as (first refs) :float) " " (arg-as (second refs) :float) ")" (coerce :bool (ty nid))))
1307+ (and (= :float (ty (first refs))) (= 1 (count refs)) (#{:zero? :pos? :neg? :inc :dec} op))
1308+ (let [x (arg-as (first refs) :float)]
1309+ (set (case op
1310+ :zero? (str "(f64.eq " x " (f64.const 0))" (coerce :bool (ty nid)))
1311+ :pos? (str "(f64.gt " x " (f64.const 0))" (coerce :bool (ty nid)))
1312+ :neg? (str "(f64.lt " x " (f64.const 0))" (coerce :bool (ty nid)))
1313+ :inc (str "(f64.add " x " (f64.const 1))" (coerce :float (ty nid)))
1314+ :dec (str "(f64.sub " x " (f64.const 1))" (coerce :float (ty nid))))))
1315+ ;; a comparison with a boxed operand: ints compare inline in the helper,
1316+ ;; anything else goes to the runtime's numeric twin (wasm.core/lt ...)
1317+ (and *rt* (cmp-ops op) (not= op :eq) (= 2 (count refs)) (some #(= (ty %) :box) refs))
1318+ (set (str "(call $rt_cmp_" (name op) " " (arg-as (first refs) :box) " " (arg-as (second refs) :box) ")"
1319+ (coerce :bool (ty nid))))
1320+ (and (int-binops op) (= 2 (count refs)) all-int?)
1321+ ;; an int constant operand goes in as a literal, so the overflow test
1322+ ;; can specialise on it (const-check)
1323+ (let [opnd (fn [r] (if-let [c (int-const-of r)] (str "(i64.const " c ")") (arg-as r :int)))]
1324+ (int-arith nid op (opnd (first refs)) (opnd (second refs))))
1325+ (and (int-binops op) (= 2 (count refs)))
1326+ (set (str "(call $rt_" (name op) " " (arg-as (first refs) :box) " " (arg-as (second refs) :box) ")"
1327+ (coerce :box (ty nid))))
1328+ ;; boxed operands go through the checked unbox: a non-int throws a named
1329+ ;; error (the general numeric tower is Phase 2)
1330+ ;; = on anything but two ints: two bools compare as i32, everything
1331+ ;; else is the runtime's generic equality (seq.lg equiv?, D38)
1332+ (and (= op :eq) (= 2 (count refs)) (every? #(= (ty %) :bool) refs))
1333+ (set (str "(i32.eq " (arg-as (first refs) :bool) " " (arg-as (second refs) :bool) ")" (coerce :bool (ty nid))))
1334+ (and (= op :eq) (= 2 (count refs)) *rt* (not all-int?))
1335+ (direct-call-wat nid (callee-sig #'wasm.seq/equiv?) refs)
1336+ (and (cmp-ops op) (= 2 (count refs)))
1337+ (set (str "(" (cmp-ops op) " " (op-int-arg op (first refs)) " " (op-int-arg op (second refs)) ")"
1338+ (coerce :bool (ty nid))))
1339+ (and (#{:inc :dec} op) (= 1 (count refs)))
1340+ (int-arith nid (if (= op :inc) :add :sub) (op-int-arg op (first refs)) "(i64.const 1)")
1341+ ;; P2.14: a boxed operand of a sign predicate may be a Float (quality
1342+ ;; terms' (pos? (+ v k))): compare it with 0 through the runtime's
1343+ ;; numeric comparison, as the binary ops do; zero? is <= and >= so a
1344+ ;; NaN is not zero
1345+ (and *rt* (#{:zero? :pos? :neg?} op) (= 1 (count refs)) (= :box (ty (first refs))))
1346+ (let [x (arg-as (first refs) :box) z "(ref.i31 (i32.const 0))"]
1347+ (set (str (case op
1348+ :pos? (str "(call $rt_cmp_gt " x " " z ")")
1349+ :neg? (str "(call $rt_cmp_lt " x " " z ")")
1350+ (str "(i32.and (call $rt_cmp_lte " x " " z ") (call $rt_cmp_gte " x " " z "))"))
1351+ (coerce :bool (ty nid)))))
1352+ ;; int sign predicates (P1.3: closures.lg's mutual recursion uses zero?)
1353+ (and (#{:zero? :pos? :neg?} op) (= 1 (count refs)))
1354+ (set (str "(" ({:zero? "i64.eq" :pos? "i64.gt_s" :neg? "i64.lt_s"} op) " "
1355+ (op-int-arg op (first refs)) " (i64.const 0))" (coerce :bool (ty nid))))
1356+ (and (= op :bit-not) (= 1 (count refs)))
1357+ (set (str "(i64.xor " (op-int-arg op (first refs)) " (i64.const -1))" (coerce :int (ty nid))))
1358+ (and (int-ops op) (= 2 (count refs)))
1359+ ;; a boxed operand's unbox is a call: stage it so int-op-wat may repeat it
1360+ (let [stage (fn [r l] (if (= (ty r) :box)
1361+ [(str "(local.set " l " " (op-int-arg op r) ")") (str "(local.get " l ")")]
1362+ [nil (arg-as r :int)]))
1363+ [sa a] (stage (first refs) "$ta")
1364+ [sb b] (stage (second refs) "$tb")
1365+ [pre expr] (int-op-wat op a b)]
1366+ (str/join " " (remove nil? [sa sb pre (set (str expr (coerce :int (ty nid))))])))
1367+ :else nil)))

1369+;; Macroexpansion leaves namespace-qualified heads (dotimes -> core/<,
1370+;; core/inc), which ir.build deliberately keeps as var calls. Calls to these
1371+;; core vars lower like the matching IR op. `=` is left out: it is only i64.eq
1372+;; on two ints, and nothing at P1.0 needs it.
1373+(def core-var-ops {#'< :lt #'<= :lte #'> :gt #'>= :gte
1374+ #'+ :add #'- :sub #'* :mul #'inc :inc #'dec :dec
1375+ #'zero? :zero? #'pos? :pos? #'neg? :neg?})

1379+(defn div-wat
1380+ "`/` on two ints when the quotient is exact (native returns an Int then);
1381+ a ratio, the MinInt64/-1 bigint and float operands are Phase 2 (D15) and
1382+ throw a named error at run time. Divide by zero is native's message."
1383+ [nid refs]
1384+ (let [m "lower-wasm: / with a ratio or bigint result (Phase 2)"
1385+ stage (fn [r l] (str "(local.set " l " " (op-int-arg :div r) ")"))]
1386+ (str (stage (first refs) "$ta") " " (stage (second refs) "$tb") " "
1387+ "(if (i64.eqz (local.get $tb)) (then (throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat "divide by zero" "divide by zero") "))) "
1388+ "(if (i32.or (i32.and (i64.eq (local.get $ta) (i64.const -9223372036854775808)) (i64.eq (local.get $tb) (i64.const -1))) "
1389+ "(i64.ne (i64.rem_s (local.get $ta) (local.get $tb)) (i64.const 0))) "
1390+ "(then (throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat m m) "))) "
1391+ "(local.set $v" nid " (i64.div_s (local.get $ta) (local.get $tb))" (coerce :int (ty nid)) ")")))

1393+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1394+;; Fn values (D36). A closure is
1395+;; (struct.new $Fn code0 code1 code2 env code3 code4 info)
1396+;; where codeK is (ref.func $<fn>__fn<nid>_K) of type $CodeK or null, env is a
1397+;; per-closure struct of the captures (typed: an int capture stays i64) or
1398+;; null, and info is a static $FnInfo global. Code takes the closure itself
1399+;; first and its args boxed, and returns boxed (D37). A closure without
1400+;; captures is one immutable global.

1402+(defn name-bytes-const
1403+ "A string as a constant expression (array.new_data is not one)."
1404+ [s]
1405+ (let [bs (map #(bit-and % 255) (.getBytes s))]
1406+ (str "(array.new_fixed $Bytes " (count bs) (apply str (map #(str " (i32.const " % ")") bs)) ")")))

1408+(defn info-global
1409+ "kind 0 = single-arity fn (`<fn ..>`), 1 = multi-arity (`<mfn ..>`), 2 = a
1410+ core op as a value (only its IR-op arity), 3 = a fn whose one arity is
1411+ variadic (`<fn ..>`, `expected at least k args`, P2.12); arity is the
1412+ declared one for kind 0, the fixed count for kind 3; name nil = anonymous."
1413+ [kind arity nm]
1414+ (let [g (str "$info_" kind "_" arity "_" (if nm (str (safe-id nm) "_" (hex32 nm)) "anon"))]
1415+ (swap! *globals* conj
1416+ (str "(global " g " (ref $FnInfo) (struct.new $FnInfo (i32.const " kind ") (i32.const " arity ") "
1417+ (if nm (name-bytes-const nm) "(ref.null none)") "))"))
1418+ g))
1419+
1420+(defn fn-struct-wat
1421+ "codes: arity -> code fn name, plus :v [k name] for a variadic arity with k
1422+ fixed args (the value is then a $FnV)."
1423+ [codes env info-g]
1424+ (let [[k vc] (:v codes) codes (dissoc codes :v)]
1425+ (swap! *elem* into (cond-> (vals codes) vc (conj vc)))
1426+ (let [slot (fn [a] (if-let [c (get codes a)] (str "(ref.func $" c ")") (str "(ref.null $Code" a ")")))]
1427+ (str "(struct.new " (if vc "$FnV " "$Fn ") (slot 0) " " (slot 1) " " (slot 2) " " env " " (slot 3) " " (slot 4)
1428+ " (global.get " info-g ")"
1429+ (when vc (str " (ref.func $" vc ") (i32.const " k ")")) ")"))))

1431+(defn env-type [kinds]
1432+ (or (get @*env-types* kinds)
1433+ (let [t (str "$Env_" (apply str (map {:int "i" :bool "z" :box "b"} kinds)))]
1434+ (swap! *env-types* assoc kinds t)
1435+ t)))

1437+(defn fn-code-wat
1438+ "A hand-written code fn of type $Code<n>: params $p0.. boxed, `body` boxed."
1439+ [cname n body]
1440+ (str "(func $" cname " (type $Code" n ") (param $self (ref null eq))"
1441+ (apply str (map #(str " (param $p" % " (ref null eq))") (range n)))
1442+ ;; $tmp: coerce's inline int boxing, when called while lowering a program fn
1443+ " (result (ref null eq)) (local $tmp i64)\n " body ")"))
1444+
1445+(defn defn-fn-global
1446+ "A defn (program or runtime, multi-arity included) as a fn value: one
1447+ wrapper code fn per arity that unboxes per the signature and calls it
1448+ directly. Arities past 4 have no $Fn slot (D52) and are left out."
1449+ [v]
1450+ (let [ent (callee-sig v)]
1451+ (when *abi-notes* (swap! *abi-notes* update :value (fnil conj #{}) v))
1452+ (or (get @*fn-values* ent)
1453+ (let [ars (into (sorted-map) (filter #(<= (key %) max-arity) (:arities ent)))
1454+ vs (let [vs (:variadic ent)] (when (and vs (<= (:fixed vs) max-var-fixed)) vs))
1455+ ;; P2.12: a native past its fixed arities, through its -seq form
1456+ ad (when-not vs (seq-adapter ent))
1457+ _ (when (and (empty? ars) (not vs) (not ad))
1458+ (fail "unsupported defn with more than 4 params used as a value" {:var v :fn *fname*}))
1459+ base (or (when (seq ars) (:name (val (first ars)))) (:name vs) (qual-name v))
1460+ g (str "$dfn_" base)
1461+ info (cond (:multi? ent) (info-global 1 0 (:base ent))
1462+ (and vs (empty? ars)) (info-global 3 (:fixed vs) (:base ent))
1463+ :else (info-global 0 (if (seq ars) (key (first ars)) 0) (:base ent)))
1464+ codes (into {} (for [[n {:keys [name params ret]}] ars
1465+ :let [cname (str name "__val" n)]]
1466+ (do (swap! *regions* conj
1467+ (fn-code-wat cname n (str "(call $" name
1468+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i k] (str " (local.get $p" i ")" (coerce :box k))) params))
1469+ ")" (coerce ret :box))))
1470+ [n cname])))
1471+ codes (cond
1472+ vs (let [{:keys [name params ret fixed]} vs cname (str name "__valv")]
1473+ (swap! *regions* conj
1474+ (fn-code-wat cname (inc fixed)
1475+ (str "(call $" name
1476+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i k] (str " (local.get $p" i ")" (coerce :box k))) params))
1477+ ")" (coerce ret :box))))
1478+ (assoc codes :v [fixed cname]))
1479+ ad (let [[sv k pre] ad cname (str base "__valseq")]
1480+ (swap! *regions* conj
1481+ (fn-code-wat cname (inc k)
1482+ (rt-call-expr sv (concat pre (map #(str "(local.get $p" % ")") (range (inc k)))))))
1483+ (assoc codes :v [k cname]))
1484+ :else codes)]
1485+ (swap! *fn-values* assoc ent g)
1486+ (swap! *globals* conj (str "(global " g " (ref $Fn) " (fn-struct-wat codes "(ref.null none)" info) ")"))
1487+ g))))

1489+;; Core ops as values, e.g. (swap! a inc), (compose2 inc f): only the arity
1490+;; the IR op has; other arities throw a named Phase-2 limit ($FnInfo kind 2).
1491+(def core-fn-impls
1492+ {#'inc [1 "(call $add_chk (call $rt_int_inc (local.get $p0)) (i64.const 1)) (call $rt_box_int)"]
1493+ #'dec [1 "(call $sub_chk (call $rt_int_dec (local.get $p0)) (i64.const 1)) (call $rt_box_int)"]
1494+ #'+ [2 "(call $rt_add (local.get $p0) (local.get $p1))"]
1495+ #'- [2 "(call $rt_sub (local.get $p0) (local.get $p1))"]
1496+ #'* [2 "(call $rt_mul (local.get $p0) (local.get $p1))"]
1497+ #'< [2 "(i64.lt_s (call $rt_int_lt (local.get $p0)) (call $rt_int_lt (local.get $p1))) (call $rt_box_bool)"]
1498+ #'<= [2 "(i64.le_s (call $rt_int_lte (local.get $p0)) (call $rt_int_lte (local.get $p1))) (call $rt_box_bool)"]
1499+ #'> [2 "(i64.gt_s (call $rt_int_gt (local.get $p0)) (call $rt_int_gt (local.get $p1))) (call $rt_box_bool)"]
1500+ #'>= [2 "(i64.ge_s (call $rt_int_gte (local.get $p0)) (call $rt_int_gte (local.get $p1))) (call $rt_box_bool)"]})

1502+(defn core-fn-global [v]
1503+ (or (get @*fn-values* v)
1504+ (let [[n body] (core-fn-impls v)
1505+ op (core-var-ops v)
1506+ nm (op-names op)
1507+ cname (str "core_" (name op))
1508+ g (str "$cfn_" cname)
1509+ info (info-global 2 n nm)]
1510+ (swap! *fn-values* assoc v g)
1511+ (swap! *regions* conj (fn-code-wat cname n body))
1512+ (swap! *globals* conj (str "(global " g " (ref $Fn) " (fn-struct-wat {n cname} "(ref.null none)" info) ")"))
1513+ g)))

1515+(defn extern-global
1516+ "The var-table slot of a var the program neither defines nor lowers
1517+ specially. It is never set, so it reads nil, like an unbound var."
1518+ [v]
1519+ (note! :externs v)
1520+ (or (get @*externs* v)
1521+ (let [g (str "$ext_" (safe-id (subs (str v) 2)) "_" (hex32 (str v)))]
1522+ (swap! *externs* assoc v g)
1523+ g)))

1525+(def ^:dynamic *program-file* nil) ; the driver's input path, for *file*
1526+
1527+(defn native-scalar-const?
1528+ "A non-dynamic var of a native namespace whose value is a number, string
1529+ or keyword (lg defines no such var by def outside a program, whose defs
1530+ are var-table vars and never reach var-value-wat)."
1531+ [v]
1532+ (and (var? v) (not (:dynamic (meta v))) (not (lw-rt/source-defn v)) (not (lw-rt/runtime-var? v))
1533+ (let [x (try @v (catch e nil))] (or (float? x) (int? x) (string? x) (keyword? x)))))
1534+
1535+(defn scalar-const-wat [x]
1536+ (if (int? x) (str "(i64.const " x ")" (coerce :int :box)) (const-box-wat x)))
1537+
1538+(defn var-value-wat
1539+ "A constant var used as a value (not in callee position)."
1540+ [v]
1541+ ;; a core op as a value: the runtime's twin when it is compiled in (every
1542+ ;; arity, native's errors), else the backend's IR-op-arity-only fn
1543+ (cond (= v #'*in-wasm*) "(global.get $true)"
1544+ ;; P3.2: *assert* is true natively (assert's check runs)
1545+ (= v #'*assert*) "(global.get $true)"
1546+ ;; D87: *out*/*err* are the runtime's two standard handles
1547+ (and *rt* (#{#'*out* #'*err*} v))
1548+ (let [s (get-in (callee-sig (if (= v #'*out*) #'wasm.host/out-handle #'wasm.host/err-handle)) [:arities 0])]
1549+ (str "(call $" (:name s) ")" (coerce (:ret s) :box)))
1550+ (and *rt* (= v #'os/args)) "(call $rt_os_args)"
1551+ ;; P2.14: *file* is the program's path (native binds it while the
1552+ ;; file loads; here the whole run is the load)
1553+ (and *rt* (= v #'*file*) *program-file*) (str-wat *program-file*)
1554+ ;; P2.14: a native var holding a scalar constant (math/PI, math/E):
1555+ ;; its value, as native reads it
1556+ (and *rt* (native-scalar-const? v)) (scalar-const-wat @v)
1557+ (and *rt* (value-substs v)) (str "(global.get " (defn-fn-global (value-substs v)) ")")
1558+ (and *rt* (rt-target v) (callee-sig v)) (str "(global.get " (defn-fn-global v) ")")
1559+ (core-fn-impls v) (str "(global.get " (core-fn-global v) ")")
1560+ (callee-sig v) (str "(global.get " (defn-fn-global v) ")")
1561+ :else (str "(global.get " (extern-global v) ")")))

1563+(defn closure-of [nid]
1564+ (loop [n (src-of nid) caps ()]
1565+ (case (ir/op n *f*)
1566+ :push-closed (let [[cls v] (ir/refs n *f*)] (recur (src-of cls) (cons v caps)))
1567+ :make-closure (recur (src-of (first (ir/refs n *f*))) caps)
1568+ (if (template? n)
1569+ {:tpl (ir/aux n *f*) :caps (vec caps)}
1570+ (fail "unsupported closure value" {:op (ir/op n *f*) :nid n :fn *fname*})))))
1571+
1572+(defn closure-wat
1573+ "Lambda-lift every arity of the closure built at nid and return the
1574+ expression constructing its $Fn."
1575+ [nid]
1576+ (let [{:keys [tpl caps]} (closure-of nid)
1577+ multi? (= :multi-fn-template (:kind tpl))
1578+ tpls (if multi? (:fns tpl) [tpl])
1579+ cap-kinds (mapv ty caps)
1580+ env-t (when (seq caps) (env-type cap-kinds))
1581+ base (str *fname* "__fn" nid)
1582+ fname (let [n (ir/fn-name (:fn (first tpls)))] (when-not (= n "fn*") n))
1583+ ;; a variadic template's arity counts the rest param (k fixed + 1);
1584+ ;; its code is the $FnV's variadic slot (P2.12)
1585+ codes (into {} (for [{tfn :fn :keys [arity variadic?]} tpls]
1586+ (do (when (and variadic? (> (dec arity) max-var-fixed))
1587+ (fail "unsupported variadic closure with more than 4 fixed params" {:fn *fname* :arity arity}))
1588+ (when (and (not variadic?) (> arity max-arity))
1589+ (fail "unsupported closure arity > 4" {:fn *fname* :arity arity}))
1590+ (let [cname (str base "_" (if variadic? "v" arity))
1591+ info (assoc (binding [*box-params* true] (analyze-ir cname tfn))
1592+ :params (vec (repeat arity :box)) :ret :box :caps []
1593+ :export? false :code arity :env env-t :env-kinds cap-kinds)]
1594+ (swap! *regions* conj (lower-fn info))
1595+ (if variadic? [:v [(dec arity) cname]] [arity cname])))))
1596+ v1 (when-not multi? (:variadic? (first tpls)))
1597+ info-g (info-global (cond multi? 1 v1 3 :else 0)
1598+ (cond multi? 0 v1 (dec (:arity (first tpls))) :else (:arity (first tpls))) fname)]
1599+ (if env-t
1600+ (fn-struct-wat codes (str "(struct.new " env-t " " (str/join " " (map arg-as caps cap-kinds)) ")") info-g)
1601+ (let [g (str "$clo_" base)]
1602+ (swap! *globals* conj (str "(global " g " (ref $Fn) " (fn-struct-wat codes "(ref.null none)" info-g) ")"))
1603+ (str "(global.get " g ")")))))

1605+(defn invoke-wat
1606+ "A call whose callee is a value: dispatch on the $Fn's arity slot."
1607+ [nid callee args]
1608+ (let [n (count args)]
1609+ (when (> n max-invoke)
1610+ (fail "unsupported call through a fn value with more than 32 args" {:argc n :fn *fname*}))
1611+ (str "(local.set $v" nid " (call $rt_invoke" (invoke-n! n) " " (arg-as callee :box)
1612+ (apply str (map #(str " " (arg-as % :box)) args)) ")" (coerce :box (ty nid)) ")")))
1613+
1614+(defn def-wat
1615+ "Top-level (def x v) sets x's var-table global. A def anywhere else (in a
1616+ defn, a closure or a try region) stays refused (P1.4)."
1617+ [nid]
1618+ (let [[vr val] (ir/refs nid *f*) v (const-val vr) g (get *var-globals* v)]
1619+ (if (and g (or (= *fname* "_main") (str/ends-with? *fname* "/__lw_nsinit")))
1620+ (when val (str "(global.set " g " " (arg-as val :box) ")"))
1621+ (fail "unsupported op :def" {:op :def :var v :nid nid :fn *fname*}))))
1622+
1623+(defn inst-wat [nid]
1624+ (let [op (ir/op nid *f*) refs (ir/refs nid *f*) aux (ir/aux nid *f*)
1625+ set (fn [expr] (str "(local.set $v" nid " " expr ")"))]
1626+ (cond
1627+ (= op :block-arg) nil
1628+ ;; a constant var is materialised at each use (arg-as); a var-table var
1629+ ;; is read here
1630+ (= op :load-var) (when-let [g (var-global aux)]
1631+ (set (str "(global.get " g ")" (coerce :box (ty nid)))))
1632+ (= op :load-arg) (set (str "(local.get $p" aux ")" (coerce (nth *param-kinds* aux) (ty nid))))
1633+ (closure-hidden? nid) nil ; a chain link, or consumed by its :try
1634+ (string-const? nid) nil ; materialised at each use (arg-as)
1635+ (null-call? nid) nil ; (wasm/null), likewise
1636+ (closure-val? nid) (set (str (closure-wat nid) (coerce :box (ty nid))))
1637+ (symbol-const? nid) nil ; consumed by catch-matches?
1638+ (var-const? nid) nil ; consumed by :def
1639+ (= op :def) (def-wat nid)
1640+ (= op :load-closed) (set (str (if *env-type*
1641+ (str "(struct.get " *env-type* " " aux " (local.get $env))")
1642+ (str "(local.get $c" aux ")"))
1643+ (coerce (nth *cap-kinds* aux) (ty nid))))
1644+ (some? (int-const-val nid)) nil ; materialised at each use (arg-as)
1645+ (= op :const) (set (const-wat nid aux))
1646+ (= op :try) (try-wat nid)
1647+ ;; build.lg stopped emitting :tail-call (fn-level recur is :recur-fn ->
1648+ ;; :tail); name it rather than fall into the generic arm.
1649+ (= op :tail-call) (fail "unsupported op :tail-call (not emitted by current ir.build)" {:nid nid :fn *fname*})
1650+ ;; a stack-VM marker cleanup strips; nothing to emit if one survives
1651+ (= op :pop) nil
1652+ (= op :set-var) (fail "unsupported op :set-var" {:op op :var (const-val (first refs)) :nid nid :fn *fname*})
1653+ ;; P2.11: a boxed operand may be a Float: the runtime's `/` (wasm.math/div)
1654+ (and (= op :div) (= 2 (count refs)) *rt* (some #(= :box (ty %)) refs) (not (some #(= :float (ty %)) refs)))
1655+ (direct-call-wat nid (callee-sig #'wasm.math/div) refs)
1656+ (and (= op :div) (= 2 (count refs)) (not (some #(= :float (ty %)) refs))) (div-wat nid refs)
1657+ (prim-wat nid op refs) (prim-wat nid op refs)
1658+ (= op :call)
1659+ (let [callee (first refs) v (var-of callee)]
1660+ (if (and v (not (table-var? v)))
1661+ (or (when (lw-rt/intrinsic? v) (intrinsic-call-wat nid v (rest refs)))
1662+ (when-let [cop (core-var-ops v)]
1663+ (or (prim-wat nid cop (rest refs))
1664+ (fail "unsupported core call shape" {:var v :argc (count (rest refs)) :fn *fname*})))
1665+ (call-wat nid v (rest refs)))
1666+ (invoke-wat nid callee (rest refs))))
1667+ :else (fail (str "unsupported op " op) {:op op :nid nid :fn *fname*}))))
1668+
1669+(defn tail-call-wat
1670+ "nid (a :call in tail position) as a wasm tail call, or nil when the call
1671+ is not one the backend makes as a plain call returning *ret-type*
1672+ unchanged (then it lowers normally). Mirrors inst-wat/call-wat's dispatch:
1673+ native lg eliminates every tail call (self, mutual and through fn values),
1674+ so 1e7 tail calls must not grow the wasm stack (P1.7 bug-07)."
1675+ [nid]
1676+ (let [refs (ir/refs nid *f*) callee (first refs) args (rest refs) argc (count args)
1677+ v (var-of callee)
1678+ inv (fn [callee-expr]
1679+ (when (and (<= argc max-invoke) (= :box *ret-type*))
1680+ (str "(return_call $rt_invoke" (invoke-n! argc) " " callee-expr (apply str (map #(str " " (arg-as % :box)) args)) ")")))
1681+ direct (fn [ent]
1682+ (if-let [sig (get-in ent [:arities argc])]
1683+ (when (and (= (:ret sig) *ret-type*) (not *guard-calls*))
1684+ (note-call-abi! ent args sig)
1685+ (str "(return_call $" (:name sig) " " (str/join " " (map arg-as args (:params sig))) ")"))
1686+ (when-let [[vs exprs] (variadic-call ent args)]
1687+ (when (and (= (:ret vs) *ret-type*) (not *guard-calls*))
1688+ (str "(return_call $" (:name vs) " " (str/join " " exprs) ")")))))]
1689+ (cond
1690+ (not (and v (not (table-var? v)))) (inv (arg-as callee :box))
1691+ (lw-rt/intrinsic? v) nil
1692+ (core-var-ops v) nil
1693+ (and *rt* (rt-overrides v)) nil
1694+ (get @*sigs* v) (direct (get @*sigs* v))
1695+ (contains? #{#'throw #'catch-matches? #'atom #'deref #'reset! #'swap! #'neg} v) nil
1696+ (= v core-println) nil
1697+ (and *rt* (coll-ctors v)) nil
1698+ (and *rt* (rt-target v) (callee-sig v)) (direct (callee-sig v))
1699+ :else (inv (str "(global.get " (extern-global v) ")")))))

1701+(defn block-wat [bid]
1702+ ;; eager: an unsupported op must fail before the terminator's operands are
1703+ ;; lowered, so the error names the first offending op in program order
1704+ (vec (remove nil? (map #(or (when (= % *tail-nid*) (tail-call-wat %)) (inst-wat %))
1705+ (remove *absorbed* (ir/block-insts bid *f*))))))
1706+
1707+(defn returns-param
1708+ "j when block b does no work and returns its j-th param, either itself or
1709+ by forwarding it to a block that does (an if's join block); else nil."
1710+ ([b] (returns-param b 0))
1711+ ([b depth]
1712+ (when (and (< depth 16)
1713+ (every? #(or (contains? *absorbed* %) (= :block-arg (ir/op % *f*))) (ir/block-insts b *f*)))
1714+ (let [t (ir/block-term b *f*)
1715+ ps (vec (ir/block-params b *f*))
1716+ idx (fn [x] (first (keep-indexed #(when (= %2 x) %1) ps)))]
1717+ (when t
1718+ (case (ir/op t *f*)
1719+ :return (idx (first (ir/refs t *f*)))
1720+ :branch (let [bt (ir/aux t *f*)
1721+ k (returns-param (ir/branch-target-target bt) (inc depth))]
1722+ (when k (idx (nth (vec (ir/branch-target-args bt)) k nil))))
1723+ nil))))))
1724+
1725+(defn tail-call-nid
1726+ "The :call that block bid ends with when its value is what the fn returns:
1727+ bid returns it, or bid's exit edge carries it to a block that only
1728+ returns (or forwards) it."
1729+ [bid edge]
1730+ (let [l (last (remove *absorbed* (ir/block-insts bid *f*)))]
1731+ (when (and l (= :call (ir/op l *f*)))
1732+ (if edge
1733+ (when-let [j (returns-param (:target edge))]
1734+ (when (= l (nth (vec (:args edge)) j nil)) l))
1735+ (when (= l (first (ir/refs (ir/block-term bid *f*) *f*))) l)))))
1736+
1737+(defn copy-wat
1738+ "Parallel copy: push every value, then pop into the destinations in reverse."
1739+ [vals kinds dests]
1740+ (concat (map arg-as vals kinds)
1741+ (map (fn [d] (str "(local.set " d ")")) (reverse dests))))
1742+
1743+(defn edge-wat [{:keys [target args]}]
1744+ ;; params that get no local (dead, var-, closure- or symbol-valued) take no copy
1745+ (let [pairs (remove (fn [[_ p]] (no-local? p))
1746+ (map vector args (ir/block-params target *f*)))]
1747+ (copy-wat (map first pairs) (map (comp ty second) pairs) (map #(str "$v" (second %)) pairs))))
1748+
1749+(defn term-ref [bid] (first (ir/refs (ir/block-term bid *f*) *f*)))
1750+
1751+(defn cond-wat [nid]
1752+ (case (ty nid)
1753+ :bool (lget nid)
1754+ :box (str "(call $rt_truthy " (arg-as nid :box) ")")
1755+ ;; an int is never nil or false
1756+ :int "(i32.const 1)"
1757+ (fail "unsupported branch condition type" {:type (ty nid) :fn *fname*})))

1759+(declare walk)
1760+
1761+(defn switch-chain
1762+ "structurize's keyword-dispatch fold as an if-chain of keyword tests (P1.6).
1763+ Correctness first: a br_table needs keyword ids, which wait for Phase 2's
1764+ interning. A non-keyword discriminant matches no arm, as native `=` would."
1765+ [d arms last-et default]
1766+ (if (empty? arms)
1767+ (concat (edge-wat last-et) (walk default))
1768+ (let [[kw tt node] (first arms)]
1769+ (concat [(str "(if " (if *rt*
1770+ (str "(ref.eq " d " " (kw-wat kw) ")")
1771+ (str "(call $rt_kw_is " d " " (bytes-wat (name kw)) ")"))
1772+ " (then")]
1773+ (edge-wat tt) (walk node) [") (else"]
1774+ (switch-chain d (rest arms) last-et default) ["))"]))))
1775+
1776+(defn walk [node]
1777+ (let [[tag bid] node]
1778+ (case tag
1779+ :return (concat (binding [*tail-nid* (tail-call-nid bid nil)] (block-wat bid))
1780+ [(str "(return " (arg-as (term-ref bid) *ret-type*) ")")])
1781+ ;; fn-level recur: the params are the recur slots; re-enter the body
1782+ :tail (let [refs (ir/refs (ir/block-term bid *f*) *f*)
1783+ kinds *param-kinds*]
1784+ (when (not= (count refs) (count kinds))
1785+ (fail "recur arity mismatch" {:fn *fname* :argc (count refs)}))
1786+ (concat (block-wat bid)
1787+ (copy-wat refs kinds (map #(str "$p" %) (range (count kinds))))
1788+ ["(br $fn)"]))
1789+ :seq (let [[_ _ edge next] node]
1790+ (concat (binding [*tail-nid* (tail-call-nid bid edge)] (block-wat bid)) (edge-wat edge) (walk next)))
1791+ :if (let [[_ _ tt et then else cont] node]
1792+ (concat (block-wat bid)
1793+ [(str "(if " (cond-wat (term-ref bid)) " (then")]
1794+ (edge-wat tt) (walk then) [") (else"] (edge-wat et) (walk else) ["))"]
1795+ (when cont (walk cont))))
1796+ ;; cont's head block IS the loop's exit block (structure-loop builds it
1797+ ;; from `exit`), which is what a :break names. A :multi-exit loop has
1798+ ;; no cont: structurize inlines every exit path into the body, each
1799+ ;; ending in :return / :tail / an outer :continue or :break.
1800+ :loop (let [[_ _ body cont] node
1801+ frame {:id bid :exit (when cont (second cont))}]
1802+ (concat [(str "(block $exit" bid " (loop $head" bid)]
1803+ (binding [*loop* (conj (or *loop* ()) frame)] (doall (walk body)))
1804+ ["unreachable))"] (when cont (walk cont))))
1805+ :continue (concat (edge-wat (nth node 2)) [(str "(br $head" bid ")")])
1806+ :break (let [fr (first (filter #(= bid (:exit %)) *loop*))]
1807+ (when-not fr (fail "break to a block no enclosing loop exits to" {:bid bid :fn *fname*}))
1808+ (concat (edge-wat (nth node 2)) [(str "(br $exit" (:id fr) ")")]))
1809+ ;; [:switch b disc [[kw tt node] ...] last-et default cont]: b's
1810+ ;; terminator and its :eq are absorbed, so b's other insts run first
1811+ :switch (let [[_ _ disc arms last-et default cont] node]
1812+ (concat (block-wat bid)
1813+ (switch-chain (arg-as disc :box) arms last-et default)
1814+ (when cont (walk cont))))
1815+ :fallthrough []
1816+ (fail "unsupported tree node" {:tag tag :fn *fname*}))))
1817+
1818+(defn all-values [f]
1819+ (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {})]
1820+ (doall (for [b (ir/blocks f) i (concat (ir/block-params b f) (ir/block-insts b f))
1821+ :when (not (no-local? i))]
1822+ i))))
1823+
1824+(defn has-node? [tag tree]
1825+ (boolean (some #(and (vector? %) (= tag (first %))) (tree-seq vector? seq tree))))
1826+
1827+(defn check-absorbed
1828+ "lower-go's contract: insts folded into a :switch carry no statement. Make
1829+ sure nothing outside the fold reads one, since its local is never set."
1830+ [fname f blocks insts]
1831+ (when (seq insts)
1832+ (doseq [b (ir/blocks f) :when (not (contains? blocks b))
1833+ i (concat (ir/block-insts b f) [(ir/block-term b f)])
1834+ :when (and i (not (contains? insts i)))
1835+ r (concat (ir/refs i f)
1836+ (when (= :branch (ir/op i f)) (ir/branch-target-args (ir/aux i f)))
1837+ (when (= :branch-if (ir/op i f))
1838+ (let [a (ir/aux i f)]
1839+ (concat (ir/branch-target-args (ir/cond-target-true a))
1840+ (ir/branch-target-args (ir/cond-target-false a))))))
1841+ :when (contains? insts r)]
1842+ (fail "switch-absorbed inst used outside its switch" {:fn fname :user i :inst r}))))
1843+
1844+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1845+;; Funcref values (kind :func). wasm/funcref and :funcref slots produce them;
1846+;; a param is :func when the body stores it in a funcref slot; a block-arg is
1847+;; :func when every incoming value is one (or a null). Nothing else may hold
1848+;; one: a funcref is not an eqref, so it never boxes.
1849+
1850+(defn func-slot-args
1851+ "Arg nids of :call nid that sit in a funcref position."
1852+ [nid]
1853+ (let [v (call-var nid) args (vec (rest (ir/refs nid *f*)))
1854+ decl (fn [] (let [x (var-of (first args))] (when (and x (decl-type-name x)) @x)))
1855+ nm (when (lw-rt/intrinsic? v) (name (symbol v)))]
1856+ (cond
1857+ (= nm "new") (when-let [d (decl)]
1858+ (keep-indexed (fn [i f] (when (= :funcref (:type f)) (get args (inc i)))) (:fields d)))
1859+ (= nm "set!") (when-let [d (decl)]
1860+ (let [i (const-val (get args 1))]
1861+ (when (and (int? i) (= :funcref (field-type d i))) [(get args 3)])))
1862+ (= nm "array-new") (when-let [d (decl)] (when (= :funcref (:elem d)) [(get args 2)]))
1863+ (= nm "aset!") (when-let [d (decl)] (when (= :funcref (:elem d)) [(get args 3)]))
1864+ (= nm "call-ref") (cons (get args 1)
1865+ (when-let [d (decl)]
1866+ (keep-indexed (fn [i t] (when (= :funcref t) (get args (+ 2 i)))) (:params d))))
1867+ (= nm "null?") nil
1868+ v (when-let [s (get-in (get @*sigs* v) [:arities (count args)])]
1869+ (keep-indexed (fn [i k] (when (= :func k) (get args i))) (:params s)))
1870+ :else nil)))
1871+
1872+(defn all-insts [f] (for [b (ir/blocks f) i (concat (ir/block-params b f) (ir/block-insts b f))] i))
1873+
1874+(defn func-params
1875+ "Indices of params the body uses in a funcref position."
1876+ [f]
1877+ (set (for [i (all-insts f) :when (= :call (ir/op i f))
1878+ a (func-slot-args i)
1879+ :let [r (src-of a)]
1880+ :when (= :load-arg (ir/op r f))]
1881+ (ir/aux r f))))
1882+
1883+(defn func-producer? [nid fs params]
1884+ (let [op (ir/op nid *f*)]
1885+ (cond
1886+ (= op :load-arg) (= :func (get params (ir/aux nid *f*)))
1887+ (= op :call)
1888+ (let [v (call-var nid) args (vec (rest (ir/refs nid *f*)))
1889+ decl (fn [] (let [x (var-of (first args))] (when (and x (decl-type-name x)) @x)))
1890+ nm (when (lw-rt/intrinsic? v) (name (symbol v)))]
1891+ (cond (= nm "funcref") true
1892+ (= nm "get") (when-let [d (decl)] (let [i (const-val (get args 1))] (and (int? i) (= :funcref (field-type d i)))))
1893+ (= nm "aget") (when-let [d (decl)] (= :funcref (:elem d)))
1894+ (= nm "call-ref") (when-let [d (decl)] (= :funcref (:result d)))
1895+ nm false
1896+ v (= :func (:ret (get-in (get @*sigs* v) [:arities (count args)])))
1897+ :else false))
1898+ (= op :block-arg)
1899+ (let [b (ir/block-of nid *f*)
1900+ idx (first (keep-indexed #(when (= %2 nid) %1) (ir/block-params b *f*)))
1901+ inc (incoming b idx)]
1902+ (and (seq inc)
1903+ (every? #(or (contains? fs %) (contains? fs (src-of %)) (nullish? %)) inc)
1904+ (some #(or (contains? fs %) (contains? fs (src-of %))) inc)))
1905+ :else false)))
1906+
1907+(defn compute-func-vals [f params]
1908+ (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {})]
1909+ (let [nids (all-insts f)]
1910+ (loop [fs #{}]
1911+ (let [fs2 (into fs (filter #(and (not (contains? fs %)) (func-producer? % fs params)) nids))]
1912+ (if (= fs2 fs) fs (recur fs2)))))))
1913+
1914+(declare analyze-opt)
1915+
1916+(defn analyze-ir
1917+ "Optimize and structurize one IR fn (a defn or a try region's fn* template)."
1918+ [fname f]
1919+ (p/optimize-fn f)
1920+ (analyze-opt fname f))
1921+
1922+(defn analyze-opt
1923+ "analyze-ir after optimize-fn has run (the census times the stages apart)."
1924+ [fname f]
1925+ (let [{:keys [tree fallbacks absorbed-blocks absorbed-insts]} (st/structurize f)]
1926+ (check-absorbed fname f (or absorbed-blocks #{}) (or absorbed-insts #{}))
1927+ ;; structurize's :fallbacks also counts :multi-exit loops, whose tree is
1928+ ;; complete (see walk's :loop); only a :goto node is unlowerable.
1929+ (when (has-node? :goto tree)
1930+ (fail "structurize fallback (:goto)" {:fn fname :fallbacks fallbacks :tree tree}))
1931+ (let [fparams (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {}) *func-vals* #{}] (func-params f))
1932+ params0 (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {}) *func-vals* #{}]
1933+ (vec (for [i (range (ir/fn-arity f))]
1934+ (if (contains? fparams i)
1935+ :func
1936+ (let [nid (ir/fn-load-arg f i)] (if nid (ty nid) :box))))))
1937+ fvals (compute-func-vals f params0)]
1938+ (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {}) *func-vals* fvals]
1939+ (let [params params0
1940+ rvals (for [b (ir/blocks f)
1941+ :let [t (ir/block-term b f)]
1942+ ;; a block left without a terminator (bfs-flood-label!) returns nothing
1943+ :when (and t (= (ir/op t f) :return))]
1944+ (first (ir/refs t f)))
1945+ rets (map ty rvals)
1946+ ret (cond (and (seq rets) (every? #{:int} rets)) :int
1947+ (and (seq rets) (every? #{:bool} rets)) :bool
1948+ ;; P2.11 (F4): a float result stays f64, so callers'
1949+ ;; float ops see it typed (s/unbox-float, f64-of)
1950+ (and (seq rets) (every? #{:float} rets)) :float
1951+ (and (seq rets) (some #{:func} rets) (every? #(or (= :func (ty %)) (nullish? %)) rvals)) :func
1952+ :else :box)]
1953+ {:name fname :f f :tree tree :params params :ret ret :caps [] :export? true
1954+ :absorbed (or absorbed-insts #{}) :func-vals fvals})))))
1955+
1956+(defn same-name-calls
1957+ "The vars f calls whose name is f's own (typeinfer's self-call test
1958+ compares names only)."
1959+ [f]
1960+ (let [nm (str (ir/fn-name f))]
1961+ (set (for [b (ir/blocks f) i (ir/block-insts b f)
1962+ :when (= :call (ir/op i f))
1963+ :let [c (first (ir/refs i f))]
1964+ :when (and c (= :load-var (ir/op c f)) (= nm (name (symbol (ir/aux c f)))))]
1965+ (ir/aux c f)))))
1966+
1967+(defn self-call?
1968+ "Does f call itself by var (typeinfer's own self-call test)? P3.2: false
1969+ when f also calls a same-named var of another namespace (string's
1970+ ends-with? calling core/ends-with?): typeinfer would apply the declared
1971+ self return type to that call too. UPSTREAM finding (typeinfer's
1972+ call-declared-type matches the callee by name, not var)."
1973+ [f]
1974+ (let [vs (same-name-calls f)
1975+ own (try (resolve (symbol (str (ir/fn-name f)))) (catch e nil))]
1976+ (and (seq vs) (every? #(= own %) vs))))
1977+
1978+;; P2.11 (F9, D87): infer-arg-types types every param that + - * < ... touch
1979+;; :int, whatever the other operand is, so a float helper (wasm.math/exp*:
1980+;; (< x 0.0)) got an i64 param and its float callers could not be lowered.
1981+;; The guess is unsound exactly where the param's value meets a float: an
1982+;; arithmetic or comparison op with a :float operand and an :int operand
1983+;; that is the param, or computed from it by int arithmetic (expmulti's
1984+;; (- hi lo) then (* t 4.1e-08)), or meets a boxed operand in arithmetic or
1985+;; an ordering (modf-frac's (- f (trunc f)): trunc returns a box that is a
1986+;; Float at run time; that op takes the boxed path anyway, so boxing the param
1987+;; costs only its other uses). Those params are re-analysed boxed: the float
1988+;; ops then convert at run time ($rt_to_f64), which is right for an Int too,
1989+;; while an i64 param would reject a Float.
1990+(def int-flow-ops #{:add :sub :mul :inc :dec :quot :unchecked-add :unchecked-sub :unchecked-mul
1991+ :bit-and :bit-or :bit-xor :bit-and-not :bit-not :bit-shift-left :bit-shift-right
1992+ :unsigned-bit-shift-right})
1993+(def float-meet-ops #{:add :sub :mul :div :lt :lte :gt :gte :eq :zero? :pos? :neg? :inc :dec})
1994+
1995+(defn float-tainted-params
1996+ "Indices of :int params of analysed fn info whose value meets a float."
1997+ [{:keys [f params func-vals]}]
1998+ (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {}) *func-vals* (or func-vals #{})]
1999+ (let [seeds (into {} (for [i (range (count params))
2000+ :when (= :int (nth params i))
2001+ :let [n (ir/fn-load-arg f i)] :when n]
2002+ [n #{i}]))]
2003+ (if (empty? seeds)
2004+ #{}
2005+ (let [insts (all-insts f)
2006+ inc-of (into {} (for [b (ir/blocks f) [idx p] (map-indexed vector (ir/block-params b f))]
2007+ [p (vec (incoming b idx))]))
2008+ step (fn [T]
2009+ (reduce (fn [T u]
2010+ (let [op (ir/op u f)
2011+ srcs (cond (= op :block-arg) (get inc-of u)
2012+ (and (contains? int-flow-ops op) (= :int (ty u))) (ir/refs u f)
2013+ :else nil)
2014+ t (reduce (fn [acc r] (into acc (get T r))) (get T u #{}) srcs)]
2015+ (if (seq t) (assoc T u t) T)))
2016+ T insts))
2017+ T (loop [T seeds] (let [T2 (step T)] (if (= T2 T) T (recur T2))))]
2018+ (set (for [u insts
2019+ :when (contains? float-meet-ops (ir/op u f))
2020+ :let [rs (ir/refs u f)]
2021+ :when (or (some #(= :float (ty %)) (cons u rs))
2022+ (and (not= :eq (ir/op u f)) (some #(= :box (ty %)) rs)))
2023+ r rs :when (= :int (ty r))
2024+ i (get T r)]
2025+ i)))))))
2026+
2027+(defn analyze-fn
2028+ "Build, optimize and structurize one (already macroexpanded) defn form.
2029+ Resolution of vars happens against *ns*, so the caller must have defined
2030+ the program's vars first.
2031+
2032+ A self-recursive defn is first tried with its self-calls typed :int
2033+ (typeinfer's #599 declared-return hook, seeded without a hint). If every
2034+ return is then :int the assumption holds by induction on recursion depth
2035+ (the base cases return ints without recursing), so the fn returns an
2036+ unboxed i64; otherwise it is rebuilt and analysed normally. fib(32): the
2037+ boxed path is ~2x the probe, the typed one well under it (bench-fib.sh)."
2038+ ([src] (analyze-fn src (str (second src)) false))
2039+ ([src wname multi?]
2040+ ;; float-tainted params are boxed and the fn re-analysed until stable;
2041+ ;; a variadic arity's params all stay boxed (P2.12: its callers build the
2042+ ;; rest seq generically, and typeinfer must not type the rest param)
2043+ (loop [boxed (if (variadic-params? (nth src 2))
2044+ (into *box-param-idx* (range (inc (fixed-count (nth src 2)))))
2045+ *box-param-idx*)]
2046+ (let [info (binding [*box-param-idx* boxed] (analyze-fn* src wname multi?))
2047+ more (remove boxed (float-tainted-params info))]
2048+ (if (empty? more) info (recur (into boxed more)))))))
2049+
2050+(defn licm-validate-error? [e]
2051+ (str/includes? (str (ex-message e)) "validate after licm"))
2052+
2053+(defn without-licm
2054+ "Run thunk with the pipeline's licm pass left out (P3.2). ir.passes.licm
2055+ leaves a cross-block ref on a few shapes (xsofy's bfs-path and
2056+ read-dismiss-key!, census 2026-10-01), which the validate after it
2057+ rejects; hoisting is an optimisation, so the fn is rebuilt and optimised
2058+ without it. UPSTREAM finding."
2059+ [thunk]
2060+ (let [orig p/default-pass-list]
2061+ (alter-var-root #'p/default-pass-list (fn [l] (vec (remove #(= "licm" (nth % 1)) l))))
2062+ (try (thunk) (finally (alter-var-root #'p/default-pass-list (constantly orig))))))
2063+
2064+(declare analyze-fn**)
2065+
2066+(defn analyze-fn*
2067+ [src wname multi?]
2068+ (try (analyze-fn** src wname multi?)
2069+ (catch e (if (licm-validate-error? e)
2070+ (without-licm #(analyze-fn** src wname multi?))
2071+ (throw e)))))
2072+
2073+(defn analyze-fn**
2074+ [src wname multi?]
2075+ (do
2076+ (let [nm (str (second src)) f (ir.build/build-fn src)]
2077+ ;; a multi-arity fn's other arities share its name, so the optimistic
2078+ ;; self typing would type them too: off for multi-arity
2079+ (if (and (not multi?) (self-call? f))
2080+ (or (try (let [info (binding [ir.passes.typeinfer/*declared-return-types* {nm :int}]
2081+ (analyze-ir wname f))]
2082+ (when (= :int (:ret info)) info))
2083+ (catch e nil))
2084+ (analyze-ir wname (ir.build/build-fn src)))
2085+ (analyze-ir wname f)))))
2086+
2087+(defn has-tail? [tree] (has-node? :tail tree))
2088+
2089+(defn closure-sets
2090+ "[linked try-srcs] for f: closure-chain nodes a later link consumes, and
2091+ every node of a chain a :try consumes (see closure-hidden?)."
2092+ [f]
2093+ (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {})]
2094+ (let [insts (for [b (ir/blocks f) i (ir/block-insts b f)] i)
2095+ chain (fn chain [n]
2096+ (let [n (src-of n)]
2097+ (if (contains? #{:push-closed :make-closure} (ir/op n f))
2098+ (cons n (chain (first (ir/refs n f))))
2099+ (list n))))]
2100+ [(set (for [i insts :when (contains? #{:push-closed :make-closure} (ir/op i f))]
2101+ (src-of (first (ir/refs i f)))))
2102+ (set (for [i insts :when (= :try (ir/op i f)) r (ir/refs i f) n (chain r)] n))])))
2103+
2104+(defn lower-fn
2105+ "One wasm function. `code` (an arity) makes it closure code of type
2106+ $Code<code>: the closure arrives as $self, its captures are read from the
2107+ env struct `env` (field kinds `env-kinds`). `caps` are a try region's
2108+ captures, passed as trailing params $c0.."
2109+ [{:keys [name f tree params ret caps export? export-name code env env-kinds absorbed func-vals]}]
2110+ (let [[linked tries] (binding [*func-vals* (or func-vals #{})] (closure-sets f))]
2111+ (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {}) *param-kinds* params *cap-kinds* (if code env-kinds caps) *fname* name *ret-type* ret
2112+ *box-inline* true *env-type* env *linked* linked *try-srcs* tries
2113+ *absorbed* (or absorbed #{}) *func-vals* (or func-vals #{}) *tail-nid* nil]
2114+ (let [locals (distinct (all-values f))
2115+ body (walk tree)
2116+ body (if (has-tail? tree)
2117+ (concat ["(loop $fn"] body ["unreachable)"])
2118+ body)]
2119+ (str "(func $" name (when code (str " (type $Code" code ")")) (when export? (str " (export \"" (wat-str (or export-name name)) "\")"))
2120+ (when code " (param $self (ref null eq))")
2121+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i k] (str " (param $p" i " " (wt k) ")")) params))
2122+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i k] (str " (param $c" i " " (wt k) ")")) caps))
2123+ " (result " (wt ret) ")\n"
2124+ " (local $tmp i64) (local $ta i64) (local $tb i64) (local $exn exnref)\n"
2125+ (when env (str " (local $env (ref null " env "))\n"))
2126+ (apply str (map (fn [v] (str " (local $v" v " " (wt (ty v)) ")\n")) locals))
2127+ (when env (str " (local.set $env (ref.cast (ref " env ") (struct.get $Fn 3 (ref.cast (ref $Fn) (local.get $self)))))\n"))
2128+ " " (str/join "\n " body) "\n unreachable)")))))
2129+
2130+;; :try (build.lg build-try): refs are the body fn*, then the optional
2131+;; handler fn* (one param, the caught value) and finally fn*, each a template
2132+;; const, optionally wrapped in :make-closure + a :push-closed per capture.
2133+;; Each region is lambda-lifted to its own wasm function taking its captures
2134+;; as trailing params ($c0..), as lower_go does with closures + InvokeValueEC.
2135+;; Orchestration (wasm EH, current proposal: try_table/exnref):
2136+;; handler: catch $lgex around the body call; the payload is reified
2137+;; ($rt_reify) and passed to the handler, whose class dispatch
2138+;; rethrows on no match.
2139+;; finally: catch_all_ref around body(+handler); run finally then
2140+;; throw_ref the original exception (so a raw runtime error keeps
2141+;; its uncaught message), or run finally after a normal exit.
2142+(defn region-of [nid]
2143+ (loop [n (src-of nid) caps ()]
2144+ (case (ir/op n *f*)
2145+ :push-closed (let [[cls v] (ir/refs n *f*)] (recur (src-of cls) (cons v caps)))
2146+ :make-closure (recur (src-of (first (ir/refs n *f*))) caps)
2147+ (if (and (template? n) (= :fn-template (:kind (ir/aux n *f*))))
2148+ (let [{tfn :fn variadic? :variadic?} (ir/aux n *f*)]
2149+ (when variadic? (fail "unsupported variadic try region" {:fn *fname*}))
2150+ {:tfn tfn :caps (vec caps)})
2151+ (fail "unsupported :try region value" {:op (ir/op n *f*) :nid n :fn *fname*})))))
2152+
2153+(defn try-wat [nid]
2154+ (let [{:keys [has-handler has-finally]} (ir/aux nid *f*)
2155+ refs (ir/refs nid *f*)
2156+ k (ty nid) T (wt k) n (str nid)
2157+ region (fn [ref role params]
2158+ (let [{:keys [tfn caps]} (region-of ref)
2159+ cap-kinds (mapv ty caps)
2160+ info (assoc (binding [*box-params* true] (analyze-ir (str *fname* "__try" nid "_" role) tfn))
2161+ :caps cap-kinds :export? false :params params)]
2162+ (swap! *regions* conj (lower-fn info))
2163+ ;; (call-fn pre-arg to-kind); to-kind nil = the region's own result kind
2164+ (fn [pre to]
2165+ (str "(call $" (:name info) (when pre (str " " pre))
2166+ (apply str (map #(str " " (arg-as %1 %2)) caps cap-kinds)) ")"
2167+ (coerce (:ret info) (or to (:ret info)))))))
2168+ body-call ((region (nth refs 0) "body" []) nil k)
2169+ handler (when has-handler (region (nth refs 1) "catch" [:box]))
2170+ fin (when has-finally (region (nth refs (if has-handler 2 1)) "finally" []))
2171+ guarded (if handler
2172+ (str "(block $hd" n " (result " T ") "
2173+ (handler (str "(call $rt_reify (block $hc" n " (result (ref null eq)) (br $hd" n
2174+ " (try_table (result " T ") (catch $lgex $hc" n ") " body-call "))))") k)
2175+ ")")
2176+ body-call)]

2814+;; Shared with the P1.5 census, which must expand units exactly as the driver.
2815+(def core-minus #'clojure.core/-)
2816+
2817+(defn- binds-minus?
2818+ "Does a binding vector / param list (destructuring included) bind `-`?"
2819+ [b] (some #(= '- %) (tree-seq coll? seq b)))
2820+
2821+(defn neg
2822+ "Unary minus as the driver's rewrite emits it (unary-minus->unchecked);
2823+ the backend lowers calls to it itself (neg-wat). Native semantics."
2824+ [x] (- x))
2825+
2826+(defn unary-minus->unchecked
2827+ "D35: build.lg turns (- x) into (sub 0 x), which throws on MinInt64 where
2828+ native bytecode negates with a wrap. Rewrite unary core `-` to
2829+ (lower-wasm/neg x) before build so the IR path matches native: an int
2830+ negates with a wrap, a float flips its sign (P2.11 F9: the earlier
2831+ (unchecked-subtract 0 x) could not take a float, and gave 0.0 for -0.0).
2832+ Runs on macroexpanded forms; quoted data is left alone. A local named `-`
2833+ (let*/loop*/letfn* binding, fn* param or name, catch binding) shadows the
2834+ core fn in its scope and is never rewritten (P1.7 bug-04)."
2835+ ([form] (unary-minus->unchecked form false))
2836+ ([form shadowed]
2837+ (let [rw #(unary-minus->unchecked % shadowed)]
2838+ (cond
2839+ (and (seq? form) (= 'quote (first form))) form
2840+ ;; sequential bindings: an init sees the names bound before it
2841+ (and (seq? form) (#{'let* 'loop*} (first form)) (vector? (second form)))
2842+ (let [[bs sh] (reduce (fn [[acc sh] [n init]]
2843+ [(conj acc n (unary-minus->unchecked init sh)) (or sh (binds-minus? n))])
2844+ [[] shadowed] (partition 2 (second form)))]
2845+ (apply list (first form) bs (map #(unary-minus->unchecked % sh) (drop 2 form))))
2846+ ;; letfn*: every fn sees every name
2847+ (and (seq? form) (= 'letfn* (first form)) (vector? (second form)))
2848+ (let [sh (or shadowed (binds-minus? (take-nth 2 (second form))))]
2849+ (apply list 'letfn* (vec (map #(unary-minus->unchecked % sh) (second form)))
2850+ (map #(unary-minus->unchecked % sh) (drop 2 form))))
2851+ (and (seq? form) (= 'fn* (first form)))
2852+ (let [nm (when (symbol? (second form)) (second form))
2853+ sh (or shadowed (= '- nm))
2854+ arities (if nm (drop 2 form) (rest form))
2855+ arity (fn [[params & body]]
2856+ (apply list params (map #(unary-minus->unchecked % (or sh (binds-minus? params))) body)))]
2857+ (if (vector? (first arities))
2858+ (let [[params & body] arities]
2859+ (apply list (concat ['fn*] (when nm [nm]) [params]
2860+ (map #(unary-minus->unchecked % (or sh (binds-minus? params))) body))))
2861+ (apply list (concat ['fn*] (when nm [nm]) (map arity arities)))))
2862+ (and (seq? form) (= 'catch (first form)) (<= 3 (count form)))
2863+ (let [sh (or shadowed (= '- (nth form 2)))]
2864+ (apply list 'catch (second form) (nth form 2) (map #(unary-minus->unchecked % sh) (drop 3 form))))
2865+ (and (not shadowed) (seq? form) (= 2 (count form)) (symbol? (first form))
2866+ (= core-minus (resolve (first form))))
2867+ (list 'lower-wasm/neg (rw (second form)))
2868+ (seq? form) (apply list (map rw form))
2869+ (vector? form) (mapv rw form)
2870+ (map? form) (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(rw k) (rw v)]) form))
2871+ (set? form) (set (map rw form))
2872+ :else form))))
2873+
2874+(defn bare-try->do
2875+ "(try body...) with no catch or finally clause is a do: native compiles it
2876+ so, which is why recur is legal inside it (P1.7 bug-08), while ir.build
2877+ lambda-lifts every try region into a fn the recur cannot reach. A try
2878+ with a handler stays (native rejects recur there itself)."
2879+ [form]
2880+ (cond
2881+ (and (seq? form) (= 'quote (first form))) form
2882+ (and (seq? form) (= 'try (first form))
2883+ (not-any? #(and (seq? %) (#{'catch 'finally} (first %))) (rest form)))
2884+ (apply list 'do (map bare-try->do (rest form)))
2885+ (seq? form) (apply list (map bare-try->do form))
2886+ (vector? form) (mapv bare-try->do form)
2887+ (map? form) (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(bare-try->do k) (bare-try->do v)]) form))
2888+ :else form))
2889+
2890+(defn fold-literal-ifs
2891+ "(if <literal> a b) -> a or b. cond's `:else` arm expands to (if :else x
2892+ (cond)), and typeinfer does not fold a keyword test, so every cond would
2893+ otherwise join its result with nil and box it (the runtime's kind, every
2894+ dispatcher)."
2895+ [form]
2896+ (cond
2897+ (and (seq? form) (= 'quote (first form))) form
2898+ (and (seq? form) (= 'if (first form)) (<= 3 (count form) 4)
2899+ (let [t (second form)] (or (keyword? t) (string? t) (number? t) (true? t) (false? t) (nil? t))))
2900+ (let [t (second form)]
2901+ (if (or (false? t) (nil? t))
2902+ (fold-literal-ifs (if (= 4 (count form)) (nth form 3) nil))
2903+ (fold-literal-ifs (nth form 2))))
2904+ (seq? form) (apply list (map fold-literal-ifs form))
2905+ (vector? form) (mapv fold-literal-ifs form)
2906+ (map? form) (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(fold-literal-ifs k) (fold-literal-ifs v)]) form))
2907+ :else form))
2908+
2909+(defn seq-loop-bindings
2910+ "(loop* [a x b (f a)] ..) -> (let* [a x b (f a)] (loop* [a a b b] ..)) when
2911+ an init reads an earlier binding: loop's bindings are sequential, but
2912+ ir.build resolves loop* inits in the outer scope (`unresolved symbol`,
2913+ phm_test's shuffle-lcg). Upstream ir.build finding; worked around here."
2914+ [form]
2915+ (cond
2916+ (and (seq? form) (= 'quote (first form))) form
2917+ (and (seq? form) (= 'loop* (first form)) (vector? (second form)))
2918+ (let [bs (second form) pairs (partition 2 bs)
2919+ names (map first pairs)
2920+ refs? (some (fn [i] (let [earlier (set (take i names))
2921+ init (second (nth pairs i))]
2922+ (some #(contains? earlier %) (filter symbol? (tree-seq coll? seq init)))))
2923+ (range 1 (count pairs)))
2924+ body (map seq-loop-bindings (drop 2 form))
2925+ bs' (vec (mapcat (fn [[n i]] [n (seq-loop-bindings i)]) pairs))]
2926+ (if refs?
2927+ (list 'let* bs' (apply list 'loop* (vec (mapcat (fn [n] [n n]) names)) body))
2928+ (apply list 'loop* bs' body)))
2929+ (seq? form) (apply list (map seq-loop-bindings form))
2930+ (vector? form) (mapv seq-loop-bindings form)
2931+ (map? form) (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(seq-loop-bindings k) (seq-loop-bindings v)]) form))
2932+ :else form))
2933+
2934+(defn expand-form
2935+ "Macroexpand one form as the driver does before ir.build (D23, D35)."
2936+ [form] (seq-loop-bindings (fold-literal-ifs (bare-try->do (unary-minus->unchecked (binding-out (p/expand-all form)))))))
2937+
2938+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2939+;; The runtime compiled through the backend (P2.1). Runtime defns are
2940+;; analysed on demand, callees first (a source scan of each body), so
2941+;; typeinfer sees a callee's return type at the caller (the hook below) and
2942+;; only what the program can reach is compiled; lowering waits until every
2943+;; analysis is done (session-module), so mutual recursion still finds sigs.
2944+
2945+;; vars the backend lowers itself: a reference to one pulls in no runtime
2946+;; defn. The IR-op core fns (ir.build makes them ops at their op arity) are
2947+;; here too: scanning `=` as the twin wasm.seq/equals would analyse equiv?
2948+;; while kind, which compares with =, is still in progress.
2949+(def intercepted (into #{#'neg #'println #'throw #'catch-matches? #'atom #'deref #'reset! #'swap!
2950+ #'vector #'hash-set #'array-map #'hash-map #'wasm.seq/float-bits
2951+ #'= #'bit-and #'bit-or #'bit-xor #'bit-and-not #'bit-not #'bit-shift-left
2952+ #'bit-shift-right #'unsigned-bit-shift-right #'unchecked-add
2953+ #'unchecked-subtract #'unchecked-multiply #'quot #'/}
2954+ (concat (keys core-var-ops) (keys core-fn-impls))))
2955+
2956+(defn rt-target
2957+ "The runtime defn var that implements v (v itself, or its twin), or nil."
2958+ [v]
2959+ (when (and *rt* (var? v))
2960+ (cond (contains? lw-rt/defn-by-var v) v
2961+ ;; P3.2: backend fills win over a runtime twin (let-go.core/now)
2962+ (contains? lw-rt/ext-twins v) (lw-rt/ext-twins v)
2963+ (lw-rt/twin-of v) (lw-rt/twin-of v)
2964+ (contains? lw-rt/core-defns v) v
2965+ (contains? lw-rt/ext-defns v) v
2966+ (contains? @lw-rt/lib-defns v) v
2967+ ;; P2.14: lg-defined stdlib namespaces, loaded on demand
2968+ (lw-rt/stdlib-twin v) (lw-rt/stdlib-twin v)
2969+ (lw-rt/stdlib-defn v) v
2970+ :else nil)))
2971+
2972+(defn qual-name [v] (subs (str v) 2))
2973+(defn rt-fn-name [v argc multi?] (str (qual-name v) (when multi? (str "#" argc))))
2974+
2975+(defn form-vars [form]
2976+ (let [syms (distinct (filter symbol? (tree-seq coll? seq form)))]
2977+ (keep #(let [r (try (resolve %) (catch e nil))] (when (var? r) r)) syms)))
2978+
2979+(declare rt-analyze! rt-global!)
2980+
2981+(defn analyze-deps! [form]
2982+ (when *rt*
2983+ (when (some #{#'neg} (form-vars form)) (rt-analyze! #'wasm.core/sub))
2984+ (when (some #(contains? coll-ctors %) (form-vars form))
2985+ (doseq [v [#'wasm.pvec/vconj #'wasm.pvec/empty-vec #'wasm.pvec/varray #'wasm.phs/sconj #'wasm.phs/empty-set
2986+ #'wasm.core/assoc #'wasm.phm/empty-map]]
2987+ (rt-analyze! v)))
2988+ (doseq [v (form-vars form) :when (not (contains? intercepted v))]
2989+ (when-let [t (rt-target v)] (rt-analyze! t))
2990+ (when (contains? lw-rt/global-by-var v) (rt-global! v)))))
2991+
2992+(declare rt-analyze*!)
2993+
2994+(defn rt-analyze!
2995+ "Analyse every arity of runtime defn v (callees first) and register its
2996+ sig. An lg-defined core fn that does not compile is marked :failed and
2997+ left out (its calls go through a nil slot, as before P2.1)."
2998+ [v]
2999+ (when (and *rt* (not (get-in @*rt* [:state v])))
3000+ (if (:core-lg (lw-rt/source-defn v))
3001+ (try (rt-analyze*! v)
3002+ (catch e (swap! *rt* assoc-in [:state v] :failed)
3003+ (swap! *sigs* dissoc v)
3004+ (swap! *rt* update :failures (fnil conj []) [(qual-name v) (ex-message e)])))
3005+ (if (:lib (lw-rt/source-defn v))
3006+ ;; P3.2: name the library defn (callers first) in a compile error
3007+ (try (rt-analyze*! v)
3008+ (catch e (throw (ex-info (str "in " (qual-name v) ": " (ex-message e)) (or (ex-data e) {}) e))))
3009+ (rt-analyze*! v)))))
3010+
3011+(defn rt-analyze*!
3012+ [v]
3013+ (when (and *rt* (not (get-in @*rt* [:state v])))
3014+ (swap! *rt* assoc-in [:state v] :busy)
3015+ (let [d (lw-rt/source-defn v)
3016+ multi? (> (count (:arities d)) 1)]
3017+ (binding [*ns* (the-ns (:ns d))]
3018+ (let [srcs (doall (for [[params & body] (:arities d)
3019+ :let [[params body] (split-rest-pattern params body)]]
3020+ ;; a namespace init (driver, P3.2) arrives expanded
3021+ (apply list 'defn (:name d) params (if (:pre-expanded d) body (map expand-form body)))))]
3022+ (doseq [s srcs] (analyze-deps! s))
3023+ (doseq [s srcs]
3024+ ;; P2.12 (amends D78): a variadic arity is `<name>#v` (or the
3025+ ;; defn's own name when it is the only arity), registered as the
3026+ ;; sig's :variadic entry with its fixed-arg count
3027+ (let [params (nth s 2)
3028+ var? (variadic-params? params)
3029+ argc (if var? "v" (count params))
3030+ ;; P3.2: a library defn's params stay boxed. Its callers
3031+ ;; are not covered by the driver's param-typing fixpoint,
3032+ ;; and typeinfer types a param :int from int ops alone, so
3033+ ;; a float or nil argument would hit the unbox error
3034+ info (assoc (binding [*box-params* (boolean (:lib d))]
3035+ (analyze-fn s (rt-fn-name v argc multi?) multi?))
3036+ :export? false :lib (:lib d))]
3037+ (swap! *sigs* update v (fn [e] (let [e (or e {:multi? multi? :base (str (:name d)) :var v})
3038+ sig (select-keys info [:name :params :ret])]
3039+ (if var?
3040+ (assoc e :variadic (assoc sig :fixed (fixed-count params)))
3041+ (assoc-in e [:arities argc] sig)))))
3042+ (swap! *rt* update :pending conj info))))))
3043+ (swap! *rt* assoc-in [:state v] :done)))
3044+
3045+(defn callee-sig
3046+ "The sig entry for a call of v: a program defn, or (analysing it now if
3047+ need be) the runtime defn that implements v."
3048+ [v]
3049+ (or (get @*sigs* v)
3050+ (when-let [t (rt-target v)] (rt-analyze! t) (get @*sigs* t))))

3052+(defn rt-init-fn!
3053+ "Analyse a 0-arg init fn named wname whose body is form, in ns."
3054+ [wname ns form]
3055+ (binding [*ns* (the-ns ns)]
3056+ (let [src (list 'defn '__init [] (expand-form form))]
3057+ (analyze-deps! src)
3058+ (swap! *rt* update :pending conj (assoc (analyze-fn src wname true) :export? false)))))
3059+
3060+(defn rt-global!
3061+ "The wasm global of a runtime top-level def (D39), its init fn analysed."
3062+ [v]
3063+ (let [g (str "$" (qual-name v))]
3064+ (when-not (get-in @*rt* [:globals v])
3065+ (swap! *rt* assoc-in [:globals v] {:name g :init (str (qual-name v) "__init") :order (count (:globals @*rt*))})
3066+ (let [{:keys [ns init]} (lw-rt/global-by-var v)]
3067+ (rt-init-fn! (str (qual-name v) "__init") ns init)))
3068+ g))

3072+(defn- plain-data? [x]
3073+ (or (nil? x) (string? x) (number? x) (keyword? x) (symbol? x) (boolean? x)
3074+ (and (or (vector? x) (seq? x) (set? x)) (every? plain-data? x))
3075+ (and (map? x) (every? plain-data? (keys x)) (every? plain-data? (vals x)))))
3076+
3077+(defn var-const-form
3078+ "P2.14 (D112): a var as a value, (var x) or #'x. The backend has no Var
3079+ kind; a var is stood in by an interned constant: the Symbol #'ns/name
3080+ (it prints as the var does) carrying the var's metadata, so it is equal
3081+ only to itself (D69: a meta'd symbol compares by identity) and (meta v)
3082+ reads :name :ns :file :line etc. :ns is the namespace stand-in
3083+ lw-ext/find-ns-v returns (the Symbol `<ns name>`); meta values that are
3084+ not plain data (a :test fn) are left out. Deref, var-get and calling the
3085+ var are named limits: use the name, whose value the var table holds."
3086+ [v]
3087+ (let [m (meta v)
3088+ m (cond-> (into {} (for [[k x] (dissoc m :ns) :when (plain-data? x)] [k x]))
3089+ (:ns m) (assoc :ns (symbol (str "<ns " (ns-name (:ns m)) ">"))))]
3090+ (list 'wasm.core/with-meta
3091+ (list 'wasm.str/sym-of-bytes (list 'wasm.intrinsics/bytes-of-string (str "#'" (subs (str v) 2))))
3092+ (const-form m))))
3093+
3094+(defn const-form
3095+ "A form that builds constant v through the runtime's constructors."
3096+ [v]
3097+ (cond
3098+ (var? v) (var-const-form v)
3099+ ;; P2.14: a regex stand-in keeps its pattern in its metadata
3100+ (and (symbol? v) (:lw/regex (meta v)))
3101+ ;; (str v): natively `namespace` refuses a meta'd symbol
3102+ (list 'wasm.core/with-meta (list 'wasm.str/sym-of-bytes (list 'wasm.intrinsics/bytes-of-string (str v)))
3103+ (const-form (meta v)))
3104+ (vector? v) (list 'wasm.pvec/varray (reduce (fn [acc x] (list 'wasm.pvec/vconj acc (const-form x))) '(wasm.pvec/empty-vec) v))
3105+ (map? v) (reduce (fn [acc [k x]] (list 'wasm.core/assoc acc (const-form k) (const-form x))) '(wasm.phm/empty-map) v)
3106+ (set? v) (reduce (fn [acc x] (list 'wasm.phs/sconj acc (const-form x))) '(wasm.phs/empty-set) v)
3107+ (seq? v) (let [xs (vec v)]
3108+ (loop [i (dec (count xs)) acc '(wasm.seq/empty-list)]
3109+ (if (< i 0)
3110+ acc
3111+ (recur (dec i) (list 'wasm.intrinsics/new 'wasm.seq/List (const-form (xs i)) acc
3112+ (- (count xs) i) '(wasm.intrinsics/null))))))
3113+ (symbol? v) (list 'wasm.str/sym-of-bytes (list 'wasm.intrinsics/bytes-of-string (named-text v)))
3114+ (keyword? v) (list 'wasm.str/kw-of-bytes (list 'wasm.intrinsics/bytes-of-string (named-text v)))
3115+ :else v))

3117+(defn const-global!
3118+ "A runtime-built constant (keyword, symbol, vector, map, set, list): one
3119+ global, built once by _rt_init (D63's placeholders made real)."
3120+ [v]
3121+ (let [k [(const-kind v) (pr-str v)]]
3122+ (or (get-in @*rt* [:consts k])
3123+ (let [i (hex32 (pr-str k)) g (str "$const_" i)]
3124+ (swap! *rt* assoc-in [:consts k] g)
3125+ (rt-init-fn! (str "const_" i "__init") 'wasm.core (const-form v))
3126+ (swap! *rt* update :const-order conj g)
3127+ g))))

3129+(defn slot-kind [t] (case t (:i64 :i32 :i8) :int :f64 :float :ref :box :funcref :func))
3130+(defn slot-wt [t] (case t :i64 "i64" (:i32 :i8) "i32" :f64 "f64" :ref "(ref null eq)" :funcref "funcref"))

3132+(defn funcref-wrapper
3133+ "A function of declared type tn (a deffunc) that calls defn fv: what
3134+ (wasm/funcref tn fv) refers to. The defn itself has its own (typed) sig,
3135+ and a func type outside the rec group would not be tn anyway."
3136+ [tn d fv]
3137+ (or (get @*fn-values* [:ref tn fv])
3138+ (let [argc (count (:params d)) ent (callee-sig fv) s (get-in ent [:arities argc])]
3139+ (when-not s (fail "wasm/funcref target has no arity for the signature" {:var fv :sig tn :fn *fname*}))
3140+ (let [w (str (:name s) "__ref" (subs tn 1))]
3141+ (swap! *fn-values* assoc [:ref tn fv] w)
3142+ (swap! *elem* conj w)
3143+ (swap! *regions* conj
3144+ (str "(func $" w " (type " tn ")"
3145+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i t] (str " (param $p" i " " (slot-wt t) ")")) (:params d)))
3146+ " (result " (slot-wt (:result d)) ") (local $tmp i64)\n (call $" (:name s)
3147+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i t] (str " (local.get $p" i ")" (coerce (slot-kind t) (nth (:params s) i))))
3148+ (:params d)))
3149+ ")" (coerce (:ret s) (slot-kind (:result d))) ")"))
3150+ w))))

3152+(defn box-wrapper
3153+ "Text of $<name>#<argc>__box: runtime defn v's arity argc with every param
3154+ and the result boxed, for the backend's hand-written helpers."
3155+ [v argc]
3156+ (let [s (get-in (callee-sig v) [:arities argc])]
3157+ (when-not s (fail "box wrapper: no such arity" {:var v :argc argc}))
3158+ (str "(func $" (qual-name v) "#" argc "__box"
3159+ (apply str (map #(str " (param $p" % " (ref null eq))") (range argc)))
3160+ " (result (ref null eq)) (local $tmp i64)\n (call $" (:name s)
3161+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i k] (str " (local.get $p" i ")" (coerce :box k))) (:params s)))
3162+ ")" (coerce (:ret s) :box) ")")))

3164+(defn lw-call-type
3165+ "typeinfer hook: an intrinsic's declared result type, or the return type
3166+ of an already-analysed defn (program or runtime) at its arity."
3167+ [inst f]
3168+ (binding [*f* f *memo* (atom {})]
3169+ (let [refs (ir/refs inst f) c (first refs)]
3170+ (when (and c (= :load-var (ir/op c f)))
3171+ (let [v (ir/aux c f) args (rest refs)]
3172+ (cond (lw-rt/intrinsic? v) (intrinsic-type v args)
3173+ (and (= v #'neg) (= 1 (count args)))
3174+ (let [t (ir/type-of (first args) f) t (if (and (vector? t) (= :const (first t))) (second t) t)]
3175+ (when (contains? #{:int :float} t) t))
3176+ (and *rt* (= v #'wasm.seq/float-bits)) :int
3177+ :else (let [ent (or (get @*sigs* v) (when-let [t (rt-target v)] (get @*sigs* t)))
3178+ r (:ret (get-in ent [:arities (count args)]))]
3179+ (case r :int :int :bool :bool :float :float nil))))))))

3181+(alter-var-root #'ir.passes.typeinfer/call-declared-type
3182+ (fn [orig] (fn [inst f] (or (lw-call-type inst f) (orig inst f)))))
3183+
3184+;; P1.7 (bug-02/03): the shared purity catalog (ir.passes.purity, also read
3185+;; by lower-go) declares + - * inc dec and the comparisons, bit ops and
3186+;; unchecked ops value-pure, and only :quot trapping. Natively every one of
3187+;; them can raise: + - * inc dec overflow, quot and / divide by zero, and all
3188+;; of them throw on a non-number operand. So DCE dropped an unused overflowing
3189+;; (+ x 1) and LICM hoisted (+ x 1) / (quot 10 x) out of a zero-trip loop.
3190+;; Pinned here rather than by editing the catalog (read-only upstream):
3191+;; - DCE: an op that may raise is not effect-free. The checked ops always may;
3192+;; the others only when an operand is not typed numeric.
3193+;; - LICM: no op that may raise is hoisted (hoisting is speculative: the
3194+;; loop may run zero times). Conservative on purpose, types or not.
3195+;; CSE stays as is: it only merges same-block duplicates, and the surviving
3196+;; first copy raises exactly where the original did.
3197+(def checked-ops #{:add :sub :mul :inc :dec :quot :div})
3198+(def may-raise-ops
3199+ (into checked-ops #{:lt :lte :gt :gte :bit-and :bit-or :bit-xor :bit-and-not :bit-not
3200+ :bit-shift-left :bit-shift-right :unsigned-bit-shift-right
3201+ :unchecked-add :unchecked-sub :unchecked-mul}))
3202+
3203+(defn- numeric-typed?
3204+ "Is operand r proven numeric? A param's type is not proof: infer-arg-types
3205+ types a param :int from the very op asking (`(< x 1)`), so deleting that
3206+ op would delete the only evidence and the param would come back boxed and
3207+ accept nil. An op straight on a param is therefore kept."
3208+ [r f]
3209+ (let [t (ir/type-of r f)]
3210+ (and (not= :load-arg (ir/op r f))
3211+ (or (contains? #{:int :float} t)
3212+ (and (vector? t) (= :const (first t)) (contains? #{:int :float} (second t)))))))
3213+
3214+(defn may-raise? [f nid]
3215+ (let [op (ir/op nid f)]
3216+ (or (contains? checked-ops op)
3217+ (and (contains? may-raise-ops op)
3218+ (not (every? #(numeric-typed? % f) (ir/refs nid f)))))))
3219+
3220+(alter-var-root #'ir.passes.purity/effect-free-inst?
3221+ (fn [orig] (fn [f nid var-facts] (and (orig f nid var-facts) (not (may-raise? f nid))))))
3222+(alter-var-root #'ir.passes.licm/pure-op?
3223+ (fn [orig] (fn [op] (and (orig op) (not (contains? may-raise-ops op))))))
3224+
3225+;; P2.11 (F2/F5): CSE keyed :const insts by (op refs aux) with `=`, merging
3226+;; [] with () and 0.0 with -0.0 inside one fn; and it merges equal :calls of
3227+;; the "pure" builtins (vector, list, hash-map, conj, ex-info, ...), each of
3228+;; which allocates natively: (= (vector nan) (vector nan)) is false because
3229+;; the two vectors are distinct objects (no identity shortcut, NaN elements),
3230+;; and merging them made it true. A :call's key carries its own id, so calls
3231+;; are never merged. Upstream IR findings.
3232+(let [ik (get (ns-interns 'ir.passes.cse) 'inst-key)]
3233+ (alter-var-root ik (fn [orig] (fn [nid f]
3234+ (let [[op refs aux] (orig nid f)]
3235+ (case op
3236+ :const [op refs (strict-key aux)]
3237+ :call [op refs aux nid]
3238+ [op refs aux]))))))
3239+
3240+;; P2.11 (F4 corpus nan-arith): constfold's algebraic identities ((+ x 0),
3241+;; (* x 1), (* x 0) -> 0, (- x 0), the bit-op ones) hold only for an int x:
3242+;; (* inf 0) is NaN, (+ -0.0 0) is 0.0, (+ nil 0) throws. They now fire only
3243+;; when the non-constant operand is typed :int. Upstream finding (D94 noted
3244+;; the non-number half).
3245+(let [ti (get (ns-interns 'ir.passes.constfold) 'try-identity)]
3246+ (alter-var-root ti (fn [orig] (fn [nid f]
3247+ (let [int-t? (fn [r] (let [t (ir/type-of r f)]
3248+ (or (= :int t) (and (vector? t) (= :const (first t)) (= :int (second t))))))]
3249+ (when (every? #(or (= :const (ir/op % f)) (int-t? %)) (ir/refs nid f))
3250+ (orig nid f)))))))
3251+
3252+;; P1.7 (bug-01): infer-arg-types types a param :int from its uses (+ x 1),
3253+;; which makes the wasm signature i64, so a caller holding nil or a string
3254+;; had to unbox it before the call (the uncatchable bare-cast trap). Analysing
3255+;; with this bound true leaves every param :unknown (boxed): the driver binds it
3256+;; for a program defn whose callers do not all pass ints, and lowering binds it
3257+;; for closure code and try regions, whose params are boxed by the ABI.
3258+;; P2.11 (F1): ir.build's closure captures are keyed by local NAME, and two
3259+;; steps of it lose scoping (read-only upstream, so pinned here):
3260+;; - free-vars' fn* case walks the body with only the fn's own params as
3261+;; bound, dropping the enclosing scope, so in (fn [i] (fn [x] (+ x i)))
3262+;; the inner fn's `i` bubbles out as free in the OUTER fn, which then
3263+;; captures whatever `i` the enclosing function has in scope (a finished
3264+;; loop's counter in _main). A fn*'s frees minus the bound set is exact.
3265+;; - build-inner-fn-template binds the captures after the params in the
3266+;; same frame, so a capture named like a param overwrites it (a
3267+;; multi-arity fn shares one capture list across arities, so one
3268+;; arity's capture can be another's param). Native: the param wins. The
3269+;; clashing capture keeps its slot under a name no form can spell.
3270+;; Upstream IR finding (lower-go shares the builder).
3271+(let [fv (get (ns-interns 'ir.build) 'free-vars)]
3272+ (alter-var-root fv (fn [orig] (fn [form bound]
3273+ (let [r (orig form bound)]
3274+ (if (and (seq? form) (= 'fn* (first form)))
3275+ (into #{} (remove bound r))
3276+ r))))))
3277+(let [bt (get (ns-interns 'ir.build) 'build-inner-fn-template)]
3278+ (alter-var-root bt (fn [orig] (fn [name-sym args-vec body-forms capture-syms variadic?]
3279+ (let [params (set args-vec)]
3280+ (orig name-sym args-vec body-forms
3281+ (mapv #(if (contains? params %) (symbol (str "__lw_shadowed " %)) %) capture-syms)
3282+ variadic?))))))
3283+
3284+(defn- infer-arg-types-skipping
3285+ "infer-arg-types' two-arity body, leaving the params in *box-param-idx*
3286+ unjoined (boxed)."
3287+ [infer-one f state]
3288+ (reduce (fn [s nid]
3289+ (if (= :load-arg (ir/op nid f))
3290+ (let [idx (ir/aux nid f)
3291+ arg-types (ir/fn-arg-types f)
3292+ explicit (when (and (vector? arg-types) (< (int idx) (count arg-types))) (nth arg-types (int idx)))
3293+ inferred (if (or (contains? *box-param-idx* idx) (and explicit (not= explicit :unknown)))
3294+ :unknown
3295+ (infer-one f nid))]
3296+ (if (= :unknown inferred) s (lat/join-inst-type! s nid inferred)))
3297+ s))
3298+ state (ir/block-insts (ir/entry-block f) f)))
3299+
3300+(let [infer-one (get (ns-interns 'ir.passes.infer-arg-types) 'infer-one-load-arg)]
3301+ (alter-var-root #'ir.passes.infer-arg-types/infer-arg-types
3302+ (fn [orig] (fn ([f] (orig f))
3303+ ([f state] (cond *box-params* state
3304+ (seq *box-param-idx*) (infer-arg-types-skipping @infer-one f state)
3305+ :else (orig f state)))))))

3307+(defn new-session
3308+ "The module-wide state lowering accumulates (strings, lifted regions,
3309+ globals, env types, fn values, extern var slots). opts :rt true compiles
3310+ the runtime into the module (the driver's default, P2.1); :shake false
3311+ compiles every runtime defn and keeps every helper (size measurement)."
3312+ ([sigs var-globals] (new-session sigs var-globals {}))
3313+ ([sigs var-globals opts]
3314+ {:sigs (atom sigs) :var-globals var-globals :strings (atom {}) :regions (atom []) :globals (atom [])
3315+ :elem (atom #{}) :env-types (atom {}) :fn-values (atom {}) :externs (atom {})
3316+ :rt (when (:rt opts) (atom {:state {} :pending [] :lowered {} :globals {} :consts {} :const-order []}))
3317+ :shake (not= false (:shake opts)) :trap-throws (boolean (:trap-throws opts)) :prog-decls (atom {})
3318+ :invoke-max (atom max-arity)}))

3323+(defn with-session* [ss thunk]
3324+ (binding [*sigs* (:sigs ss) *var-globals* (:var-globals ss) *strings* (:strings ss)
3325+ *regions* (:regions ss) *globals* (:globals ss) *elem* (:elem ss)
3326+ *env-types* (:env-types ss) *fn-values* (:fn-values ss) *externs* (:externs ss)
3327+ *rt* (:rt ss) *shake* (:shake ss) *trap-throws* (:trap-throws ss)
3328+ *prog-decls* (or (:prog-decls ss) (atom {}))
3329+ *invoke-max* (or (:invoke-max ss) (atom max-arity))]
3330+ (thunk)))

3332+(defn top-forms
3333+ "Split WAT text into its top-level parenthesised forms (strings with
3334+ escapes and ;; comments are skipped over, so a paren inside either does
3335+ not count). Text outside any form is dropped."
3336+ [text]
3337+ (let [n (count text)]
3338+ (loop [i 0 depth 0 start 0 in-str false out (transient [])]
3339+ (if (>= i n)
3340+ (persistent! out)
3341+ (let [c (nth text i)]
3342+ (cond
3343+ in-str (cond (= c \\) (recur (+ i 2) depth start true out)
3344+ (= c \") (recur (inc i) depth start false out)
3345+ :else (recur (inc i) depth start true out))
3346+ (= c \") (recur (inc i) depth start true out)
3347+ (and (= c \;) (< (inc i) n) (= \; (nth text (inc i))))
3348+ (let [e (or (str/index-of text "\n" i) n)] (recur e depth start false out))
3349+ (= c \() (recur (inc i) (inc depth) (if (zero? depth) i start) false out)
3350+ (= c \)) (if (= depth 1)
3351+ (recur (inc i) 0 start false (conj! out (subs text start (inc i))))
3352+ (recur (inc i) (dec depth) start false out))
3353+ :else (recur (inc i) depth start false out)))))))

3355+(def wat-id #"\$[A-Za-z0-9!#%&'*+./:<=>?@^_`|~-]+")
3356+(defn refs-of [t] (set (re-seq wat-id t)))
3357+
3358+(defn field-wt [tn i f]
3359+ (let [t (if-let [c (get-in funcref-fields [tn i])] (str "(ref null " c ")") (slot-wt (:type f)))]
3360+ (if (:mut f) (str "(mut " t ")") t)))
3361+
3362+(defn fnv-types
3363+ "P2.12: $FnV (a $Fn plus its variadic code and fixed-arg count) and the
3364+ one code type rt/ lacks, $Code5 (a variadic arity with 4 fixed args)."
3365+ []
3366+ (let [fn-decl (:decl (first (filter #(= "$Fn" (lw-rt/type-name (:var %))) lw-rt/decls)))]
3367+ (str " (type $FnV (sub final $Fn (struct"
3368+ (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i f] (str " (field " (field-wt "$Fn" i f) ")")) (:fields fn-decl)))
3369+ " (field funcref) (field i32))))\n"
3370+ " (type $Code5 (func" (apply str (repeat 6 " (param (ref null eq))")) " (result (ref null eq))))\n")))
3371+
3372+(defn rec-group
3373+ "ONE rec group (D25): every runtime declaration (lw-rt, source order),
3374+ then the backend's closure env structs (D52 note 6: kept distinct)."
3375+ []
3376+ (str "(rec\n"
3377+ (apply str
3378+ (for [{:keys [tn decl]} (concat (for [d lw-rt/decls] {:tn (lw-rt/type-name (:var d)) :decl (:decl d)})
3379+ (for [[_ d] (sort-by (comp :order val) @*prog-decls*)] {:tn (:name d) :decl (:decl d)}))
3380+ :let [k (:wasm.intrinsics/kind decl)]]
3381+ (str " (type " tn " "
3382+ (case k
3383+ ;; P2.12: $Fn is open, so the backend's $FnV can extend it
3384+ :struct (let [st (str "(struct" (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i f] (str " (field " (field-wt tn i f) ")")) (:fields decl))) ")")]
3385+ (if (= tn "$Fn") (str "(sub " st ")") st))
3386+ :array (str "(array (mut " (if (= :i8 (:elem decl)) "i8" (slot-wt (:elem decl))) "))")
3387+ :func (str "(func" (apply str (map #(str " (param " (slot-wt %) ")") (:params decl)))
3388+ " (result " (slot-wt (:result decl)) "))"))
3389+ ")\n")))
3390+ (fnv-types)
3391+ (apply str (for [[kinds t] (sort-by val @*env-types*)]
3392+ (str " (type " t " (struct" (apply str (map #(str " (field " (wt %) ")") kinds)) "))\n")))
3393+ ")\n"))
3394+
3395+(defn form-name
3396+ "The $name a shakeable top-level form defines (func, import, global,
3397+ data), or nil."
3398+ [f]
3399+ (or (second (re-find #"^\(func (\$[^\s()]+)" f))
3400+ (second (re-find #"^\(import \"[^\"]*\" \"[^\"]*\" \(func (\$[^\s()]+)" f))
3401+ (second (re-find #"^\(global (\$[^\s()]+)" f))
3402+ (second (re-find #"^\(data (\$[^\s()]+)" f))))
