3404+(defn live-set
3405+ "Names reachable from roots over items (name -> text) plus extra deps
3406+ (name -> [name ...])."
3407+ [items deps roots]
3408+ (loop [todo (vec (filter items roots)) live #{}]
3409+ (if (empty? todo)
3410+ live
3411+ (let [nm (peek todo) todo (pop todo)]
3412+ (if (contains? live nm)
3413+ (recur todo live)
3414+ (recur (into todo (filter items (concat (refs-of (items nm)) (get deps nm)))) (conj live nm)))))))
3415+
3416+(defn rt-global-items
3417+ "name -> decl text and name -> deps for the runtime's globals and constants."
3418+ []
3419+ (let [st @*rt*
3420+ gs (concat (for [[v {:keys [name init]}] (:globals st)] [name init (= v #'wasm.seq/hooks)])
3421+ (for [g (vals (:consts st))] [g (str (subs g 1) "__init") false]))]
3422+ [(into {} (for [[g] gs] [g (str "(global " g " (mut (ref null eq)) (ref.null none))")]))
3423+ (into {} (for [[g init hooks?] gs] [g (cond-> [(str "$" init)] hooks? (conj "$wasm.core/install!"))]))]))
3424+
3425+(defn rt-reached?
3426+ "Does the program (its fns, transitively through lifted regions and
3427+ fn-value globals) reach any runtime fn, global or constant? If not, the
3428+ helpers are generated without their runtime paths (printing through
3429+ print-str, keyword/map calls), so a scalar program's module stays small
3430+ (D64: module size is a perf input) even though the runtime library is
3431+ loaded."
3432+ [items rt-names program]
3433+ (boolean (some rt-names (live-set items {} (refs-of program)))))
3434+
3435+(defn by-name [texts] (into {} (map (fn [t] [(form-name t) t]) texts)))
3436+
3437+(defn module-parts
3438+ "The pieces session-module assembles. Only the program's own fns (and its
3439+ var table) are roots; every helper, runtime fn, lifted region, fn-value
3440+ global, constant and data segment is kept only if something live reaches
3441+ it (D64: module size is a perf input)."
3442+ [fns]
3443+ (let [[gitems gdeps] (if *rt* (rt-global-items) [{} {}])
3444+ externs (into {} (for [g (vals @*externs*)] [g (str "(global " g " (mut (ref null eq)) (ref.null none))")]))
3445+ vars (for [g (sort (vals *var-globals*))]
3446+ (str "(global " g " (mut (ref null eq)) (ref.null none))\n"))
3447+ program (str (apply str vars) (str/join "\n" fns))
3448+ base-items (merge (when *rt* (:lowered @*rt*)) gitems (by-name @*globals*) (by-name @*regions*) externs)
3449+ ;; a program that catches exceptions or makes atoms may print one, and
3450+ ;; only the runtime's printer prints those (P1.7 gap-02)
3451+ rt? (and *rt* (or (rt-reached? base-items (set (concat (keys (:lowered @*rt*)) (keys gitems))) program)
3452+ (some #(re-find #"\$rt_reify|struct\.new \$Atom" %)
3453+ (cons program (keep base-items (live-set base-items {} (refs-of program)))))))
3454+ helper-forms (top-forms (binding [*rt* (when rt? *rt*)] (runtime)))
3455+ ;; after the helpers: generating them registers their strings
3456+ datas (into {} (for [[s nm] @*strings*] [nm (str "(data " nm " \"" (wat-bytes s) "\")")]))
3457+ base-items (merge base-items datas)
3458+ exported? (fn [f] (re-find #"^\(func \$[^\s()]+ \(export " f))
3459+ item-forms (filter #(and (form-name %) (not (exported? %))
3460+ (not (re-find #"^\(global \$(true|false|trap_msg) " %))
3461+ (not (re-find #"^\(data \(" %))) helper-forms)
3462+ fixed-forms (remove (set item-forms) helper-forms)
3463+ items (merge (by-name item-forms) base-items)
3464+ roots (into (refs-of program) (mapcat refs-of fixed-forms))
3465+ live (if *shake* (live-set items gdeps roots) (set (keys items)))]
3466+ {:fixed fixed-forms :items items :live live :program program}))
3467+
3468+(defn stub-fn
3469+ "A runtime fn that failed to lower: same signature, throws a named error,
3470+ so callers already lowered against its sig still validate."
3471+ [{:keys [name params ret]} msg]
3472+ (let [m (str "lower-wasm: " name " did not compile (" msg ")")]
3473+ (str "(func $" name (apply str (map-indexed (fn [i k] (str " (param $p" i " " (wt k) ")")) params))
3474+ " (result " (wt ret) ")\n (throw $lgex " (rt-error-wat m m) "))")))
3475+
3476+;; P2.14: the driver's --test mode binds this, so a library fn (a test's
3477+;; helper namespace) that does not lower becomes a stub like a runtime fn:
3478+;; the tests that call it report an ERROR instead of the file not compiling
3479+(def ^:dynamic *stub-libs* false)
3480+
3481+(defn lower-pending!
3482+ "Lower one pending runtime fn into :lowered (a stub if it fails)."
3483+ [info]
3484+ (swap! *rt* assoc-in [:lowered (str "$" (:name info))]
3485+ ;; P3.2: a program library fn fails the compile (no stub)
3486+ (if (and (:lib info) (not *stub-libs*))
3487+ (lower-fn info)
3488+ (try (lower-fn info)
3489+ (catch e (swap! *rt* update :failures (fnil conj []) [(:name info) (ex-message e)])
3490+ (stub-fn info (subs (str (ex-message e)) 0 (min 80 (count (str (ex-message e)))))))))))
3491+
3492+(def box-ref #"\$([^\s()#]+)#([0-9]+)__box")
3493+
3494+(defn rt-fixpoint!
3495+ "Lower pending runtime fns, then compile what the live helpers and globals
3496+ ask for (boxed wrappers, install!), until nothing new appears."
3497+ [fns]
3498+ (loop [n 0]
3499+ (when (> n 50) (fail "runtime fixpoint did not converge" {}))
3500+ (while (seq (:pending @*rt*))
3501+ (let [info (first (:pending @*rt*))]
3502+ (swap! *rt* update :pending (comp vec rest))
3503+ (lower-pending! info)))
3504+ (let [{:keys [items live]} (module-parts fns)
3505+ live-text (apply str (map items live))
3506+ wants (distinct (for [[_ q argc] (re-seq box-ref live-text)
3507+ :let [nm (str "$" q "#" argc "__box")]
3508+ :when (not (contains? (:lowered @*rt*) nm))]
3509+ [nm (resolve (symbol q)) (parse-long argc)]))
3510+ need-install (and (contains? live "$wasm.seq/hooks") (not (get-in @*rt* [:state #'wasm.core/install!])))]
3511+ (doseq [[nm v argc] wants]
3512+ (when-not v (fail "box wrapper for an unknown runtime var" {:name nm}))
3513+ (swap! *rt* assoc-in [:lowered nm] (box-wrapper v argc)))
3514+ (when need-install (rt-analyze! #'wasm.core/install!))
3515+ (when (or (seq wants) need-install (seq (:pending @*rt*)))
3516+ (recur (inc n))))))
3517+
3518+(defn const-init-order
3519+ "Constant globals in an order where each one's init runs after the
3520+ constants it reads."
3521+ [live items]
3522+ (let [st @*rt*
3523+ gs (filter live (:const-order st))
3524+ dep (fn [g] (filter #(and (not= % g) (re-find #"^\$const_[0-9a-f]+$" %))
3525+ (refs-of (or (items (str "$" (subs g 1) "__init")) ""))))]
3526+ (loop [todo gs done [] seen #{}]
3527+ (if (empty? todo)
3528+ done
3529+ (let [g (first todo)]
3530+ (if (contains? seen g)
3531+ (recur (rest todo) done seen)
3532+ (let [pre (remove seen (dep g))]
3533+ (if (seq pre)
3534+ (recur (concat pre todo) done seen)
3535+ (recur (rest todo) (conj done g) (conj seen g))))))))))
3536+
3537+(defn rt-init-wat
3538+ "_rt_init: runtime globals in file order, the link step when the hooks
3539+ global is live, then the constants. Run by the module's start function."
3540+ [live items]
3541+ (when *rt*
3542+ (let [st @*rt*
3543+ order (into {} (map-indexed (fn [i g] [(:var g) i]) lw-rt/globals))
3544+ gs (sort-by #(order (key %)) (filter #(live (:name (val %))) (:globals st)))
3545+ stmts (concat (for [[_ {:keys [name init]}] gs] (str "(global.set " name " (call $" init "))"))
3546+ (when (live "$wasm.seq/hooks") ["(drop (call $wasm.core/install!))"])
3547+ (for [g (const-init-order live items)] (str "(global.set " g " (call $" (subs g 1) "__init))")))]
3548+ (when (seq stmts)
3549+ (str "(func $_rt_init\n " (str/join "\n " stmts) ")\n(start $_rt_init)\n")))))
3550+
3551+(defn session-module
3552+ "The module text for session ss around the lowered program fns `fns`
3553+ (lifted regions are appended from the session)."
3554+ [ss fns]
3555+ (with-session* ss
3556+ (fn []
3557+ (when *rt* (rt-fixpoint! fns))
3558+ (let [{:keys [fixed items live program]} (module-parts fns)
3559+ ordered (fn [prefix] (for [[nm f] (sort-by key items) :when (and (live nm) (str/starts-with? f prefix))] f))
3560+ ;; fn-value globals must come after the globals they read ($info_*)
3561+ gl (let [gs (ordered "(global")
3562+ info? #(str/starts-with? % "(global $info_")]
3563+ (concat (filter info? gs) (remove info? gs)))
3564+ elem (filter #(live (str "$" %)) (sort @*elem*))]
3565+ (str "(module\n"
3566+ (str/join "\n" (ordered "(import")) "\n"
3567+ (rec-group)
3568+ (str/join "\n" fixed) "\n"
3569+ (str/join "\n" gl) "\n"
3570+ (when (seq elem) (str "(elem declare func" (apply str (map #(str " $" %) elem)) ")\n"))
3571+ (str/join "\n" (ordered "(data")) "\n"
3572+ (str/join "\n" (ordered "(func")) "\n"
3573+ program "\n"
3574+ (rt-init-wat live items)
3575+ ")\n")))))
3576+
3577+(defn module
3578+ "infos: analyze-fn results, in definition order. sigs: var -> signature.
3579+ var-globals: var -> global name (the var table, top-level def/declare)."
3580+ ([infos sigs] (module infos sigs {}))
3581+ ([infos sigs var-globals]
3582+ (let [ss (new-session sigs var-globals)
3583+ fns (with-session* ss #(vec (doall (map lower-fn infos))))]
3584+ (session-module ss fns))))
3585+
3586+(defn lower-fn-only
3587+ "P1.5 census: lower one built (not yet optimized) IR fn alone into session
3588+ ss, with no signatures for the rest of the program (its calls go through
3589+ var-table slots). Returns {:wat str :externs #{var} :phase2 [kind]} or
3590+ throws ex-info whose data carries :stage (:optimize or :lower)."
3591+ [ss fname f]
3592+ (try (p/optimize-fn f)
3593+ (catch e (throw (ex-info (str "optimize error: " (ex-message e)) {:stage :optimize}))))
3594+ (let [notes (atom {})
3595+ wat (binding [*unit-notes* notes]
3596+ (with-session* ss #(lower-fn (analyze-opt fname f))))]
3597+ {:wat wat :externs (set (:externs @notes)) :phase2 (vec (:phase2 @notes))}))
3598+
3599+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
3600+;; The runtime library cache (P2.1). Analysing the runtime dominates a
3601+;; program's compile (most programs reach most of it through the dispatchers
3602+;; and the printer), so the whole runtime is analysed and lowered once, the
3603+;; session state that produced it saved under src/.rtlib/ keyed by a hash of
3604+;; the runtime sources and the backend's, and each compile starts from it.
3605+;; Names are content-addressed, so a program's additions merge without
3606+;; renumbering; the shake then keeps what the program reaches.
3607+
3608+(def rtlib-dir (let [d (os/getenv "LW_RTLIB_DIR")] (if (seq d) d (str lw-rt/src-dir "/.rtlib"))))
3609+
3610+(defn rtlib-key []
3611+ (hex32 (apply str (concat (map #(slurp (first %)) lw-rt/file-forms)
3612+ (map #(slurp (str lw-rt/src-dir "/" %)) ["lower_wasm.lg" "lw_rt.lg" "lw_ext.lg"])))))
3613+
3614+(defn var-sym [v] (symbol (qual-name v)))
3615+(defn sym-var [s] (lw-rt/ns-var (symbol (namespace s)) (symbol (name s))))
3616+
3617+(defn build-rtlib!
3618+ "Analyse and lower every runtime defn, global and the link step into the
3619+ current session. Returns the defns that failed (with the error), which
3620+ stay out of the library: a call to one compiles through a nil slot."
3621+ []
3622+ (let [fails (atom [])]
3623+ (doseq [d (concat lw-rt/defns (vals lw-rt/core-defns) (vals lw-rt/ext-defns))]
3624+ (try (rt-analyze! (:var d))
3625+ (catch e (swap! *rt* update :state dissoc (:var d))
3626+ (swap! *sigs* dissoc (:var d))
3627+ (swap! fails conj [(qual-name (:var d)) (ex-message e)]))))
3628+ (doseq [g lw-rt/globals] (rt-global! (:var g)))
3629+ (loop []
3630+ (when (seq (:pending @*rt*))
3631+ (let [info (first (:pending @*rt*))]
3632+ (swap! *rt* update :pending (comp vec rest))
3633+ (lower-pending! info))
3634+ (recur)))
3635+ @fails))
3636+
3637+(defn rtlib-snapshot [fails]
3638+ (let [st @*rt*]
3639+ {:sigs (into {} (for [[v e] @*sigs*] [(var-sym v) (dissoc e :var)]))
3640+ :state (into {} (for [[v s] (:state st) :when (#{:done :failed} s)] [(var-sym v) s]))
3641+ :lowered (:lowered st)
3642+ :rt-globals (into {} (for [[v g] (:globals st)] [(var-sym v) g]))
3643+ :consts (:consts st) :const-order (:const-order st)
3644+ :strings @*strings* :globals @*globals* :regions @*regions* :elem @*elem* :env-types @*env-types*
3645+ :externs (into {} (for [[v g] @*externs*] [(var-sym v) g]))
3646+ :failures (into fails (:failures st))}))
3647+
3648+(defn rtlib-restore! [snap]
3649+ (swap! *sigs* merge (into {} (for [[s e] (:sigs snap)] [(sym-var s) (assoc e :var (sym-var s))])))
3650+ (swap! *rt* merge {:state (into {} (for [[s st] (:state snap)] [(sym-var s) st]))
3651+ :lowered (:lowered snap)
3652+ :globals (into {} (for [[s g] (:rt-globals snap)] [(sym-var s) g]))
3653+ :consts (:consts snap) :const-order (:const-order snap)
3654+ :failures (:failures snap)})
3655+ (swap! *strings* merge (:strings snap))
3656+ (swap! *globals* into (:globals snap))
3657+ (swap! *regions* into (:regions snap))
3658+ (swap! *elem* into (:elem snap))
3659+ (swap! *env-types* merge (:env-types snap))
3660+ ;; sym-var, not resolve: an extern may be private (core/special-symbols)
3661+ (swap! *externs* merge (into {} (for [[s g] (:externs snap) :let [v (try (sym-var s) (catch e nil))] :when v] [v g]))))
3662+
3663+(defn load-rtlib!
3664+ "Start the current session from the cached runtime library, building and
3665+ saving it first if the runtime or the backend changed."
3666+ []
3667+ (let [f (str rtlib-dir "/rtlib-" (rtlib-key) ".edn")]
3668+ (if (some? (try (os/stat f) (catch e nil)))
3669+ (rtlib-restore! (read-string (slurp f)))
3670+ (let [fails (build-rtlib!)
3671+ tmp (str f ".tmp" (rand-int 1000000000))]
3672+ (os/sh "mkdir" "-p" rtlib-dir)
3673+ (spit tmp (pr-str (rtlib-snapshot fails)))
3674+ (os/rename tmp f)
3675+ ;; a library for older sources is dead weight (~3.5 MB each)
3676+ (doseq [old (os/ls rtlib-dir)
3677+ :when (and (str/starts-with? old "rtlib-") (str/ends-with? old ".edn")
3678+ (not= (str rtlib-dir "/" old) f))]
3679+ (os/sh "rm" "-f" (str rtlib-dir "/" old)))))))

1+;; lw-ext: lg defns the backend compiles where rt/wasm has no form for a
2+;; native's variadic use (P2.12). Plain lg over core fns, built like the lg
3+;; core fns (lw_rt's core-defns); lower-wasm's seq-variant-table routes the
4+;; native to them past its fixed arities.

7+(defn map-n
8+ "map* over two or more colls (lang.go mapf's multi-collection path,
9+ mapLazyN): lazy, ends with the shortest coll; an empty coll gives the
10+ empty lazy seq. Each step realises one element of every coll (native
11+ bulk-applies over chunked inputs; only side effects could tell)."
12+ [f colls]
13+ (lazy-seq
14+ (let [ss (map seq colls)]
15+ (when (every? some? ss)
16+ (cons (apply f (map first ss)) (map-n f (map rest ss)))))))
17+
18+(defn list-n
19+ "core/list past rt/'s fixed arities: the args already arrive as the
20+ PersistentList native builds (the variadic rest seq); none is ()."
21+ [xs]
22+ (if (nil? xs) () xs))

25+;; inline, lower-wasm's coll-ctors): native's variadic natives, as variadic
26+;; fns over the runtime's own constructors

99+(defn- json-char
100+ "One char of a JSON string as Go's encoding/json writes it (encode.go
101+ appendString with escapeHTML): \\\" \\\\ \\n \\r \\t, other controls and
102+ < > & as \\u00XX, U+2028/U+2029 escaped, everything else verbatim."
103+ [c]
104+ (let [n (int c)]
105+ (cond (= n 34) "\\\""
106+ (= n 92) "\\\\"
107+ (= n 10) "\\n"
108+ (= n 13) "\\r"
109+ (= n 9) "\\t"
110+ (or (< n 32) (= n 60) (= n 62) (= n 38))
111+ (str "\\u00" (nth "0123456789abcdef" (quot n 16)) (nth "0123456789abcdef" (rem n 16)))
112+ (= n 8232) "\\u2028"
113+ (= n 8233) "\\u2029"
114+ :else (str c))))

116+(defn json-string [s] (str "\"" (apply str (map json-char s)) "\""))

118+(defn json-key
119+ "A map key as fromMapValue (pkg/rt/json.go:58) names it: a String as is,
120+ a Keyword its name with namespace and no colon, anything else String()."
121+ [k]
122+ (cond (string? k) k
123+ (keyword? k) (subs (str k) 1)
124+ :else (str k)))

126+(defn json-str
127+ "(js/emit name data)'s data as JSON text: fromValue (pkg/rt/json.go:103)
128+ then json.Marshal. Map keys are sorted (Go marshals map[string]any in
129+ key order). Floats: a whole value (|v| < 1e18) prints without a fraction,
130+ as Go's 'f'/-1 does; others use the runtime's float text (Go switches to
131+ exponent form outside [1e-6, 1e21); xsofy's payloads carry no floats)."
132+ [v]
133+ (cond (nil? v) "null"
134+ (true? v) "true"
135+ (false? v) "false"
136+ (string? v) (json-string v)
137+ (int? v) (str v)
138+ (float? v) (if (and (< v 1e18) (> v -1e18) (= 0.0 (- v (long v)))) (str (long v)) (str v))
139+ (keyword? v) (json-string (subs (str v) 1))
140+ (map? v) (let [es (sort-by first (map (fn [[k x]] [(json-key k) x]) v))]
141+ (str "{" (apply str (interpose "," (map (fn [[k x]] (str (json-string k) ":" (json-str x))) es))) "}"))

180+(defn dot-v
181+ "core/. (host interop). Two shapes: xsofy's ui/millis (.Sub (now)
182+ clock-epoch), where now-v stands a monotonic ns Int in for a time.Time
183+ (Sub of two Ints is their difference in ns, time.Duration), and
184+ String.getBytes (P2.14). Anything else is a named limit."
185+ ([obj m] (if (and (= m 'getBytes) (string? obj))
186+ (get-bytes obj)
187+ (wasm.core/raise (wasm.str/str-bytes (str "lower-wasm: host interop (." m ") is not supported")))))
188+ ([obj m a] (cond (and (= m 'Sub) (int? obj) (int? a)) (ns-between obj a)
189+ (and (= m 'getBytes) (string? obj)) (get-bytes-enc obj a)
190+ :else (wasm.core/raise (wasm.str/str-bytes (str "lower-wasm: host interop (." m ") is not supported")))))
191+ ([obj m a b] (if (and (= m 'getBytes) (string? obj))
192+ (wasm.core/raise (wasm.str/str-bytes "string.getBytes expected 0 or 1 argument, got 2"))
193+ (wasm.core/raise (wasm.str/str-bytes (str "lower-wasm: host interop (." m ") is not supported"))))))

201+ four screen keys at once): each key in turn, as native's variadic loop."
202+ [coll ks]

206+;; P2.14: natives let-go's core tests reach that rt/ has no twin for. Each

212+(defn disj-v
213+ "core/disj (lang.go): nil stays nil, a set drops each key in turn."
214+ ([s] s)
215+ ([s x] (cond (nil? s) nil
216+ (set? s) (wasm.phs/sdisj s x)
217+ :else (raise-lit "disj expected Set")))
218+ ([s x & xs] (loop [r (disj-v s x) xs xs] (if xs (recur (disj-v r (first xs)) (next xs)) r))))

224+ (do (wasm.phs/tdisj! (wasm.intrinsics/get wasm.core/TSet 0 t) x) t)
225+ (raise-lit "disj! expected TransientSet")))
226+ ([t x & xs] (loop [r (disj!-v t x) xs xs] (if xs (recur (disj!-v r (first xs)) (next xs)) r))))

235+ "core/str-replace-first (clojure.string/replace-first) with a literal
236+ String match: the first occurrence replaced by r, or by (r match) when r
237+ is a fn. A regex match reaches here only as a literal pattern (the
238+ backend lowers a metacharacter-free regex to its String)."
239+ [s m r]
240+ (let [i (clojure.string/index-of s m)]
241+ (if (nil? i)
242+ s
243+ (str (subs s 0 i) (if (wasm.seq/callable? r) (r m) r) (subs s (+ i (count m)))))))

245+;; Namespaces as values. The backend has no Namespace kind: a namespace is
246+;; stood in by the Symbol `<ns name>` (it prints as native's #<Namespace>
247+;; does, `<ns name>`, and compares by name, which is identity for interned
248+;; namespaces). find-ns names any namespace, existing or not (named limit:
249+;; native returns nil for an unknown one). A var's :ns meta (lower-wasm's
250+;; var constants) uses the same stand-in.
251+(defn find-ns-v [s]
252+ (if (symbol? s) (symbol (str "<ns " s ">")) (raise-lit "find-ns expected Symbol")))

254+(defn ns-name-v [n]
255+ (let [t (when (symbol? n) (str n))]
256+ (if (and t (clojure.string/starts-with? t "<ns ") (clojure.string/ends-with? t ">"))
257+ (symbol (subs t 4 (dec (count t))))
258+ (raise-lit "ns-name expected Namespace"))))

260+;; clojure.math / math: the natives rt/wasm/math.lg has no twin for. Go's
261+;; math.Round (half away from zero) to an Int, Floor/Ceil to a Float.
262+(defn- to-f [x] (if (int? x) (wasm.intrinsics/i64-to-f64 x) (wasm.str/unbox-float x)))
263+
264+(defn round-v [x]
265+ (if (int? x)
266+ x
267+ (let [f (to-f x) t (wasm.math/trunc f) d (- f t)]
268+ (wasm.intrinsics/f64-to-i64 (cond (>= d 0.5) (+ t 1.0) (<= d -0.5) (- t 1.0) :else t)))))
269+
270+(defn floor-v [x] (let [f (to-f x) t (wasm.math/trunc f)] (if (< f t) (- t 1.0) t)))
271+(defn ceil-v [x] (let [f (to-f x) t (wasm.math/trunc f)] (if (> f t) (+ t 1.0) t)))
272+
273+(defn floor-div-v
274+ "Math.floorDiv on Ints: quot rounded toward negative infinity."
275+ [a b]
276+ (let [q (quot a b)]
277+ (if (and (not= 0 (rem a b)) (not= (neg? a) (neg? b))) (dec q) q)))

279+(defn get-bytes
280+ "(.getBytes s): a fresh byte-array of s's UTF-8 bytes (let-go strings are
281+ UTF-8, so every supported encoding is the identity)."
282+ [s]
283+ (let [bs (wasm.str/str-bytes s) n (wasm.intrinsics/alen bs) out (wasm.intrinsics/bytes-new n)]
284+ (loop [i 0] (when (< i n) (wasm.intrinsics/bset! out i (wasm.intrinsics/bget bs i)) (recur (inc i))))
285+ (wasm.intrinsics/new wasm.arrays/Arr 0 out)))

287+(defn get-bytes-enc
288+ "(.getBytes s enc): pkg/rt's string method accepts only UTF-8, any case,
289+ with or without the dash."
290+ [s enc]
291+ (cond (not (string? enc)) (raise-lit (str "string.getBytes encoding must be string, got " (type enc)))
292+ (contains? #{"UTF-8" "UTF8"} (clojure.string/upper-case enc)) (get-bytes s)
293+ :else (raise-lit (str "string.getBytes: only UTF-8 supported, got " (pr-str enc)))))

295+;; with-out-str (core/with-out-str*): output written to fd 1 while f runs is
296+;; collected instead (D115's *out* fd stack, with a buffer as the target).
297+;; Named limit, as for (binding [*out* ..]): the backend's own println
298+;; (env.print_*) knows no fds, so only the runtime's printers (pr, prn,
299+;; print, a println that is not lowered inline) are captured.
300+(defn ^{:intrinsic true
301+ :wasm "push fd -2 on the *out* stack and an empty buffer on the capture stack"
302+ :type "[] -> :any"}
303+ capture-begin [] nil)
304+
305+(defn ^{:intrinsic true
306+ :wasm "pop the capture and *out* stacks; the captured Bytes"
307+ :type "[] -> :any"}
308+ capture-end [] nil)
309+
310+(defn with-out-str-v [f]
311+ (capture-begin)
312+ (let [r (try (f) (catch Throwable e (capture-end) (throw e)))]
313+ (wasm.str/mk-str (capture-end))))

315+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
316+;; P2.14: regular expressions. let-go's Regex is Go's regexp (RE2 syntax,
317+;; leftmost-first matching). The backend has no Regex kind, so a regex
318+;; CONSTANT whose pattern uses only the subset below is compiled at build
319+;; time (regex-parse runs natively in the driver) and stood in by an
320+;; interned Symbol named as the regex prints, carrying the parsed pattern in
321+;; its metadata (:lw/regex). The matcher below is a backtracking one: for
322+;; this subset its leftmost-first results are Go's. Supported: literals and
323+;; escapes, `.`, classes [..] [^..] with ranges, \d \w \s \D \W \S, groups
324+;; (..) (?:..), alternation, * + ? {n} {n,} {n,m} and their lazy forms, ^ $
325+;; \A \z \b \B. Named limits (the constant stays a Phase-2 constant): flags
326+;; (?i), named groups, \p classes, \x escapes, POSIX classes, lookahead.
327+;; re-pattern on a runtime string is a named limit too.
328+;;
329+(defn regex-source
330+ "The pattern text of a native Regex value, or nil (not a Regex). Its str
331+ is `#` and the pattern Go-quoted (%q), which reads back as an lg string.
332+ Runs natively, at build time."
333+ [v]
334+ (when (= "let-go.lang.Regex" (str (type v)))
335+ (let [t (str v)]
336+ (try (let [src (read-string (subs t 1))] (when (string? src) src)) (catch e nil)))))
337+
338+;; AST: [:lit c] [:any] [:cls k] [:set neg? items] (items [:r lo hi] or
339+;; [:cls k]) [:grp n node] [:cat nodes] [:alt nodes] [:rep node min max
340+;; greedy?] (max -1 = unbounded) [:bol] [:eol] [:wb] [:nwb]; chars are code
341+;; points.
342+
343+(defn regex-parse
344+ "{:ast .. :groups n} for pattern src, or throws (unsupported syntax).
345+ Runs natively, at build time."
346+ [src]
347+ (let [cs (vec src) n (count cs) pos (atom 0) ngroups (atom 0)
348+ fail (fn [m] (throw (ex-info (str "lower-wasm: regex " m " (named limit)") {:src src})))
349+ peekc (fn [] (when (< @pos n) (nth cs @pos)))
350+ nextc (fn [] (let [c (nth cs @pos)] (swap! pos inc) c))
351+ esc-class {\d :d \w :w \s :s \D :D \W :W \S :S}
352+ esc-char {\n 10 \t 9 \r 13 \f 12 \v 11}
353+ punct? (fn [c] (contains? (set ".[]{}()*+?^$|\\/-#&~,:;=<>!@%'\"`") c))]
354+ (letfn [(parse-esc [in-class?]
355+ (when (>= @pos n) (fail "trailing backslash"))
356+ (let [c (nextc)]
357+ (cond (esc-class c) [:cls (esc-class c)]
358+ (esc-char c) [:lit (esc-char c)]
359+ (punct? c) [:lit (int c)]
360+ (and (not in-class?) (= c \b)) [:wb]
361+ (and (not in-class?) (= c \B)) [:nwb]
362+ (and (not in-class?) (= c \A)) [:bol]
363+ (and (not in-class?) (= c \z)) [:eol]
364+ :else (fail (str "escape \\" c)))))
365+ (parse-class []
366+ (let [neg (when (= \^ (peekc)) (nextc) true)]
367+ (when (= \: (peekc)) (fail "POSIX class"))
368+ (loop [items [] first? true]
369+ (when (>= @pos n) (fail "unterminated ["))
370+ (let [c (peekc)]
371+ (if (and (= c \]) (not first?))
372+ (do (nextc) [:set (boolean neg) items])
373+ (let [lo (if (= c \\) (do (nextc) (parse-esc true)) [:lit (int (nextc))])]
374+ (if (and (= :lit (first lo)) (= \- (peekc)) (< (inc @pos) n) (not= \] (nth cs (inc @pos))))
375+ (do (nextc)
376+ (let [c2 (peekc)
377+ hi (if (= c2 \\) (do (nextc) (parse-esc true)) [:lit (int (nextc))])]
378+ (when-not (= :lit (first hi)) (fail "class range end"))
379+ (recur (conj items [:r (second lo) (second hi)]) false)))
380+ (recur (conj items (if (= :lit (first lo)) [:r (second lo) (second lo)] lo)) false))))))))
381+ (parse-int []
382+ (loop [v nil]
383+ (let [c (peekc)]
384+ (if (and c (<= 48 (int c) 57)) (do (nextc) (recur (+ (* 10 (or v 0)) (- (int c) 48)))) v))))
385+ (parse-quant [a]
386+ (let [c (peekc)
387+ rng (cond (= c \*) (do (nextc) [0 -1])
388+ (= c \+) (do (nextc) [1 -1])
389+ (= c \?) (do (nextc) [0 1])
390+ (= c \{) (let [save @pos]
391+ (nextc)
392+ (let [lo (parse-int)
393+ hi (if (= \, (peekc)) (do (nextc) (or (parse-int) -1)) lo)]
394+ (if (and lo (= \} (peekc)))
395+ (do (nextc) [lo hi])
396+ (do (reset! pos save) nil))))
397+ :else nil)]
398+ (if rng
399+ (let [lazy (when (= \? (peekc)) (nextc) true)]
400+ (when (contains? #{\* \+ \?} (peekc)) (fail "nested repetition"))
401+ (when (contains? #{:bol :eol :wb :nwb} (first a)) (fail "repeated assertion"))
402+ [:rep a (first rng) (second rng) (not lazy)])
403+ a)))
404+ (parse-atom []
405+ (let [c (nextc)]
406+ (cond (= c \() (if (= \? (peekc))
407+ (do (nextc)
408+ (if (= \: (peekc))
409+ (do (nextc) (let [r (parse-alt)] (when-not (= \) (peekc)) (fail "missing )")) (nextc) r))
410+ (fail "group flags or name")))
411+ (let [g (swap! ngroups inc) r (parse-alt)]
412+ (when-not (= \) (peekc)) (fail "missing )"))
413+ (nextc)
414+ [:grp g r]))
415+ (= c \[) (parse-class)
416+ (= c \.) [:any]
417+ (= c \^) [:bol]
418+ (= c \$) [:eol]
419+ (= c \\) (parse-esc false)
420+ (contains? #{\* \+ \?} c) (fail "missing repetition argument")
421+ :else [:lit (int c)])))
422+ (parse-cat []
423+ (loop [items []]
424+ (let [c (peekc)]
425+ (if (or (nil? c) (= c \|) (= c \)))
426+ (if (= 1 (count items)) (first items) [:cat items])
427+ (recur (conj items (parse-quant (parse-atom))))))))
428+ (parse-alt []
429+ (loop [alts [(parse-cat)]]
430+ (if (= \| (peekc))
431+ (do (nextc) (recur (conj alts (parse-cat))))
432+ (if (= 1 (count alts)) (first alts) [:alt alts]))))]
433+ (let [ast (parse-alt)]
434+ (when (< @pos n) (fail "unbalanced )"))
435+ {:ast ast :groups @ngroups}))))
436+
437+(defn- rx-cls? [k c]
438+ (cond (= k :d) (if (>= c 48) (<= c 57) false)
439+ (= k :w) (or (rx-cls? :d c) (if (>= c 65) (<= c 90) false) (if (>= c 97) (<= c 122) false) (= c 95))
440+ (= k :s) (or (= c 32) (= c 9) (= c 10) (= c 12) (= c 13))
441+ (= k :D) (not (rx-cls? :d c))
442+ (= k :W) (not (rx-cls? :w c))
443+ :else (not (rx-cls? :s c))))
444+
445+(defn- rx-set? [items c]
446+ (loop [i 0]
447+ (if (< i (count items))
448+ (let [it (nth items i)]
449+ (if (if (= :r (nth it 0)) (if (>= c (nth it 1)) (<= c (nth it 2)) false) (rx-cls? (nth it 1) c))
450+ true
451+ (recur (inc i))))
452+ false)))
453+
454+(defn- rx-wb? [cs i]
455+ (let [n (count cs)
456+ a (if (> i 0) (rx-cls? :w (nth cs (dec i))) false)
457+ b (if (< i n) (rx-cls? :w (nth cs i)) false)]
458+ (not= a b)))
459+
460+(declare rx-m)
461+
462+(defn- rx-cat [items j cs i caps k]
463+ (if (= j (count items))
464+ (k i caps)
465+ (rx-m (nth items j) cs i caps (fn [i2 c2] (rx-cat items (inc j) cs i2 c2 k)))))
466+
467+(defn- rx-alt [alts j cs i caps k]
468+ (if (= j (count alts))
469+ nil
470+ (let [r (rx-m (nth alts j) cs i caps k)]
471+ (if (nil? r) (rx-alt alts (inc j) cs i caps k) r))))
472+
473+(defn- rx-rep [node cnt cs i caps k]
474+ (let [sub (nth node 1) mn (nth node 2) mx (nth node 3) greedy (nth node 4)
475+ more (fn [] (if (if (< mx 0) true (< cnt mx))
476+ ;; an empty iteration past the minimum cannot progress:
477+ ;; it ends the loop, keeping its captures only when no
478+ ;; optional iteration preceded it, as RE2 does ((a*)*b
479+ ;; captures "" on "b" and "a" on "ab")
480+ (rx-m sub cs i caps (fn [i2 c2] (if (if (= i2 i) (>= cnt mn) false) (if (= cnt mn) (k i2 c2) nil) (rx-rep node (inc cnt) cs i2 c2 k))))
481+ nil))]
482+ (cond (< cnt mn) (more)
483+ greedy (let [r (more)] (if (nil? r) (k i caps) r))
484+ :else (let [r (k i caps)] (if (nil? r) (more) r)))))
485+
486+(defn- rx-m
487+ "Match node at i, then continue with (k end caps); the continuation's
488+ non-nil result, or nil (backtrack)."
489+ [node cs i caps k]
490+ (let [t (nth node 0) n (count cs)]
491+ (cond
492+ (= t :lit) (if (if (< i n) (= (nth cs i) (nth node 1)) false) (k (inc i) caps) nil)
493+ (= t :any) (if (if (< i n) (not= (nth cs i) 10) false) (k (inc i) caps) nil)
494+ (= t :cls) (if (if (< i n) (rx-cls? (nth node 1) (nth cs i)) false) (k (inc i) caps) nil)
495+ (= t :set) (if (if (< i n) (not= (nth node 1) (rx-set? (nth node 2) (nth cs i))) false) (k (inc i) caps) nil)
496+ (= t :cat) (rx-cat (nth node 1) 0 cs i caps k)
497+ (= t :alt) (rx-alt (nth node 1) 0 cs i caps k)
498+ (= t :grp) (let [g (nth node 1)] (rx-m (nth node 2) cs i caps (fn [j c2] (k j (assoc c2 g [i j])))))
499+ (= t :rep) (rx-rep node 0 cs i caps k)
500+ (= t :bol) (if (= i 0) (k i caps) nil)
501+ (= t :eol) (if (= i n) (k i caps) nil)
502+ (= t :wb) (if (rx-wb? cs i) (k i caps) nil)
503+ :else (if (rx-wb? cs i) nil (k i caps)))))
504+
505+(defn- rx-search
506+ "The leftmost match at or after rune index from: [start end caps] or nil."
507+ [ast cs from]
508+ (let [n (count cs) done (fn [e caps] [e caps])]
509+ (loop [s from]
510+ (if (<= s n)
511+ (let [r (rx-m ast cs s {} done)]
512+ (if (nil? r) (recur (inc s)) [s (nth r 0) (nth r 1)]))
513+ nil))))
514+
515+(defn- rx-all
516+ "Go's allMatches: successive matches, an empty match abutting the previous
517+ one skipped; at most limit (all when negative)."
518+ [ast cs limit]
519+ (let [n (count cs)]
520+ (loop [pos 0 prev -1 out []]
521+ (if (if (> pos n) true (if (>= limit 0) (>= (count out) limit) false))
522+ out
523+ (let [m (rx-search ast cs pos)]
524+ (if (nil? m)
525+ out
526+ (let [st (nth m 0) en (nth m 1) empty-here (= en pos)]
527+ (recur (if empty-here (inc pos) en) en
528+ (if (if empty-here (= st prev) false) out (conj out m))))))))))
529+
530+(defn rx? "A regex stand-in (see above)." [x]
531+ (if (symbol? x) (some? (:lw/regex (meta x))) false))
532+
533+(defn- rx-ast [re] (:lw/regex (meta re)))
534+(defn- rx-ngroups [re] (:lw/groups (meta re)))
535+(defn- rx-chars [s] (mapv int s))
536+
537+(defn- rx-group-strs
538+ "A match's groups as Strings (nil when a group did not take part)."
539+ [s ng m]
540+ (let [caps (nth m 2)]
541+ (vec (cons (subs s (nth m 0) (nth m 1))
542+ (map (fn [g] (let [p (get caps g)] (if (nil? p) nil (subs s (nth p 0) (nth p 1)))))
543+ (range 1 (inc ng)))))))
544+
545+(defn- rx-value
546+ "regexSubmatchValue: the match String without groups, else the vector."
547+ [s ng m]
548+ (if (= ng 0) (subs s (nth m 0) (nth m 1)) (rx-group-strs s ng m)))
549+
550+(defn- rx-expand
551+ "Go's Regexp.Expand of template t for match m, after let-go's
552+ validateReplacement (a reference to a group the pattern lacks raises)."
553+ [re s t m]
554+ (let [ng (rx-ngroups re) gs (rx-group-strs s ng m) cs (vec t) n (count cs)
555+ name-char? (fn [c] (let [x (int c)] (or (= x 95) (if (>= x 97) (<= x 122) false) (if (>= x 65) (<= x 90) false) (if (>= x 48) (<= x 57) false))))]
556+ (loop [i 0 out ""]
557+ (if (>= i n)
558+ out
559+ (let [c (nth cs i)]
560+ (if (not= c \$)
561+ (recur (inc i) (str out c))
562+ (if (if (< (inc i) n) (= \$ (nth cs (inc i))) false)
563+ (recur (+ i 2) (str out "$"))
564+ (let [braced (if (< (inc i) n) (= \{ (nth cs (inc i))) false)
565+ st (if braced (+ i 2) (inc i))
566+ en (loop [j st] (if (if (< j n) (name-char? (nth cs j)) false) (recur (inc j)) j))
567+ nm (apply str (subvec cs st en))
568+ ok (if braced (if (< en n) (= \} (nth cs en)) false) true)
569+ nxt (if braced (inc en) en)]
570+ (cond (if (not ok) true (= nm "")) (recur (inc i) (str out "$"))
571+ (every? (fn [ch] (name-char? ch)) nm)
572+ (let [idx (parse-long nm)]
573+ (cond (nil? idx) (raise-lit (str "no group named " (pr-str nm) " in regex " (str re)))
574+ (> idx ng) (raise-lit (str "no group " idx " in regex " (str re)))
575+ :else (recur nxt (str out (or (nth gs idx) "")))))
576+ :else (recur nxt out))))))))))
577+
578+(defn- rx-replace
579+ "str-replace / str-replace-first with a regex match: Go's ReplaceAllString
580+ (or the first match only) with $-expansion, or the fn called with each
581+ match (strReplaceCallback: the String, or the groups vector)."
582+ [s re r first?]
583+ (let [cs (rx-chars s) ng (rx-ngroups re)
584+ tmpl (string? r)
585+ ;; the template is validated before matching (validateReplacement)
586+ _ (when tmpl (rx-expand re "" r [0 0 {}]))
587+ ms (rx-all (rx-ast re) cs (if first? 1 -1))]
588+ (loop [ms ms last 0 out ""]
589+ (if (empty? ms)
590+ (str out (subs s last))
591+ (let [m (first ms)
592+ rep (if tmpl
593+ (rx-expand re s r m)
594+ (let [x (r (if (= ng 0) (subs s (nth m 0) (nth m 1)) (rx-group-strs s ng m)))]
595+ (if (string? x) x (raise-lit "str-replace replacement function must return a String"))))]
596+ (recur (rest ms) (nth m 1) (str out (subs s last (nth m 0)) rep)))))))
597+
598+(defn re-find-v
599+ "core/re-find: the first match (String, or [whole groups..]) or nil. A
600+ metacharacter-free regex constant arrives as its String (re-find-lit)."
601+ [re s]
602+ (cond (string? re) (re-find-lit re s)
603+ (not (rx? re)) (raise-lit "re-find expected Regex")
604+ (not (string? s)) (raise-lit "re-find expected String")
605+ :else (let [m (rx-search (rx-ast re) (rx-chars s) 0)]
606+ (if (nil? m) nil (rx-value s (rx-ngroups re) m)))))
607+
608+(defn re-matches-v
609+ "core/re-matches: the leftmost match, only when it spans all of s
610+ (CoreReMatches: find, then compare the span, not an anchored match)."
611+ [re s]
612+ (cond (string? re) (if (= re s) re nil)
613+ (not (rx? re)) (raise-lit "re-matches expected Regex")
614+ (not (string? s)) (raise-lit "re-matches expected String")
615+ :else (let [cs (rx-chars s) m (rx-search (rx-ast re) cs 0)]
616+ (if (if (nil? m) false (if (= 0 (nth m 0)) (= (count cs) (nth m 1)) false))
617+ (rx-value s (rx-ngroups re) m)
618+ nil))))
619+
620+(defn re-seq-v
621+ "core/re-seq: every match as a list, or nil."
622+ [re s]
623+ (cond (not (rx? re)) (if (string? re)
624+ (let [n (count re)]
625+ (loop [i 0 out []]
626+ (let [j (if (= n 0) nil (clojure.string/index-of s re i))]
627+ (if (nil? j) (if (empty? out) nil (apply list out)) (recur (+ j n) (conj out re))))))
628+ (raise-lit "re-seq expected Regex"))
629+ (not (string? s)) (raise-lit "re-seq expected String")
630+ :else (let [ng (rx-ngroups re) ms (rx-all (rx-ast re) (rx-chars s) -1)]
631+ (if (empty? ms) nil (apply list (map (fn [m] (rx-value s ng m)) ms))))))
632+
633+(defn split-v
634+ "core/split: a regex separator splits as Go's Regexp.Split (string.lg's
635+ clojure.string/split adds the limit-0 rule on top); anything else is the
636+ runtime's split."
637+ ([s] (wasm.str/split s))
638+ ([s sep] (if (rx? sep) (split-v s sep -1) (wasm.str/split s sep)))
639+ ([s sep n]
640+ (if (rx? sep)
641+ (cond (not (string? s)) (raise-lit "split expected String")
642+ (not (int? n)) (raise-lit "split expected Int limit")
643+ (= n 0) ()
644+ (if (= s "") (not= "" (:lw/src (meta sep))) false) (list "")
645+ :else (let [cs (rx-chars s) ms (rx-all (rx-ast sep) cs n)]
646+ (loop [ms ms beg 0 end 0 out []]
647+ (if (if (empty? ms) true (if (> n 0) (= (count out) (dec n)) false))
648+ (apply list (if (not= end (count cs)) (conj out (subs s beg)) out))
649+ (let [m (first ms)]
650+ (recur (rest ms) (nth m 1) (nth m 0)
651+ (if (not= 0 (nth m 1)) (conj out (subs s beg (nth m 0))) out)))))))
652+ (wasm.str/split s sep n))))
653+
654+(defn str-replace-v
655+ "core/str-replace: a regex match through rx-replace, else the runtime's."
656+ [s m r]
657+ (if (rx? m)
658+ (if (string? s) (rx-replace s m r false) (raise-lit "str-replace expected String"))
659+ (wasm.str/str-replace s m r)))
660+
661+(defn str-replace-first-rx-v
662+ "core/str-replace-first: a regex match through rx-replace, else the
663+ literal fill."
664+ [s m r]
665+ (if (rx? m)
666+ (if (string? s) (rx-replace s m r true) (raise-lit "str-replace-first expected String"))
667+ (str-replace-first-v s m r)))
668+
669+(defn read-all-string-v
670+ "core/read-all-string: every form of s, in order, through the runtime's
671+ data reader (wasm.reader/read-string*). Whitespace, commas and ;
672+ comments between forms are skipped here (native also returns a VOID
673+ marker for a #_ discard or a trailing comment, which callers filter out;
674+ none is produced here). The reader's named limits apply (reader macros
675+ that need *ns*)."
676+ [s]
677+ (if (string? s)
678+ (let [n (count s)]
679+ (loop [i 0 out []]
680+ (let [j (loop [j i]
681+ (if (< j n)
682+ (let [c (nth s j)]
683+ (cond (or (= c \space) (= c \,) (= c \newline) (= c \tab) (= c \return) (= c \formfeed)) (recur (inc j))
684+ (= c \;) (recur (loop [k j] (if (if (< k n) (not= (nth s k) \newline) false) (recur (inc k)) k)))
685+ :else j))
686+ j))]
687+ (if (>= j n)
688+ out
689+ (let [r (wasm.reader/read-string* s j)]
690+ (recur (nth r 1) (conj out (nth r 0))))))))
691+ (raise-lit "read-all-string expected String")))
692+
693+(defn double-v
694+ "core/double: an Int as its Float, a Float as is; anything else raises
695+ native's `<pr form> can't be coerced to double`."
696+ [x]
697+ (cond (float? x) x
698+ (int? x) (wasm.str/box-float (wasm.intrinsics/i64-to-f64 x))
699+ :else (raise-lit (str (pr-str x) " can't be coerced to double"))))
700+
701+(defn log-v "math/log: Go's math.Log (wasm.math's portable port)." [x]
702+ (wasm.str/box-float (wasm.math/log* (to-f x))))
703+
704+(defn- fixed-str
705+ "x (a Float or Int) with exactly p decimals, as Go's %.<p>f. Rounds the
706+ shortest decimal form of x half-to-even, which equals Go's rounding of the
707+ exact binary value except when that form ends in a 5 exactly at the cut
708+ and the binary value lies on the other side (named limit)."
709+ [x p]
710+ (let [t (str (if (int? x) (wasm.str/box-float (wasm.intrinsics/i64-to-f64 x)) x))
711+ neg (clojure.string/starts-with? t "-")
712+ t (if neg (subs t 1) t)
713+ ei (clojure.string/index-of t "e")
714+ mant (if ei (subs t 0 ei) t)
715+ ex (if ei
716+ (let [e (subs t (inc ei)) eneg (clojure.string/starts-with? e "-")
717+ e (if (or eneg (clojure.string/starts-with? e "+")) (subs e 1) e)
718+ v (reduce (fn [acc ch] (+ (* acc 10) (- (int ch) 48))) 0 e)]
719+ (if eneg (- v) v))
720+ 0)
721+ di (clojure.string/index-of mant ".")
722+ digits (if di (str (subs mant 0 di) (subs mant (inc di))) mant)
723+ point (+ ex (if di di (count mant))) ; decimal point after this many digits
724+ ;; pad so the point and p decimals exist
725+ lead (if (< point 1) (- 1 point) 0)
726+ digits (str (apply str (repeat lead "0")) digits)
727+ point (+ point lead)
728+ need (+ point p)
729+ digits (if (< (count digits) (inc need)) (str digits (apply str (repeat (- (inc need) (count digits)) "0"))) digits)
730+ keep (subs digits 0 need)
731+ nextd (- (int (nth digits need)) 48)
732+ rest-nonzero (some (fn [c] (not= c \0)) (subs digits (inc need)))
733+ lastd (if (> need 0) (- (int (nth keep (dec need))) 48) 0)
734+ ;; a shortest form ending in 5 right at the cut is a decimal tie,
735+ ;; but the binary x is usually not: compare x*10^(p+1) with the
736+ ;; tie K exactly (TwoProduct by Dekker's split, exact below 2^53)
737+ tie-side (when (and (= nextd 5) (not rest-nonzero) (<= (inc p) 22) (<= (inc need) 15))
738+ (let [k (* 1.0 (reduce (fn [acc ch] (+ (* acc 10) (- (int ch) 48))) 0 (subs digits 0 (inc need))))
739+ f (if (int? x) (* 1.0 x) x) f (if neg (- f) f)
740+ pw (reduce (fn [acc _] (* acc 10.0)) 1.0 (range (inc p)))
741+ split (fn [a] (let [c (* 134217729.0 a) h (- c (- c a))] [h (- a h)]))
742+ hi (* f pw)
743+ [ah al] (split f) [bh bl] (split pw)
744+ lo (+ (+ (+ (- (* ah bh) hi) (* ah bl)) (* al bh)) (* al bl))
745+ d (+ (- hi k) lo)]
746+ (cond (> d 0.0) :up (< d 0.0) :down :else nil)))
747+ up (cond (= tie-side :up) true
748+ (= tie-side :down) false
749+ :else (or (> nextd 5) (and (= nextd 5) (or rest-nonzero (odd? lastd)))))
750+ ;; increment the kept digits as a decimal string
751+ inc-str (fn [s] (loop [i (dec (count s)) s s]
752+ (if (< i 0)
753+ (str "1" s)
754+ (let [d (- (int (nth s i)) 48)]
755+ (if (= d 9)
756+ (recur (dec i) (str (subs s 0 i) "0" (subs s (inc i))))
757+ (str (subs s 0 i) (+ d 1) (subs s (inc i))))))))
758+ r (if up (inc-str keep) keep)
759+ point (+ point (- (count r) (count keep)))
760+ ip (subs r 0 point)
761+ fp (subs r point)
762+ ip (let [s (loop [s ip] (if (and (> (count s) 1) (clojure.string/starts-with? s "0")) (recur (subs s 1)) s))] (if (= s "") "0" s))
763+ body (if (= p 0) ip (str ip "." fp))]
764+ (if neg (str "-" body) body)))
765+
766+(defn format-v
767+ "core/format (Go's fmt.Sprintf) for the verbs %s %d %f %.Nf and %%; any
768+ other verb is a named limit."
769+ [fmt & args]
770+ (let [n (count fmt)]
771+ (loop [i 0 args args out ""]
772+ (if (>= i n)
773+ out
774+ (let [c (nth fmt i)]
775+ (if (not= c \%)
776+ (recur (inc i) args (str out c))
777+ (let [j (inc i)
778+ prec (when (and (< j n) (= \. (nth fmt j)))
779+ (loop [k (inc j) v 0] (if (and (< k n) (let [x (int (nth fmt k))] (and (>= x 48) (<= x 57)))) (recur (inc k) (+ (* v 10) (- (int (nth fmt k)) 48))) [k v])))
780+ vi (if prec (nth prec 0) j)
781+ verb (when (< vi n) (nth fmt vi))
782+ a (first args)]
783+ (cond (= verb \%) (recur (inc vi) args (str out "%"))
784+ (= verb \s) (recur (inc vi) (rest args) (str out (if (nil? a) "%!s(<nil>)" (str a))))
785+ (= verb \d) (recur (inc vi) (rest args) (str out (str a)))
786+ (= verb \f) (recur (inc vi) (rest args) (str out (fixed-str a (if prec (nth prec 1) 6))))
787+ :else (raise-lit (str "lower-wasm: format verb %" verb " is not supported (named limit)"))))))))))
788+
789+(defn empty-v
790+ "core/empty: the empty collection of x's kind with x's meta (a vector,
791+ map, set, list or any seq), nil for anything else; a MapEntry gives []."
792+ [x]
793+ (let [m (meta x)
794+ keep (fn [e] (if (nil? m) e (with-meta e m)))]
795+ (cond (nil? x) nil
796+ (map-entry?-v x) []
797+ (vector? x) (keep [])
798+ (map? x) (keep {})
799+ (set? x) (keep #{})
800+ (seq? x) (keep ())
801+ :else nil)))

+384 -0
@@ -0,0 +1,384 @@
1+;; lw-rt: the wasm runtime (rt/wasm/*.lg) as the backend sees it (P2.1).
2+;;
3+;; Loading this namespace loads the runtime namespaces under native lg, in
4+;; rt/wasm/README.md's order, so their vars exist for ir.build to resolve and
5+;; their macros expand. It then indexes, from the source forms:
6+;; - every type declaration (wasm/defstruct, defarray, deffunc, and
7+;; wasm.intrinsics/Bytes), in source order: the module's ONE rec group (D25)
8+;; - every runtime defn/defn- with its arities (what the backend lowers)
9+;; - every runtime top-level def (a runtime global, D39)
10+;; - the twin table (D58): native var -> runtime var
11+;; wasm.intrinsics' own defns are the reference implementation and are never
12+;; lowered; only its declarations (Bytes) are read.
13+(ns lw-rt
14+ (:require [clojure.string :as str]))
15+
16+(def src-dir (let [f *file*] (if (str/includes? f "/") (subs f 0 (str/last-index-of f "/")) ".")))
17+;; LW_RT_DIR: compile against a patched copy of rt/wasm (to verify a runtime
18+;; patch without editing rt/; the rtlib cache key covers the sources read)
19+(def rt-dir (let [d (os/getenv "LW_RT_DIR")] (if (seq d) d (str src-dir "/../rt/wasm"))))
20+
21+(def ^:private row-file #"^\| [0-9]+ \| `([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.lg)` \|")
22+
23+(defn readme-order
24+ "Files from README.md's load-order table (`| n | `file.lg` | ...`). Every
25+ numbered row naming a file must parse (P2.11, D87: a name with a digit
26+ used to be skipped silently, so its namespace was never loaded)."
27+ []
28+ (let [rows (filter #(re-find #"^\| [0-9]+ \| `[^`]+\.lg` \|" %)
29+ (str/split-lines (slurp (str rt-dir "/README.md"))))
30+ bad (remove #(re-find row-file %) rows)]
31+ (when (seq bad)
32+ (throw (ex-info (str "lw-rt: unreadable load-order rows in rt/wasm/README.md: " (vec bad)) {})))
33+ (vec (for [l rows] (second (re-find row-file l))))))
34+
35+(def files (readme-order))
36+
37+(defn read-forms [path] (read-string (str "[" (slurp path) "\n]")))
38+
39+(def file-forms
40+ ;; [[path ns-sym [form ...]] ...] in load order; each file is also loaded
41+ (do
42+ (vec (for [f files]
43+ (let [path (str rt-dir "/" f)
44+ text (slurp path)]
45+ (load-string text)
46+ (let [forms (read-string (str "[" text "\n]"))
47+ ns-sym (some #(when (and (seq? %) (= 'ns (first %))) (second %)) forms)]
48+ [path ns-sym forms]))))))
49+
50+;; load-string's ns forms leave the compiler in the last runtime ns
51+(in-ns 'lw-rt)
52+
53+(def intrinsics-ns 'wasm.intrinsics)
54+
55+(defn intrinsic-meta?
56+ "A defn whose calls the backend emits as an instruction sequence (D24): an
57+ ^:intrinsic var with a :wasm description, in wasm.intrinsics or any other
58+ runtime namespace (D97: wasm.term's term-read-key, term-key-pending,
59+ term-size)."
60+ [v] (let [m (meta v)] (and (:intrinsic m) (string? (:wasm m)))))
61+
62+(defn ns-var
63+ "The var nm names in ns, private ones included (ns-resolve skips those)."
64+ [ns-sym nm] (get (ns-interns ns-sym) nm))
65+
66+(defn decl? [v] (and (map? v) (contains? #{:struct :array :func} (:wasm.intrinsics/kind v))))
67+
68+(defn strip-meta-name
69+ "A defn/def name as read: a symbol, or the reader's (with-meta sym m)."
70+ [nm]
71+ (if (and (seq? nm) (= 'with-meta (first nm))) [(second nm) (nth nm 2)] [nm nil]))
72+
73+(defn head-var [ns-sym form]
74+ (when (and (seq? form) (symbol? (first form)) (not (#{'def 'defn 'defn- 'declare 'defmacro 'ns} (first form))))
75+ (binding [*ns* (the-ns ns-sym)] (resolve (first form)))))
76+
77+(def rt-nss (set (keep second file-forms)))
78+
79+(def decl-heads #{#'wasm.intrinsics/defstruct #'wasm.intrinsics/defarray #'wasm.intrinsics/deffunc})
80+
81+(def decls
82+ ;; [{:var v :decl map :ns sym}] in source order
83+ (vec (for [[_ ns-sym forms] file-forms
84+ form forms
85+ :let [hv (head-var ns-sym form)
86+ nm (cond (decl-heads hv) (second form)
87+ (and (= 'def (first form)) (= ns-sym intrinsics-ns)) (first (strip-meta-name (second form)))
88+ :else nil)
89+ v (when nm (ns-var ns-sym nm))]
90+ :when (and v (decl? @v))]
91+ {:var v :decl @v :ns ns-sym})))
92+
93+;; A decl's wasm type name: $Name, or $<last ns segment>.Name when two
94+;; namespaces declare the same Name (str and core both have a Globals).
95+(def type-names
96+ (let [by-name (group-by #(str (:name (:decl %))) decls)]
97+ (into {} (for [d decls
98+ :let [nm (str (:name (:decl d)))
99+ clash? (> (count (by-name nm)) 1)
100+ seg (last (str/split (str (:ns d)) #"\."))]]
101+ [(:var d) (str "$" (if clash? (str seg "." nm) nm))]))))
102+
103+(defn type-name
104+ "Wasm type name of a declaration var, or nil."
105+ [v] (get type-names v))
106+
107+(def decl-by-name (into {} (for [d decls] [(type-name (:var d)) (:decl d)])))
108+
109+(defn arities
110+ "The arity bodies of a defn tail (after the name): [[params body...] ...]."
111+ [more]
112+ (let [more (if (string? (first more)) (rest more) more)
113+ more (if (map? (first more)) (rest more) more)]
114+ (if (vector? (first more))
115+ [(vec more)]
116+ (mapv vec more))))
117+
118+(def defns
119+ ;; [{:var v :ns sym :arities [[params & body] ...]}] in source order;
120+ ;; intrinsics (any namespace) are reference impls, never lowered
121+ (vec (for [[_ ns-sym forms] file-forms
122+ :when (not= ns-sym intrinsics-ns)
123+ form forms
124+ :when (and (seq? form) (#{'defn 'defn-} (first form)))
125+ :let [[nm _] (strip-meta-name (second form))]
126+ :when (not (intrinsic-meta? (ns-var ns-sym nm)))]
127+ {:var (ns-var ns-sym nm) :ns ns-sym :name nm
128+ :arities (arities (drop 2 form))})))
129+
130+(def defn-by-var (into {} (for [d defns] [(:var d) d])))
131+
132+(def globals
133+ ;; runtime top-level defs that are not declarations: [{:var :ns :init form}]
134+ (vec (for [[_ ns-sym forms] file-forms
135+ :when (not= ns-sym intrinsics-ns)
136+ form forms
137+ :when (and (seq? form) (= 'def (first form)))
138+ :let [[nm _] (strip-meta-name (second form))
139+ v (ns-var ns-sym nm)]
140+ :when (not (decl? @v))]
141+ {:var v :ns ns-sym :init (nth form 2)})))
142+
143+(def global-by-var (into {} (for [g globals] [(:var g) g])))
144+
145+(defn runtime-var? [v] (or (contains? defn-by-var v) (contains? global-by-var v)))
146+
147+(defn intrinsic? [v]
148+ (and (var? v) (intrinsic-meta? v)
149+ ;; P4.1: src/lw_ext.lg declares the backend's own host intrinsics
150+ ;; (host-emit, host-url-param) until rt/ carries them
151+ (let [n (ns-name (:ns (meta v)))] (or (contains? rt-nss n) (= n 'lw-ext)))))
152+
153+(defn intrinsic-vars
154+ "Every intrinsic var of the loaded runtime, for the backend's emitter check."
155+ []
156+ (for [ns-sym rt-nss [_ v] (ns-publics ns-sym) :when (intrinsic? v)] v))
157+
158+;; D58: a runtime defn claims the native(s) it implements with :twin; the
159+;; native's var is what a program's call resolves to.
160+(def twins
161+ (into {} (for [d defns
162+ :let [t (:twin (meta (:var d)))]
163+ :when t
164+ tw (if (string? t) [t] t)
165+ :let [nv (resolve (symbol tw))]
166+ :when nv]
167+ [nv (:var d)])))
168+
169+;; Natives the runtime implements without a :twin marker (wasm.core keeps
170+;; these unmarked because P2.7 gave them names that shadow core's, D68).
171+(def extra-twins
172+ (into {} (for [[n r] [['core/ex-message 'wasm.core/ex-message] ['core/ex-data 'wasm.core/ex-data]
173+ ['core/ex-cause 'wasm.core/ex-cause]
174+ ;; P2.14 (D112): defined in wasm.core, never marked
175+ ['core/meta 'wasm.core/meta] ['core/dissoc! 'wasm.core/dissoc!]]
176+ :let [nv (resolve n) rv (resolve r)]
177+ :when (and nv rv)]
178+ [nv rv])))
179+
180+;; D58: a twin covers every var bound to the same NativeFn (string/trim is
181+;; core/trim's NativeFn), so a native var is also looked up by its value.
182+(def twins-by-value
183+ (into {} (for [[nv rv] twins] [@nv rv])))
184+
185+(defn twin-of [v]
186+ (or (get twins v) (get extra-twins v)
187+ (when (var? v) (let [x (try @v (catch e nil))] (when (some? x) (get twins-by-value x))))))
188+
189+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
190+;; let-go's core fns written in lg (mapv, into, filter, ...): no runtime twin
191+;; can claim them (they are not natives), so their own source compiles
192+;; through the backend like a runtime defn, read from core.lg at the commit
193+;; the pinned lg was built from (the checkout itself may have moved on).
194+;; Variadic arities compile too since P2.12 (D83, amending D78).
195+
196+(def letgo-commit "4e769212")
197+(def letgo-dir (str (os/getenv "HOME") "/projects-new/3p/let-go"))
198+
199+(defn embedded-forms
200+ "The forms of let-go's embedded pkg/rt/core/<file> at letgo-commit, read in
201+ ns-sym (loaded first: string is loaded on demand natively)."
202+ [file ns-sym]
203+ (let [r (try (os/sh "git" "-C" letgo-dir "show" (str letgo-commit ":pkg/rt/core/" file)) (catch e nil))]
204+ (if (and r (= 0 (:exit r)))
205+ (do (require ns-sym)
206+ (binding [*ns* (the-ns ns-sym)] (read-string (str "[" (:out r) "\n]"))))
207+ [])))
208+
209+(def core-forms (embedded-forms "core.lg" 'core))
210+
211+(defn lg-defined?
212+ ([v] (lg-defined? v 'core))
213+ ([v ns-sym] (let [m (meta v)] (and (= (str "<embedded:" ns-sym ">") (:file m)) (:line m)))))
214+
215+(defn embedded-defns [ns-sym forms]
216+ (into {} (for [form forms
217+ :when (and (seq? form) (#{'defn 'defn-} (first form)))
218+ :let [[nm _] (strip-meta-name (second form))
219+ v (ns-var ns-sym nm)
220+ ars (arities (drop 2 form))]
221+ :when (and v (lg-defined? v ns-sym) (seq ars))]
222+ [v {:var v :ns ns-sym :name nm :arities ars :core-lg true}])))
223+
224+(def core-defns
225+ ;; var -> {:var :ns 'core :name :arities [...]}; P3.2: let-go's embedded
226+ ;; string.lg too (string/join, string/ends-with?: clojure.string's lg fns)
227+ (merge (embedded-defns 'core core-forms)
228+ (embedded-defns 'string (embedded-forms "string.lg" 'string))))
229+
230+;; P2.12: lg defns the backend adds where rt/ has no form for a native's
231+;; variadic use (src/lw_ext.lg: map* over several colls). Compiled like the
232+;; lg core fns; a native reaches one through lower-wasm's seq-variant-table.
233+(def ext-path (str src-dir "/lw_ext.lg"))
234+(load-string (slurp ext-path))
235+(in-ns 'lw-rt)
236+
237+(def ext-defns
238+ (into {} (for [form (read-forms ext-path)
239+ :when (and (seq? form) (#{'defn 'defn-} (first form)))
240+ :let [[nm _] (strip-meta-name (second form))
241+ v (ns-var 'lw-ext nm)]
242+ :when (and v (not (intrinsic-meta? v)))]
243+ [v {:var v :ns 'lw-ext :name nm :arities (arities (drop 2 form)) :core-lg true}])))
244+
245+;; P3.2: defns of the program's own library namespaces (the driver's
246+;; -source-paths, e.g. xsofy), registered by the driver after it loads them:
247+;; var -> {:var :ns :name :arities :lib true}. Compiled on demand like
248+;; runtime defns, so only what the program reaches is analysed.
249+(def lib-defns (atom {}))
250+
251+;; P3.2: natives the backend fills from lw_ext.lg (no rt/ twin)
252+(def ext-twins
253+ (merge
254+ {#'core/long #'lw-ext/long-v #'core/ints #'lw-ext/ints-v #'core/longs #'lw-ext/ints-v
255+ #'core/re-find #'lw-ext/re-find-v
256+ (resolve 'let-go.core/now) #'lw-ext/now-v
257+ #'term/size #'lw-ext/term-size-v
258+ ;; P4.1: the real entry's host seams
259+ #'os/os-name #'lw-ext/os-name-v #'core/char? #'lw-ext/char-v
260+ (resolve 'core/.) #'lw-ext/dot-v
261+ ;; P2.14: natives let-go's core tests reach (lw_ext.lg says why each)
262+ #'core/disj #'lw-ext/disj-v #'core/disj! #'lw-ext/disj!-v
263+ ;; P2.4: array-map = hash-map in let-go (insertion-ordered up to 8, D29); the map-order corpus builds by both
264+ #'core/array-map #'lw-ext/hash-map-v
265+ #'core/map-entry? #'lw-ext/map-entry?-v #'core/lazy-seq? #'lw-ext/lazy-seq?-v
266+ #'core/shutdown-agents #'lw-ext/shutdown-agents-v
267+ (resolve 'let-go.core/str-replace-first) #'lw-ext/str-replace-first-rx-v
268+ ;; P2.14: regexes (lw_ext.lg's engine); a String separator/match still
269+ ;; reaches the runtime's split / str-replace
270+ #'core/re-matches #'lw-ext/re-matches-v #'core/re-seq #'lw-ext/re-seq-v
271+ #'core/split #'lw-ext/split-v #'core/str-replace #'lw-ext/str-replace-v
272+ #'core/find-ns #'lw-ext/find-ns-v #'core/ns-name #'lw-ext/ns-name-v
273+ #'math/round #'lw-ext/round-v #'clojure.math/round #'lw-ext/round-v
274+ #'clojure.math/floor #'lw-ext/floor-v #'clojure.math/ceil #'lw-ext/ceil-v
275+ #'clojure.math/floor-div #'lw-ext/floor-div-v
276+ #'clojure.math/sqrt #'wasm.math/sqrt #'clojure.math/pow #'wasm.math/pow
277+ #'clojure.math/exp #'wasm.math/exp #'clojure.math/abs #'wasm.math/abs
278+ #'core/with-out-str* #'lw-ext/with-out-str-v #'core/read-all-string #'lw-ext/read-all-string-v
279+ #'core/double #'lw-ext/double-v #'core/format #'lw-ext/format-v #'math/log #'lw-ext/log-v
280+ #'core/empty #'lw-ext/empty-v}
281+ ;; D100: js/emit and js/url-param through the host imports, until rt/'s
282+ ;; host.lg twins call the intrinsics themselves (the requested patch
283+ ;; defines wasm.host/host-emit; then the runtime twins are used as is)
284+ (when-not (ns-var 'wasm.host 'host-emit)
285+ {#'js/emit #'lw-ext/emit-v #'js/url-param #'lw-ext/url-param-v})))
286+
287+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
288+;; P2.14 (D112): let-go's other lg-DEFINED stdlib namespaces (zip.lg,
289+;; data.lg, set.lg, walk.lg, pprint.lg, graph.lg, ...) are compiled from
290+;; their own source like core.lg (read at letgo-commit), not ported into rt/.
291+;; They load on demand: the first var of such a namespace the backend meets
292+;; (its :file meta is `<embedded:<ns>>`) indexes the whole file. Their defns
293+;; are library defns (D114: params boxed, compiled when reached, a compile
294+;; error names the defn chain), keyed by the native var, so a program's call
295+;; to clojure.zip/node reaches zip.lg's node.
296+;;
297+;; A protocol the file extends only to Object and/or nil (data.lg's
298+;; EqualityPartition and Diff) has no lg defn to compile: its method var is
299+;; filled by a synthesized defn in the same namespace that dispatches nil vs
300+;; everything else to the two extend-type bodies. Extending such a protocol
301+;; from a program is not seen (named limit: protocols are unsupported).
302+
303+(def stdlib-index (atom {})) ; ns-sym -> {var entry}
304+(def stdlib-twin-map (atom {})) ; protocol method var -> synthesized fill var
305+(def stdlib-fills (atom {})) ; synthesized fill var -> its entry
306+
307+(defn embedded-ns
308+ "The stdlib namespace v was loaded from (`<embedded:zip>` -> zip), or nil."
309+ [v]
310+ (let [f (when (var? v) (:file (meta v)))]
311+ (when (and (string? f) (str/starts-with? f "<embedded:") (str/ends-with? f ">"))
312+ (symbol (subs f 10 (dec (count f)))))))
313+
314+(defn- protocol-fills
315+ "[[method-sym fill-form] ...] for the methods a file's (extend-type Object ..)
316+ and (extend-type nil ..) forms implement."
317+ [forms]
318+ (let [impls (atom {})] ; method -> {:object (fn ..) :nil (fn ..)}
319+ (doseq [form forms
320+ :when (and (seq? form) (= 'extend-type (first form)) (contains? '#{Object nil} (second form)))
321+ :let [target (if (= 'Object (second form)) :object :nil)]
322+ m (drop 2 form)
323+ :when (seq? m)]
324+ (swap! impls assoc-in [(first m) target] (apply list 'fn (rest m))))
325+ (vec (for [[m impl] @impls
326+ :let [object (:object impl) nil-impl (:nil impl)
327+ argc (count (second (or object nil-impl)))
328+ args (vec (map #(symbol (str "a" %)) (range argc)))
329+ call (fn [impl] (if impl (apply list impl args)
330+ (list 'throw (list 'ex-info (str "No implementation of method: " m) {}))))]]
331+ [m (list 'defn (symbol (str "__lw_proto_" m)) args
332+ (list 'if (list 'nil? (first args)) (call nil-impl) (call object)))]))))
333+
334+(defn stdlib-ns!
335+ "Index stdlib namespace ns-sym (once); its {var entry} map."
336+ [ns-sym]
337+ (or (get @stdlib-index ns-sym)
338+ (let [file (str (str/replace (str ns-sym) "." "/") ".lg")
339+ forms (embedded-forms file ns-sym)
340+ fills (protocol-fills forms)
341+ ;; eval of a defn under (binding [*ns* ..]) leaves *ns* there
342+ ;; after the binding exits (lg 4e769212), so restore it by name
343+ cur (ns-name *ns*)
344+ fill-vars (try (doall (for [[m form] fills]
345+ (binding [*ns* (the-ns ns-sym)]
346+ (eval form)
347+ [(ns-var ns-sym m) (ns-var ns-sym (second form)) form])))
348+ (finally (in-ns cur)))
349+ idx (merge (into {} (for [[v e] (embedded-defns ns-sym forms)]
350+ [v (-> e (dissoc :core-lg) (assoc :lib true))]))
351+ (into {} (for [[_ fv form] fill-vars]
352+ [fv {:var fv :ns ns-sym :name (second form) :lib true
353+ :arities (arities (drop 2 form))}])))]
354+ (doseq [[mv fv _] fill-vars :when mv] (swap! stdlib-twin-map assoc mv fv))
355+ (swap! stdlib-fills merge (into {} (for [[_ fv _] fill-vars] [fv (get idx fv)])))
356+ (swap! stdlib-index assoc ns-sym idx)
357+ idx)))
358+
359+(defn stdlib-defn
360+ "v's source defn when v is an lg-defined stdlib fn outside core/string."
361+ [v]
362+ (or (get @stdlib-fills v)
363+ (let [n (embedded-ns v)]
364+ (when (and n (not (#{'core 'string} n)))
365+ (get (stdlib-ns! n) v)))))
366+
367+(defn stdlib-twin
368+ "The synthesized fill of a stdlib protocol method var (see above), or nil."
369+ [v]
370+ (when (var? v)
371+ (or (get @stdlib-twin-map v)
372+ (let [m (meta v) n (when (:ns m) (ns-name (:ns m)))]
373+ ;; a protocol method var carries :ns but no :file; index its
374+ ;; namespace when that is an embedded stdlib one
375+ (when (and n (nil? (:file m)) (not (#{'core 'string} n))
376+ (some #(= (str "<embedded:" n ">") (:file (meta %))) (vals (ns-interns n))))
377+ (stdlib-ns! n)
378+ (get @stdlib-twin-map v))))))
379+
380+(defn source-defn
381+ "The source defn the backend compiles for v: a runtime defn, an lg-defined
382+ core fn, one of src/lw_ext.lg's, a stdlib defn, or a program library defn."
383+ [v] (or (get defn-by-var v) (get core-defns v) (get ext-defns v) (get @lib-defns v)
384+ (stdlib-defn v)))

1+// Run a lower-wasm module like lg runs a program (DECISIONS D11/D12):
2+// node src/run.mjs <module.wasm>
3+// Program output goes to stdout through the env.print_* imports; an uncaught
4+// lg exception, wasm trap or host error prints `error: <message>` to stderr
5+// and exits 1.
6+//
7+// The module runs on a worker thread because the main thread's ~1 MB stack
8+// overflows near 10k non-tail lg frames, while native lg (growable Go stacks)
9+// recurses into the millions; 256 MB covers 3M int frames (measured).
10+import fs from 'node:fs';
11+import { Worker, isMainThread, workerData } from 'node:worker_threads';
12+
13+if (isMainThread) {
14+ const w = new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url), {
15+ workerData: { wasm: process.argv[2], argv: process.argv.slice(3) }, resourceLimits: { stackSizeMb: 256 },
16+ });
17+ w.on('error', (e) => { fs.writeSync(2, `error: ${e && e.message || e}\n`); process.exitCode = 1; });
18+ w.on('exit', (c) => { if (c) process.exitCode = c; });
19+} else {
20+ const chunks = [];
21+ let pending = 0;
22+ let fd = 1;
23+ const flush = () => { if (chunks.length) { fs.writeSync(fd, Buffer.concat(chunks)); chunks.length = 0; pending = 0; } };
24+ const emit = (buf) => { chunks.push(buf); pending += buf.length; if (pending > 1 << 16) flush(); };
25+
26+ let mem;
27+ const argv = ['lg', ...workerData.argv];
28+ const env = {
29+ print_i64: (v) => emit(Buffer.from(String(v))),
30+ // copy: the module reuses the scratch region for the next string
31+ print_str: (ptr, len) => emit(Buffer.from(new Uint8Array(mem.buffer, ptr, len))),
32+ print_nl: () => emit(Buffer.from('\n')),
33+ // the host intrinsics (rt/wasm/INTRINSICS.md): fd 1 is the program's
34+ // stdout stream, fd 2 goes straight to stderr
35+ write: (fd, ptr, len) => {
36+ const b = Buffer.from(new Uint8Array(mem.buffer, ptr, len));
37+ if (fd === 1) emit(b); else { flush(); fs.writeSync(2, b); }
38+ return len;
39+ },
40+ sleep: (ms) => { Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, Number(ms)); },
41+ nanotime: () => process.hrtime.bigint(),
42+ // os/args (P3.2, proposed ABI addition): `node run.mjs m.wasm prog.lg a b`
43+ // reads as native's [lg-path "prog.lg" "a" "b"]; arg follows getenv's
44+ // contract (returns the byte length, copies only when it fits in cap)
45+ // D100 (P4.1): js/emit and js/url-param. Native lg off the browser
46+ // emits nowhere and has no page URL, so: drop, and -1 (absent -> nil)
47+ emit: () => {},
48+ url_param: () => -1,
49+ argc: () => argv.length,
50+ arg: (i, buf, cap) => {
51+ const b = Buffer.from(argv[i] ?? '');
52+ if (b.length <= cap) new Uint8Array(mem.buffer, buf, b.length).set(b);
53+ return b.length;
54+ },
55+ };
56+
57+ // D97 term imports: node has no terminal input here, so this host reads as
58+ // the runtime's reference does with no input queued: end of input, nothing
59+ // pending, the 80x24 default (host/ is the interactive JSPI host)
60+ // P3.2: size (-1, -1) = no terminal: this runner mirrors native lg run
61+ // headless, whose term/size is nil off a TTY (term.go), and xsofy keys
62+ // its title-card animation on that nil (lw-ext/term-size-v)
63+ const term = { read_key: () => 0, key_pending: () => 0, size: () => [-1, -1] };
64+ const { instance } = await WebAssembly.instantiate(fs.readFileSync(workerData.wasm), { env, term });
65+ // the backend's own exports have names no lg symbol can spell (a space),
66+ // so a program defn exported under its lg name never collides (P1.7 bug-09)
67+ const ex = instance.exports;
68+ mem = ex['lw mem'];
69+ const lgex = ex['lw lgex'];
70+ try {
71+ ex['lw main']();
72+ flush();
73+ } catch (e) {
74+ flush();
75+ fd = 2;
76+ emit(Buffer.from('error: '));
77+ if (e instanceof WebAssembly.Exception && e.is(lgex)) {
78+ // the module formats its own exception values (message / pr-str)
79+ ex['lw report'](e.getArg(lgex, 0));
80+ } else if (ex['lw trap'] && ex['lw trap']()) {
81+ // wasm/trap: the module printed the reference impl's message
82+ } else {
83+ emit(Buffer.from(String((e && e.message) || e)));
84+ }
85+ emit(Buffer.from('\n'));
86+ flush();
87+ process.exit(1);
88+ }
89+}

1+;; testshim: the minimal `test` namespace a test file needs under the backend
2+;; (P2.1, checks/run-tests.sh). pkg/rt/core/test.lg leans on dynamic vars,
3+;; multimethods and ns reflection, none of which the backend lowers, so the
4+;; driver's --test mode swaps the test file's deftest/is/testing for these
5+;; and prints the lines native run-tests prints that the check compares:
6+;;
7+;; \nTesting <ns>\n\nRan N tests containing M assertions.\nF failures, E errors.
8+;; \nFAIL in (<test>) \nERROR in (<test>)
9+;;
10+;; (native's FAIL/ERROR lines also carry a file:line and the expected/actual
11+;; block, which run-tests.sh strips before comparing).
12+;;
13+;; The forms below are injected into the test program after its ns form.
14+;; `is` counts one assertion per evaluation, like native's do-report; an
15+;; exception inside `is` is an error, one escaping a deftest body is an error
16+;; too ("Uncaught exception, not in assertion") and ends that test.
17+
18+(def __t-pass (atom 0))
19+(def __t-fail (atom 0))
20+(def __t-error (atom 0))
21+(def __t-tests (atom 0))
22+(def __t-name (atom nil))
23+
24+(defn __t-begin [nm]
25+ (swap! __t-tests inc)
26+ (reset! __t-name nm))
27+
28+(defn __t-report [r]
29+ (if (= r :__t-error)
30+ (do (swap! __t-error inc) (println (str "\nERROR in (" @__t-name ")")))
31+ (if r
32+ (swap! __t-pass inc)
33+ (do (swap! __t-fail inc) (println (str "\nFAIL in (" @__t-name ")"))))))
34+
35+(defn __t-uncaught [e]
36+ (swap! __t-error inc)
37+ (println (str "\nERROR in (" @__t-name ")")))
38+
39+(defn __t-summary []
40+ (println (str "\nRan " @__t-tests " tests containing " (+ (+ @__t-pass @__t-fail) @__t-error) " assertions."))
41+ (println (str @__t-fail " failures, " @__t-error " errors.")))
